{{Quote|Well, you know the Rogues. All we need is a ship and rock to land it on.|Wedge Antilles|<ref name="Shadows novel">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>}}
'''Rogue Squadron''' was a legendary [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that flew for over 130 [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. Originally a part of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], it later served the [[Alliance of Free Planets]], [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]], and [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]]. Its roster routinely included some of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] best [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], and its successes in [[Space warfare/Legends|battle]] gave the squadron an almost mythical presence that reassured galactic citizens someone was in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] protecting them. The Rogues were important symbols to the different governments they served and a key part of public morale. Led by a pilot with the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] [[Rogue Leader/Legends|Rogue Leader]], the squadron flew various types of fighter [[Starship/Legends|craft]] throughout their history, usually a version of an [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]], and they were assisted by [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] in the fighters' [[Astromech socket/Legends|droid sockets]].

The Rogues were originally a smaller [[Flight group/Legends|flight group]] known as '''Rogue Flight''', formed by the Alliance's [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Arhul Narra/Legends|Arhul Narra]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] from the remnants of [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] led a core group of [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilots]] on various missions in the ongoing [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and the flight's members were a part of the '''Rogue Group''' that flew against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY's]] [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. Antilles expanded the Rogues into a full twelve-person squadron after [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] was evacuated, and they [[Starfighter combat/Legends|fought]] in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] [[4 ABY/Legends|one year later]] as '''Red Squadron''', where Antilles helped destroy the Empire's [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]]. As the group went on to serve the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], it was disbanded for a year due to the amount of new recruits who were [[Death/Legends|dying]] too soon after signing up.

Rebuilt with a heavily-trained group of elite pilots in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], Rogue Squadron played a key role in [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|capturing]] the galactic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] from the Empire, but its twelve members soon afterward resigned their commissions in order to [[Antilles's Rogues|pursue]] a private [[Bacta War|guerrilla war]] against the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Ysanne Isard]]. The operation was retroactively sanctioned by the New Republic, and the Rogues went on to fight for their government in such conflicts as the [[Essence transfer|reborn]] [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Battle of Calamari|assault]] on [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]], the [[Orinda campaign]], and a [[Battle of Yaga Minor (Galactic Civil War)|battle]] at [[Yaga Minor/Legends|Yaga Minor]] that brought the long war to an [[Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty|end]]. When the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invaded]] the galaxy in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], Rogue Squadron were among the first defenders on the front lines.

Although they suffered devastating losses against the unknown enemy, Rogue Squadron persevered and helped fight the tide of the invasion for four years under the command of [[Gavin Darklighter]]. They were among the few [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic forces]] who took a [[Battle of Borleias (Yuuzhan Vong War; Second)|stand]] at [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]], and they flew in the decisive [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar]] that finally defeated the invaders. Now a part of the Galactic Alliance, the Rogues [[Battle of Tenupe|took on]] the [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] during the [[Swarm War]] and a [[Battle of Centerpoint Station (Second Galactic Civil War)|unit]] called [[Rakehell Squadron]] in the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. Loyalties had been blurred during the conflict, and [[Rakehell Leader]] Wedge Antilles [[Battle of Centerpoint Station (Second Galactic Civil War)|shot down]] and killed Rogue Leader [[Lensi]]. Nearly [[137 ABY|100 years later]], Rogue Squadron were a part of the Galactic Alliance Remnant, and they [[Second Imperial Civil War|fought]] the [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]] of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] in such engagements as the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Second Imperial Civil War)|Battle of Mon Calamari]] and a [[Battle of Coruscant (Second Imperial Civil War)|climactic strike]] at [[Darth Krayt|Krayt's]] Coruscant stronghold.

==Organization==
{{Quote|I'm with Rogue Squadron. Impossible is our stock in trade, and success is what we deliver.|Corran Horn|<ref name="The Krytos Trap" />}}
Rogue Squadron was a twelve-person [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that, throughout its history, served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]],<ref name="CSWE Rogue Squadron" /> [[Alliance of Free Planets]],<ref name="The Forgotten War" /> [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]],<ref name="CSWE Rogue Squadron" /> and [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]].<ref name="LECG" /> It was composed of the top [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilots]] in the [[Alliance Starfighter Corps/Legends|Alliance Starfighter Corps]],<ref name="CSWE Rogue Squadron" /> and later, the best [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] in the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic Defense Force]]. The Rogues were the symbol of the [[New Republic Starfighter Corps/Legends|New Republic's starfighter]] superiority and its most effective tool against enemy aggression;<ref name="NJO Sourcebook">''[[The New Jedi Order Sourcebook]]''</ref> their successes gave them an almost mythical presence in battle and could sometimes prompt an enemy to surrender without any shots being fired.<ref name="CE Handbook Wedge" /> As long as Rogue Squadron endured, the citizens of the New Republic had hope that there was someone in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] protecting them.<ref name="NJO Sourcebook" /> Still later, the Rogues became a symbol of the bravery and fighting spirit of the Galactic Alliance,<ref name="CSWE Rogue Squadron" /> and in [[137 ABY]], they were the most elite of all squadrons in the Galactic Alliance Remnant.<ref name="LECG" />

[[File:RogueSquadron-Aurebesh.svg|thumb|left|200px|The Rogue Squadron crest]]
Rogue Squadron was originally a [[Flight group/Legends|flight group]] known as Rogue Flight, and was, along with [[Renegade Flight]], formed from the remnants of the Rebel Alliance's [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]<ref name="Warfare" /> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="NEC" /> The pilots of Rogue Flight, together with those of [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue]] and [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green Squadrons]], flew as the ad hoc Rogue Group in the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]<ref name="Warfare" /> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> after which the Rogues became a full squadron,<ref name="Galaxy Guide 3 2nd Edition">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]]</ref> designed by Skywalker to operate without a set mission profile in order to take on any assignment that came their way.<ref name="CSWE Rogue Squadron" /> Throughout their history, the Rogues were led by a pilot designated [[Rogue Leader/Legends|Rogue Leader]];<ref name="CSWE Rogue Leader" /> some Rogue Leaders broke the squadron up into smaller flight groups of four starfighters a piece.<ref name="Rogue Squadron" /><ref name="Onslaught" />

By the ethics of the Squadron, every pilot was concerned with each other's protection over their own survival; each success or failure was credited collectively, no matter which pilot managed the critical shots.<ref name="Rogue Squadron Player's Guide" />

For many [[Standard year/Legends|years]], the Rogues flew [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing fighters]], with [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] assisting them from the fighters' [[Astromech socket/Legends|droid sockets]],<ref name="CSWE Rogue Squadron" /> although missions occasionally called for them to pilot other craft such as [[BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]], [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]], or [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47 airspeeders]].<ref name="Star Wars: Rogue Squadron" /> The Rebel Alliance and the New Republic initially used the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]]<ref name="CSWE X-wing" /> and later the upgraded [[T-65B X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65B model]],<ref name="Mindor" /> with special red stripes for Rogue Squadron painted on,<ref name="Wraith Squadron" /> but in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]]<ref name="NEC" /> the squadron was reconfigured into a multi-fighter unit that included A-wings,<ref name="CE Handbook Wedge" /> [[E-7 E-wing multi-role starfighter|E-wings]], and [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]].<ref name="Crimson Empire 5" /> The Rogues were back in X-wings within the year, however.<ref name="I, Jedi">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref> By [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], Rogue Squadron was flying in the new [[T-65A3 X-wing starfighter|T-65A3 X-wing]],<ref name="Onslaught" /> and in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], the [[XJ7 X-wing starfighter|XJ7 model]].<ref name="Bloodlines" /> Nearly 100 years later, the Rogues flew [[CF9 Crossfire starfighter]]s.<ref name="LECG" />

In the New Republic's early years, Rogue Squadron was so key to citizens' morale that when its members resigned their posts to wage the independent, guerrilla [[Bacta War]] against the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Ysanne Isard]], the New Republic put together an [[ersatz Rogue Squadron]] to be visible while [[Antilles's Rogues]] were away. Two unique Rogue Squadrons existed simultaneously with each other, but after Isard's [[Battle of Thyferra|defeat]], the New Republic retroactively deemed the [[Bacta/Legends|Bacta]] War an officially sanctioned operation, and Rogue Squadron was once more whole.<ref name="Wraith Squadron" />

[[Rogue Squadron crest|Rogue Squadron's crest]] featured a blue [[Alliance Starbird]] surrounded by a twelve-pointed red star, with an X-wing fighter at each of the star's points. It was designed by Rogue pilot [[Gavin Darklighter]] in [[6 ABY/Legends|6.5 ABY]]. The Rogues began to use it before it was officially sanctioned by [[New Republic Starfighter Command/Legends|New Republic Starfighter Command]], sporting it as a patch on their orange [[Rebel flight suit|flight suits]] and having it painted on their X-wings.<ref name="Rogue Squadron" />

==History==
===Rebel aces===
====Origins====
{{Quote|It was about a year and a half ago that I first met most of you. You were bright-eyed and enthusiastic, ready to launch into one grand adventure after another. I had seen that before with other pilots in Rogue Squadron. I remember the days before Yavin when we were all young, armored with the invincibility of youth and fired by the belief that the Emperor's evil Empire could not win.|Wedge Antilles in 7 ABY|<ref name="The Bacta War" />}}
[[File:Battle_of_Yavin.png|thumb|right|300px|Red Squadron flies into the Battle of Yavin.]]
In the year 0 BBY,<ref name="NEC" /> the Rebel Alliance cobbled together an ad hoc [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] composed of [[Rebel pilot/Legends|rebel pilots]] from such groups as the [[Ecliptic Evaders]], the [[Dantooine Squadron]], the [[Tierfon Yellow Aces/Legends|Tierfon Yellow Aces]],<ref name="Galaxy Guide 3 2nd Edition" /> and the [[Griffon Flight Wing]].<ref name="Warfare" /> The new group was known as Red Squadron, and its task was to destroy the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] massive [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]],<ref name="Galaxy Guide 3 2nd Edition" /> which was approaching the [[Great Temple/Legends|Alliance's base]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. In T-65 X-wing starfighters,<ref name="A New Hope">{{Film|IV}}</ref> [[Garven Dreis/Legends|Garven Dreis]] flew as [[Red Leader/Legends|Red Leader]], [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] as [[Red Two/Legends|Red Two]], [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]] as [[Red Three/Legends|Red Three]], [[John D. Branon/Legends|John D. Branon]] as [[Red Four/Legends|Red Four]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] as [[Red Five/Legends|Red Five]], [[Jek Tono Porkins/Legends|Jek Tono Porkins]] as [[Red Six/Legends|Red Six]], [[Elyhek Rue/Legends|Elyhek Rue]] as [[Red Seven/Legends|Red Seven]], [[Bren Quersey/Legends|Bren Quersey]] as [[Red Eight/Legends|Red Eight]], [[Nozzo Naytaan/Legends|Nozzo Naytaan]] as [[Red Nine/Legends|Red Nine]], [[Theron Nett/Legends|Theron Nett]] as [[Red Ten/Legends|Red Ten]], [[Wenton Chan/Legends|Wenton Chan]] as [[Red Eleven/Legends|Red Eleven]], and [[Puck Naeco/Legends|Puck Naeco]] as [[Red Twelve/Legends|Red Twelve]].<ref name="Warfare" /> Of the entire squadron, only Skywalker and Antilles survived the Battle of Yavin, with the former firing two [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] into the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star's]] [[Thermal exhaust port/Legends|thermal exhaust port]] and destroying the entire [[Space station/Legends|station]].<ref name="A New Hope" />

The [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] continued, and Red Squadron was reconstituted as two different flight groups: Renegade Flight, led by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Arhul Narra/Legends|Arhul Narra]], and Rogue Flight, led by Rogue Leader, Luke Skywalker. Wedge Antilles was his second-in-command.<ref name="Warfare" /> The latter flight group developed when Antilles was permanently assigned to [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] following the Rebels' [[Evacuation of Yavin]]. He was part of a core team of pilots that began to form under Skywalker, that flew, trained, and developed tactics together. Narra placed Skywalker in charge of the nascent Rogue Flight, which began to take form under Narra's wise tutelage. Its members included [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]], a capable pilot and [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] who struck up a fast friendship with Antilles, and [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek "Hobbie" Klivian]], who bonded with Skywalker over the loss of their mutual friend Biggs Darklighter.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 3 2nd Edition" /> Skywalker and Antilles were surrounded by some of the best pilots in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="CSWE Wedge">{{CSWECite|I|35|Antilles, Wedge}}</ref>

====Earliest missions====
{{Quote|How pathetic, allying yourself with those Rebel criminals&mdash;Rogue Squadron. You and your so-called Rogues helped in the absconding of my AT-PTs ''and'' the plundering of my Research Facility. My retaliation shall be swift and just&hellip;|Moff Kohl Seerdon, to Kasan Moor|<ref name="Star Wars: Rogue Squadron" />}}
Although Rogue Flight was initially dismissed by [[Starfighter Command (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Starfighter Command]],<ref name="NEGTC" /> they proved their effectiveness as a team that lived together and flew together during several skirmishes of the Alliance's [[Battle of Thila|evacuation of Thila]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide 3 2nd Edition" /> The [[Thila/Legends|planet]] was the site of the relocated Rebel [[Thila Command|headquarters]], and when the Empire attacked, Antilles took a T-47 [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] into battle without realizing that the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] was dangling from his fuselage.<ref name="NEGTC" /> Flying close to the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] surface, Antilles became aware of his stowaway and maneuvered close enough to a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] to allow the Wookiee to drop in on the Imperial pilot. The move allowed Chewbacca to successfully capture an enemy fighter, but Antilles was frightened enough of his surprise passenger's ire to make himself scarce upon returning to base.<ref name="Chewbacca 3">[[Chewbacca (2000) 3|''Chewbacca'' (2000) 3]]</ref>

[[File:Ambushatmoseisley.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Rogue Leader Luke Skywalker chases a TIE bomber over Mos Eisley.]]
[[0 ABY/Legends|Six months after Yavin]], Rogue Flight was composed of Skywalker, Antilles, Janson, Klivian, [[Dak Ralter/Legends|Dak Ralter]], and [[Zev Senesca/Legends|Zev Senesca]]. In the droid socket of Skywalker's X-wing was his [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. On the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], Skywalker, Antilles, and one other Rogue took their X-wings for a stroll through [[Beggar's Canyon/Legends|Beggar's Canyon]] and came across [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Imperial probe droids]] firing on nearby [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farms]]. After [[Ambush at Mos Eisley|making short work]] of the machines, the Rogues hastened to the [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] to defend it from attacking [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bombers]]. Their next mission took them to [[Barkhesh/Legends|Barkhesh]], where local [[Barkhesh Resistance|resistance forces]] were set to donate supplies that were vital to the Rebel cause. After being briefed by the Alliance's [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Rieekan]], the Rogues escorted the dirtside supply [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] to a landing zone for a rendezvous with a Rebel [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]], but the way there was [[Rendezvous on Barkhesh|beset]] by Imperial forces including [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]], [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]], and [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] batteries. Despite the opposition, the Rogues ensured that the handoff was a success.<ref name="Star Wars: Rogue Squadron" />

When the Rebel [[Transport/Legends|transport]] ''[[Nonnah]]'' crashed<ref name="Star Wars: Rogue Squadron" /> on the world of [[Chorax]],<ref name="Rogue Squadron instruction manual">[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron'']] instructon manual</ref> Rieekan sent Rogue Flight to [[Search for the Nonnah|find]] the Alliance [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and their stolen Imperial equipment before the Empire could. Piloting A-wings above Chorax's surface, the Rogues were forced to deal with [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE interceptors]] until the target was located. When the crashed [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was found half-submerged in a lake, Rogue Flight fought off TIE [[Bomb/Legends|bombers]], as well as [[XR-85 tank droid]]s, an AT-ST, and [[All Terrain Personal Transport/Legends|AT-PT]] walkers that were disgorged from an Imperial [[Sentinel-class landing craft/Legends|''Sentinel''-class landing craft]]. A Rebel [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] was able to rescue the ''Nonnah''{{'s}} crew, and the Rogues defended it from one more [[Interceptor/Legends|interceptor]] squadron before leaving the planet. General Rieekan [[1 ABY/Legends|later]] received word that [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]], an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] with information on the Empire's [[Ground warfare/Legends|ground operations]], wanted to defect to the Rebellion, and he traveled to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to meet with him. With rear gunners assisting them, Skywalker and two other Rogues patrolled the planet's [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] in T-47 airspeeders while Rieekan met with [[City/Legends|city]] officials inside the [[Coronet Capitol Tower]].<ref name="Star Wars: Rogue Squadron" />

TIE bombers began [[Battle of Corellia (1 ABY)|pounding]] the tower, but the Rogues fought them off before receiving a message from Madine: the [[Technology Center]] where he was hiding was also under attack. Luckily for the Rogues, the Alliance's [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], a native [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]], and his [[First Mate/Legends|First Mate]] Chewbacca soon arrived in their [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|starship]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], to aid them. Further resistance came from Imperial [[amphibion]]s, AT-STs, and one [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]], but Skywalker tripped the latter with his [[Speeder/Legends|speeder's]] [[Power harpoon launcher|harpoon and tow cable]] while Rebel [[DF.9/Legends|defense batteries]] helped hold off the rest. When Rebel shuttles rescued both Rieekan and Madine, the Alliance forces departed Corellia. The Rogues then began to work on a number of missions under the direction of Madine, including the [[liberation of Gerrard V]] from the oppression of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kohl Seerdon]].<ref name="Star Wars: Rogue Squadron" />

[[Gerrard V]] was seeking independence from the Empire, and its local [[Unidentified Imperial governor (Gerrard V)|governor]] responded by looting the planet. Madine responded to a distress call from the local insurgents by sending in both Rogue Flight and [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] to help. The Rogues were tasked with protecting the Golds while their Y-wings disabled the [[Governor/Legends|governor's]] [[Personal Luxury Yacht 3000/Legends|yachts]], and Skywalker also led Rogue Flight in destroying laser and [[missile turret]]s that were mounted in one of the planet's cities, as well as roaming AT-PTs. Antilles suddenly contacted Skywalker from the other side of the planet with urgent news&mdash;he was facing off against the famed Imperial [[128th TIE Interceptor Squadron]]. The interceptors soon swarmed the city, but Rogue Flight was able to hold them off while Gold Squadron completed its mission. One Y-wing disabled the 128th's [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Kasan Moor/Legends|Kasan Moor]], who commed her attacker with an offer to defect to the Alliance.<ref name="Star Wars: Rogue Squadron" />

[[File:Narraandskywalker.jpg|thumb|right|275px|Arhul Narra and Luke Skywalker in the early days of Rogue Flight]]
Moor provided the Alliance with the location of an [[Jade Moon supply base|Imperial base]] on a moon known as the [[Jade Moon]]. It was a supply station for other Imperial bases in the [[Loronar system/Legends|system]], and Madine led ground troops during the [[Battle of the Jade Moon|assault]] while Rogue Flight provided air support, tasked with knocking out the base's [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]]. Four X-wings flew in the mission, including the newest Rogue, Moor, whom Antilles was not sure they could trust. The Rogues neutralized laser and missile [[Turret/Legends|turret]] defenses, as well as AT-PTs, before Skywalker found the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] generator in a canyon and blew it up. Madine's [[combat vehicle]]s moved in, and the arrival of TIE bombers and interceptors kept Rogue Flight busy while the [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] looted the base. Although Moor found it strange to be flying for the other side, Skywalker commended her for fighting for her own ideals.<ref name="Star Wars: Rogue Squadron" />

Moor then offered up the location of [[Imperial construction yard]]s<ref name="Star Wars: Rogue Squadron" /> on the planet [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].<ref name="Rogue Squadron Player's Guide">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron: The Official Nintendo Player's Guide]]''</ref> Skywalker and five other Rogues, in three airspeeders, went in on a simple [[Raid on Balmorra|hit-and-run mission]] while the base's TIEs were out on a test flight, stealthily approaching through a canyon and knocking out any ground scanners that lay in their path. At the construction yards, they met resistance from Imperial walkers and a number of ground-based laser and missile turrets, but various TIEs and a ''Lambda''-class shuttle were blasted apart before they could lift off. The defending AT-ATs were tripped with tow cables, and when the yards were destroyed, the three Rogues were elated to have brought the fight to the Empire. Moor's next target was an Imperial [[enclave]] on [[Kile II]] that supported the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] throughout the [[Jospro sector/Legends|sector]], and Rogue Flight went on the [[Assault on Kile II|assault]] with six Y-wing bombers. Skywalker led his fellows through some deep canyons to their target: the enclave's spaceport.<ref name="Star Wars: Rogue Squadron" />

While bombing the spaceport, the Rogues faced opposition from TIE interceptors, ''Lambda''s, and both laser and missile turrets. They destroyed their target while weaving through a thick field of enemy fire, but Antilles and [[Rogue Seven/Legends|Rogue Seven]] were overwhelmed by three interceptors. Rogue Seven was killed and Antilles's Y-wing was downed, and Klivian barely escaped to inform Skywalker of Antilles's capture. Although Rieekan attempted to buoy the flight group's spirits by declaring that Imperial activity in the sector would now slow down, they immediately made for the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] planet of [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] to [[Rescue on Kessel|rescue]] their comrade. Moor's insight helped the Rogues avoid a decoy convoy full of [[Human/Legends|Human]] lifesigns and head to their true target, an [[armored hovertrain]] that was carrying Antilles and other rebel prisoners to a central station for processing.<ref name="Star Wars: Rogue Squadron" />

The Imperial defenses on Kessel failed to deter Rogue Flight, whose [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] disabled the [[Train/Legends|train]]. Antilles's X-wing was brought down for him to board, leading Moor to express some grudging respect for Skywalker's abilities in the cockpit. The Rogues' mission on Kessel was not yet complete, however&mdash;Antilles had learned that other rebels were being held in the planet's notorious prisons, and Rogue Flight were quickly recruited to help General Madine free them. Their task was to knock out the prison camp's [[DSS-02 shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] to allow Madine to go in, and despite resistance from AT-STs, TIEs, turrets, and probe droids, the pilots got it done. With a shuttle full of rescued allies, Madine accompanied them back to the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]], but Rogue Flight were once again called into action in the skies above [[Taloraan/Legends|Taloraan]] to do [[Battle above Taloraan|battle]] with the Empire over [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] [[Gas/Legends|gas]] platforms.<ref name="Star Wars: Rogue Squadron" />

[[File:Escapefromfest.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Skywalker takes down an AT-AT on Fest with his harpoon and tow cable.]]
Skywalker, Antilles, Moor, and one other Rogue accomplished two goals from the cockpits of A-wings: destroying enemy tibanna gas supplies, which were fuel for Imperial weapons, and doing as much damage as possible to the local TIE fighter squadron. They were careful to avoid injuring civilians, and upon achieving their goal, they were escorted away from [[Taloraan City]] by several [[Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud car/Legends|Twin-Pod cloud cars]]. Concurrently, a group of Rebel commandos captured three AT-PT walkers from a [[Weapons Research Facility]] on [[Fest/Legends|Fest]], but a wrench thrown into the works of their escape plan necessitated Rogue Flight [[Escape from Fest|intervention]]. Skywalker, Antilles, Moor, and two other Rogues took to snowspeeders with their rear gunners and descended on a wintry landscape to screen the captured walkers from AT-ATs, XR-85 [[Tank/Legends|tank]] droids, and TIE bombers. The Rogues also destroyed the research facility after taking out its protective shield generator, and with their assistance, the commandos safely made it to a landing zone and took off in a [[Y-4 Transport]]. On their way out, the Rogues learned from Rieekan that Seerdon was planning to attack the Alliance's bacta supply.<ref name="Star Wars: Rogue Squadron" />

The pilots of Rogue Flight put an end to Moff Seerdon's schemes on a number of worlds, flying in a [[Blockade on Chandrila]]&mdash;while Seerdon invaded [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], the Rogues escorted an armed [[Hovertrain/Legends|hovertrain]] loaded with supplies to the besieged city of [[Nayli]] and several evacuation shuttles full of civilians away from it. They also took out Seerdon's TIE bombers and interceptors, thus saving the city. After [[Raid on Sullust|raiding]] one of Seerdon's bases on [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], the Rogues had a [[Attack on Thyferra|final showdown]] with the Moff at [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]], which saw Seerdon finally perish.<ref name="Star Wars: Rogue Squadron" />

====Making a name====
{{Quote|I'm Captain Kar Lamoran of Corellia. You must be with the Rebel Alliance.''"<br />"''What makes you say that?''"<br />"''Only a Rebel would be brave enough to risk everything to rescue us from this place. Either that or you're just crazy!|Kar Lamoran and a member of Rogue Flight on Kwenn Space Station|<ref name="Rogue Squadron to the Rescue">''[[Star Wars Missions 18: Rogue Squadron to the Rescue]]''</ref>}}
Other Rogue missions included escorting a convoy of transports through the [[Ison Trade Corridor/Legends|Ison Corridor]], fighting off an Imperial [[Ison Corridor ambush|ambush]] to make it safely to Hoth.<ref name="Rogue Squadron II">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader]]''</ref> Rogue Flight also headed to [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] to [[Mission to Dantooine|rescue]] the Imperial pilot [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]], a double agent whose [[Spy/Legends|spying]] for the Rebels had been discovered. Celchu eventually became a Rogue, and the pilots were later dispatched to the [[defense of Ralltiir]] to help cover the escape of [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] working for the Alliance. Since the evacuation of Yavin, the Rogues' Lieutenant [[Sarkli]] had caused tension among he and his fellow pilots, believing he was not getting the credit he deserved. At [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]], Sarkli decided he had enough and joined the Empire.<ref name="Rebel Strike">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref>

When a shipment of metal from the planet [[Vactooine]] failed to arrive on Yavin 4, Skywalker [[Force sense/Legends|felt]] that something was amiss. Alongside Solo, Chewbacca, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], and the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], R2-D2, and [[Q-7N]], he took the ''Millennium Falcon'' to Vactooine to investigate, with Antilles and three other Rogues escorting the group in their X-wings. Upon their reversion to realspace, they were attacked by a lone Imperial ''Lambda''-class shuttle, which [[Battle of Vactooine|launched]] a [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] that detonated and produced a shockwave. Power was knocked out of all of the Rebel ships save for one, which engaged in further battle with the ''Lambda'' and was forced to crash-land onto Vactooine's surface. There, its pilot learned of a [[12-4C-41's Droid Army|droid army]] led by the criminal [[Olag Greck]] that had commandeered the Imperial [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Decimator (Star Destroyer)|''Decimator'']]. Teaming up with [[Boonda/Legends|Boonda]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], the former owner of the droids, the Rebel infiltrated a local [[Unidentified mining colony (Vactooine)|mining colony]] and convinced Greck's army to turn against him. The ''Decimator'' was then gifted to the Alliance by Boonda and the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colony's workers.<ref name="The Vactooine Disaster">''[[Star Wars Missions 12: The Vactooine Disaster]]''</ref>

[[File:IsonAmbush-RSII.jpg|thumb|right|275px|Rogue Flight takes on Imperials in the Ison Corridor.]]
In search of a new Rebel base, General [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] [[Mission to Kwenn Space Station|dispatched]] Rogue Flight to [[Kwenn Space Station/Legends|Kwenn Space Station]] to search for tips on seldom-used [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]].<ref name="Darth Vader's Return">''[[Star Wars Missions 17: Darth Vader's Return]]''</ref> The Rogues made the trip without Skywalker, who was still on assignment aboard the ''Falcon'', and on arrival they were dismayed to learn that a number of the station's outbound trade routes through the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] had been altered by the Empire. Splitting up from their fellow pilots, Antilles, Janson, and Celchu disguised themselves as [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] and observed an [[Action VI bulk transport/Legends|Action VI transport]] get seized by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]; Antilles contacted Leia Organa via [[Courier droid/Legends|message droid]] to request backup before proceeding to investigate. After taking care of a stormtrooper problem, the three left the [[Hangar 872-H|hangar]] and headed to a shopping complex, but the sight of more [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] prompted the trio to dissolve. Two of the Rogues fled while one stayed behind to distract the Imperials, and after a short tussle, he escaped by swimming through an aquarium.<ref name="Rogue Squadron to the Rescue" />

Making his way to the detention cells, he got past a [[K4 security droid]] and an [[Interrogation droid/Legends|interrogation droid]] in order to rescue the crew of the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], the ''[[Stellar Manx]]''. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kar Lamoran]] and her crew helped the Rogue defeat two suddenly-arriving stormtroopers before he sent them to Rogue Flight's [[Docking Bay 238|docking bay]], but Lamoran was determined to reclaim her ship and met up with the Rogue back at the hangar, which he had reached through the system's air vents. She helped him dispose of more stormtroopers, and when the freighter suddenly took off, the Rogue followed it in an emergency vehicle and boarded it. On the ship, he overheard Imperial soldiers mention that the Empire's [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] had ordered them to take it to the planet [[Bonadan/Legends|Bonadan]], but he was able to neutralize them all and take control of the freighter. The Rogue's final challenge was a suspicious [[ASP-7 labor droid/Legends|ASP-7 labor droid]] that had been left aboard the freighter, which he overcame before safely bringing the ship back aboard the space station and rendezvousing with the arriving ''Millennium Falcon'', which had received Antilles's message. Worried by Vader's plans, Solo, Organa, and Skywalker decided to dress as Imperials and take the freighter to Bonadan themselves.<ref name="Rogue Squadron to the Rescue" />

On a mission to set up a listening post on [[Lubang Minor]] approximately seven [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the Battle of Yavin,<ref name="EmpireOmnibus2">''[[Star Wars Omnibus: At War with the Empire Volume 2]]''</ref> three Rogues&mdash;Skywalker, Antilles, and Senesca&mdash;flew under Commander Narra<ref name="Empire 27">[[Empire 27|''Empire'' 27]]</ref> as Red Squadron.<ref name="Empire 26">[[Empire 26|''Empire'' 26]]</ref> There, they [[Battle of Lubang Minor (Galactic Civil War)|rescued]] [[Able]], an aged [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] left abandoned on the planet during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Empire 27" /> In the following month,<ref name="EmpireOmnibus2" /> Antilles and Klivian escorted a [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] party of Rebels to [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]] after the [[Jabiimi Loyalists]] requested Alliance aid in their fight against Imperial control of their planet. The two Rogues' X-wings remained in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], but they were soon ordered out of the system by the Loyalists, who were furious with one of the diplomats: Luke Skywalker.<ref name="Empire 29">[[Empire 29|''Empire'' 29]]</ref>

[[File:Rogueflightatjabiim.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Antilles and Klivian flee from Imperials above Jabiim.]]
TIE fighters aligned with the Imperial [[Jabiimi Nationalists]] suddenly arrived, but the Rogues elected not to attack them in an effort to maintain diplomacy. When the TIEs were followed by an Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], Antilles and Klivian decided to [[Subjugation of Jabiim|rescue]] their comrades, diplomacy be damned.<ref name="Empire 30">[[Empire 30|''Empire'' 30]]</ref> After outrunning the fleet of [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|slave ships]],<ref name="Empire 32">[[Empire 32|''Empire'' 32]]</ref> they made it to the surface of Jabiim in [[Time/Legends|time]] to save the Rebels Leia Organa and [[Nera Dantels]] from a group of TIEs. Although Organa did not want to abandon the Jabiimi Loyalists, Antilles insisted that they flee from the encroaching Imperial fleet.<ref name="Empire 33">[[Empire 33|''Empire'' 33]]</ref> Before departing, they rescued Skywalker and Loyalist leader [[Nolan Gillmunn]] from the Nationalists, with Antilles's and Klivian's X-wings blasting their way into an [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]]. On their way out of [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], the two Rogues held off TIE fighters, allowing themselves and Dantels' ''[[Starduster]]'' to jump to [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]].<ref name="Empire 34">[[Empire 34|''Empire'' 34]]</ref>

When Governor [[Bidor Ferrouz]] of the [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector]], a region of space near the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], offered to provide a base for the Alliance in exchange for protection from the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] warlord [[Nuso Esva]], two Rebel teams were organized to go investigate. While Skywalker joined an [[Battle for Poln Major|expedition]] to the [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Poln Major]], Rogue Flight went to [[Poln Minor]] under the command of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]]. After touching down, Antilles and two other Rogues were called on to pilot their X-wings through the world's underground tunnels to intercept Organa and Solo, who were being pursued by enemy [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]]. Although the speeders eluded the Rogues, the trio escorted their charges back to Cracken's base camp, and Organa deduced where they could locate a cavern full of Nuso Esva's [[Warship/Legends|warships]]&mdash;Esva had in fact kidnapped Governor Ferrouz's family and forced him to make contact with the Alliance, and the group realized they had to take out the warlord's ships in order to have any hope of escape. A plan was thus made for Rogue Flight to attack the warships in T-47 airspeeders, which were small and maneuverable enough to make it through the constricting tunnels that led to their targets.<ref name="Choices of One">''[[Choices of One]]''</ref>

With Organa riding in Antilles's rear gunner's seat, a ten-ship raiding party lifted off in their airspeeders. Unexpectedly, they found fifty of the warlord's warships prepped and ready to fly, and ready to fire [[Laser/Legends|lasers]] at the Rebel attackers. By staying above the forward-firing [[Laser cannon/Legends|cannons]] of the parked craft, the Rebels were able to evade the blasts, but the warships were heavily [[Armor/Legends|armored]] and [[Ray shield/Legends|ray-shielded]] to boot, allowing them to withstand the Rogues' onslaught. Cracken soon ordered the airspeeders to disengage, as Solo and Chewbacca had a plan of their own, but before they fled, Organa fired her harpoon and tow cable at Rogue Three's speeder. The move allowed Antilles and Rogue Three to fly in tandem and slice off one of the warship's [[Sensor globe|sensor bulbs]], and the other Rogues mimicked the maneuver and destroyed at least twelve more bulbs before breaking off. When the warships blew their way through the cavern's ceiling and launched into space, Solo destroyed them all with proton torpedoes from a nearby [[Golan I Space Defense Platform/Legends|Golan space platform]] he had commandeered, throwing a [[Hydrospanner/Legends|hydrospanner]] into Esva's battle plans. [[Nuso Esva's battle fleet]] was defeated by the Empire's [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] in the ensuing [[Battle of the Poln system|battle]], allowing the Alliance armada to escape.<ref name="Choices of One" />

====Fire and ice====
{{Quote|Rogue Group, use your harpoons and tow cables. Go for the legs. It might be our only chance of stopping them.|Luke Skywalker during the Battle of Hoth|<ref name="ESB" />}}
[[File:Rogue_Squadron_by_Tommy_Lee_Edwards.jpg|thumb|right|270px|Rogue Group is briefed at Echo Base.]]
In 3 ABY,<ref name="NEC" /> the Alliance had set up the secret [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the icy world of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. While escorting a convoy of supplies and reinforcements to Hoth from [[Derra IV/Legends|Derra IV]], Renegade Flight was [[Battle of Derra IV|attacked]] and destroyed along with the entire convoy, and when word reached Echo Base, General Rieekan promoted Skywalker to Commander as a replacement for the fallen Narra. With the Renegades gone, Skywalker and Antilles decided to expand Rogue Flight into a full-fledged squadron that would serve Rebel High Command. The two pored over lists of pilots<ref name="Warfare" /> until a [[One-Arm|wampa]] attack forced Skywalker and Captain Han Solo to spend a night out in the cold; Rogue Flight took to snowspeeders the next morning to search for them in the fields of snow. The missing Rebels were found by [[Rogue Two/Legends|Rogue Two]],<ref name="Radio Drama">[[The Empire Strikes Back (radio)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' radio drama]]</ref> Zev Senesca.<ref name="CCG Hoth Limited Rogue Two">{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=Rogue 2}}</ref>

Shortly after the rescue, base [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] detected a nearby metallic presence, and Rieekan dispatched Rogues [[Rogue Ten/Legends|Ten]] and [[Rogue Eleven/Legends|Eleven]] to [[Echo Station 3-8]] to investigate.<ref name="ESB novel">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization]]</ref> Their progress was tracked by the presence, in fact an Imperial [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]],<ref name="Marvel Star Wars 39">[[Star Wars (1977) 39|''Star Wars'' (1977) 39]]</ref> but the droid was destroyed by Captain Solo and Chewbacca, who were investigating on foot. Certain that the Empire had discovered the base, Rieekan ordered a full evacuation. Preparations were made for an Imperial ground assault, as the Rebels' [[Planetary shield/Legends|shield generator]] protected them from an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]],<ref name="ESB" /> and an ad hoc snowspeeder unit was created out of Rogue Flight, Blue Squadron, and Green Squadron; the twenty-three person strong "Rogue Group" was made up of twelve pilots and eleven gunners. Dak Ralter served as Rogue Leader Skywalker's gunner, while [[Kit Valent/Legends|Kit Valent]] joined Senesca in Rogue Two. Antilles and Janson flew as [[Rogue Three/Legends|Rogue Three]], Klivian and [[Kesin Ommis/Legends|Kesin Ommis]] as [[Rogue Four/Legends|Rogue Four]], Celchu and [[Tarn Mison]] as [[Rogue Five/Legends|Rogue Five]], [[Samoc Farr/Legends|Samoc Farr]] and [[Vigrat Pomoner]] as [[Rogue Six/Legends|Rogue Six]], [[Nala Hetsime]] and [[Cinda Tarheel/Legends|Cinda Tarheel]] as Rogue Seven, [[Vekozev Kabir]] and [[Stax Mullawny]] as [[Rogue Eight/Legends|Rogue Eight]], [[Stevan Makintay]] and [[Barlon Hightower/Legends|Barlon Hightower]] as [[Rogue Nine/Legends|Rogue Nine]], [[Tarrin Datch/Legends|Tarrin Datch]] and [[Hosh Hune]] as Rogue Ten, [[Tenk Lenso]] and [[Jek Pugilio]] as Rogue Eleven, and the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]] flying solo as [[Rogue Twelve]].<ref name="Warfare" /> Delivering [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]] to Echo Base when its shield went up, Rendar found himself piloting a snowspeeder while waiting for the chance to leave the planet.<ref name="Shadows novel" />

[[File:Luke_leads_Rogue_Squadron.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Skywalker leads Rogue Group into the Battle of Hoth.]]
The Rogues flew into the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] against the AT-AT walkers of the Empire's [[Blizzard Force/Legends|Blizzard Force]], tasked with delaying the ground assault while a groundside ion cannon aided Rebel transports in escaping the system. When the snowspeeders' laser cannons proved ineffective against the walkers' armor, Skywalker suggested tripping the AT-ATs' legs with harpoons and tow cables,<ref name="ESB" /> the final tactic of his experimental [[Rogue Doctrine]].<ref name="A Plan of Desperation">''[[The Movie Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref> An enemy laser blast killed Ralter, his gunner, but Antilles and Janson were able to take down<ref name="ESB" /> [[Blizzard 2/Legends|Blizzard 2]].<ref name="Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy 20 21">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref> Another hit on his speeder forced Skywalker into a crash landing,<ref name="ESB" /> and command of Rogue Group was given over to Antilles by both Skywalker<ref name="Rebel Strike" /> and by Rieekan.<ref name="Radio Drama" /> Other Rogues were not as lucky as their leader&mdash;Senesca, Valent, Pomoner, Kabir, Mullawny, Hune, Lenso, and Pugilio were all killed when their speeders were shot down. Farr and Datch survived being shot down, however, and Klivian and Ommis survived<ref name="Warfare" /> taking out the [[Blizzard 1/Legends|lead walker]] of the Empire's General [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Veers]] with a [[Death/Legends|suicide]] run.<ref name="ESB novel" /> Antilles and Janson abandoned their snowspeeder after taking a hit and losing their starboard [[Stabilizer/Legends|stabilizer]].<ref name="Running the Gauntlet">{{WEGCite|story=Running the Gauntlet|book=Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back|reprint=1}}</ref>

Following his crash, Skywalker ascended a [[magnetic grapple]] and cut into the AT-AT [[Blizzard 4/Legends|Blizzard 4]] with [[Anakin Skywalker's second lightsaber/Legends|his lightsaber]]. A lobbed [[Concussion grenade/Legends|concussion grenade]] knocked the walker down,<ref name="Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy 20 21" /> and another walker was destroyed by Rendar in Rogue Twelve.<ref name="Warfare" /> Blizzard Force was ultimately successful in their mission to destroy the shield generator,<ref name="ESB" /> and the surviving Rogues took to the skies in starfighters to protect fleeing Rebel transports. When Antilles found a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] blocking the escape lane of a [[Thon's Orchard/Legends|transport]] being piloted by Datch, he took his X-wing in close behind Klivian and Janson's Y-wing. He then pulled away in a [[Tallon split]], confusing the warship's targeting batteries and giving himself enough time to destroy one of its sensor globes. Datch's ship made it to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]<ref name="Running the Gauntlet" />&mdash;thirteen of thirty Rebel transports escaped in all, with the other seventeen destroyed or captured by the Empire.<ref name="Warfare" /> Antilles was promoted to commander to fill the gap left by the loss of Renegade Flight,<ref name="Galaxy Guide 3 2nd Edition" /> and he assumed command of the Rogues<ref name="NEGTC" /> while Skywalker traveled to the planet [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] to [[Jedi training/Legends|train]] as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] under the mysterious [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]].<ref name="ESB" />

====A complete squadron====
{{Quote|Wedge Antilles and Rogue Squadron are with the fleet&hellip; they can provide all the backup we need!|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Shadows comic 1">[[Shadows of the Empire 1|''Shadows of the Empire'' 1]]</ref>}}
The loss of so many Rogues at Hoth was felt heavily by the survivors, and a plaque to the fallen Rogues and Renegades was hung on the command deck of the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Rebel frigate]] [[Chancellor (frigate)|''Chancellor'']]. Antilles expanded the Rogues into a full squadron: Rogue Squadron. Although they were an escort squadron for the main Alliance Fleet,<ref name="Galaxy Guide 3 2nd Edition" /> Skywalker designed them to be a unit without a set mission profile, able to take on any mission that came their way.<ref name="CSWE Rogue Squadron" /> Stationed aboard the [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Star Cruiser]] [[Home One/Legends|''Home One'']], the Rogues acted as a rapid response team that could transfer to hot spots as needed. The squadron was composed of the Alliance's twelve best pilots who had survived its fiercest battles against the Empire, and its pilots were famed for their ability to fly nearly anything. Antilles led the Rogues, but Skywalker sometimes still served with them, taking the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of Rogue Leader while Antilles flew as Rogue One. Other squadron members included Rogue Two [[Will Scotian/Legends|Will Scotian]], whom Antilles recruited due to his fine combat record at [[Oracle Base]]; Rogue Five [[Dix Rivan]], who acted as the Rogues' rear guard; and Wes Janson as Rogue Six.<ref name="Shadows Sourcebook">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> Barlon Hightower also formally joined Rogue Squadron at some point following the evacuation.<ref name="CSWE Hightower">{{CSWECite|II|41|Hightower, Lieutenant Barlon}}</ref>

After Hoth, the Alliance Fleet [[Haven (rendezvous point)|rendezvoused]] outside the [[Galactic Rim/Legends|rim]] of the inhabited galaxy. Skywalker was a latecomer<ref name="Tales of the Golden Droid">''[[C-3PO: Tales of the Golden Droid]]''</ref> following his Jedi training and a [[Duel on Cloud City/Legends|duel with]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin's]] [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]],<ref name="ESB" /> and several [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] after his arrival an [[Unidentified Strike-class medium cruiser|Imperial strike cruiser]] appeared.<ref name="Tales of the Golden Droid" /> Rogue Squadron moved to intercept in an effort to keep the [[Strike-class medium cruiser|cruiser]] from escaping and revealing the Rebel fleet's location. They destroyed several TIE fighters, with only Rogue Three taking damage to his [[Engine/Legends|engines]], and the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] diverted power to its rear shields while attempting a getaway. Rivan swooped in and fired on the cruiser's front side, however, blowing it to pieces. Rebel [[Jammer/Legends|jamming]] had prevented the enemy vessel from transmitting its coordinates, and the fleet's location remained safe, but the Alliance altered course as a precaution anyway<ref name="Shadows comic 1" /> and remained on the move over the next few months.<ref name="Tales of the Golden Droid" />

[[File:Shirainfiltratesroguesquadron.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Imperial spy Shira Brie infiltrated Rogue Squadron after the Battle of Hoth.]]
Antilles led the Rogues in [[Battle near the Maw|dangerous missions]] to rescue [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] from an [[Maw Imperial Prison|Imperial installation]] at [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]]. [[Karie Neth/Legends|Karie Neth]] was one of the prisoners,<ref name="Rogue Squadron II" /> and she joined Rogue Squadron as a replacement for a [[Unidentified Bothan pilot|Bothan pilot]] who had been lost during a secret mission.<ref name="Death Star II Limited Karie Neth">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Karie Neth}}</ref> [[Keir Santage/Legends|Keir Santage]] was another rescued prisoner who joined the Rogues;<ref name="Death Star II Limited Keir Santage">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Keir Santage}}</ref> [[Kin Kian (Human)|Kin Kian]]<ref name="Death Star II Limited Kin Kian">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Kin Kian}}</ref> and [[Gemmer Sojan/Legends|Gemmer Sojan]] were also members of the squadron around that time.<ref name="Warfare" /> The Rogues next rescued prisoners [[Raid at Bakura|from]] a [[Bakura Imperial Prison|prison]] orbiting [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]], but several scientist prisoners were taken by the Empire from Bakura to [[Geonosis]], where the squadron [[Battle of Geonosis (Galactic Civil War)|encountered]] former Rogue Sarkli. Antilles shot down the defector's [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]], but Sarkli survived the crash and swore revenge. The squadron then joined a task force under Rebel General Crix Madine and were sent to [[Destrillion]] to [[Mission to Destrillion|destroy]] an Imperial tibanna gas facility, but no such facility was found. After taking out [[TIE/hu "Hunter" Multi-Role Starfighter|Tie Hunters]], the task force passed by neighboring [[Dubrillion/Legends|Dubrillion]] while preparing to leave the [[Dubrillion system/Legends|system]], and the Empire sprung their trap with a [[Dubrillion superlaser facility|superlaser facility]] that sat on Dubrillion's surface. In the [[Battle of Dubrillion (Galactic Civil War)|ensuing battle]], Antilles commandeered an Imperial AT-ST and personally took out the [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] facility. Later on, the Rogues led a [[Fondor shipyard assault]] and destroyed a [[Unidentified Executor-class Star Dreadnought|prototype Super Star Destroyer]].<ref name="Rebel Strike" />

At some point in the first half of 3 ABY,<ref name="NEC" /> young Rebel [[Lumiya|Shira Brie]] was drafted into Rogue Squadron and flew with Skywalker on a mission to Cloud City.<ref name="Fact File 111 Shira">{{FactFile|111|BRI 1-2|Shira Brie}}</ref> Former [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] of the city and fellow Rebel [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] had been sent there from the Alliance's [[Haven Base]] on the world of [[Arbra/Legends|Arbra]], and when he failed to report in, Skywalker and Brie decided to investigate.<ref name="Coffin in the Clouds">[[Star Wars (1977) 56|''Star Wars'' (1977) 56]]</ref> When they landed in an empty city, R2-D2 [[Slicer/Legends|sliced]] into the central [[Computer/Legends|computer]] and learned that the population had been evacuated after a number of bombs had been planted. A [[Lightfight|firefight]] with arriving Imperial stormtroopers quickly ensued, but the arrival of Calrissian, his [[Aide/Legends|aide]] [[Lobot/Legends|Lobot]], and a group of [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]] brought the [[Ugnaught rebellion|confrontation]] to a standstill. Lobot was prepared to detonate the planted bombs until Imperial Captain [[Hugo Treece]] shot him, so Skywalker used the Force to blow the bomb's primers and trick the Imperials into fleeing from Cloud City.<ref name="Hello Bespin Goodbye">[[Star Wars (1977) 57|''Star Wars'' (1977) 57]]</ref> Not long afterward, intelligence reported the Empire was building a [[secret armada]]<ref name="Shira's Story">[[Star Wars (1977) 60|''Star Wars'' (1977) 60]]</ref> that was transporting to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] a [[Teezl]], a strange creature capable of naturally amplifying hyperspace communications.<ref name="Sanctuary in the Storm">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030626arbra4|series=Arbra: Sanctuary In the Storm|text=Part 4: Rebels in Disguise}}</ref> After Rebel pilots [[Operation Earplug|acquired]] four stolen TIE fighters and [[Skirmish on Spindrift|obtained]] the armada's coordinates,<ref name="Shira's Story" /> four members of Rogue Squadron<ref name="NEGTC" />&mdash;Skywalker, Brie, [[Hanc Thorben]], and [[Alph (Rogue)|Alph]]&mdash;made their way to the armada.<ref name="Screams in the Void">[[Star Wars (1977) 61|''Star Wars'' (1977) 61]]</ref>

The Rogues' TIEs were modified to fire just six standard-strength laser bursts before releasing powerful shots that would cut through even the strongest shields, and also included [[signal transceiver]]s so the Rogues could recognize one another.<ref name="Screams in the Void" /> Dubbed [[Flying Bantha Squadron]],<ref name="Sanctuary in the Storm" /> they gained entrance to the armada with stolen Imperial codes and each attacked a Star [[Destroyer/Legends|Destroyer]]. Imperial pilots were unable to tell friend from foe and destroyed several of their own before managing to take out Alph's fighter and kill the Rogue. Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mils Giel]] responded by using the teezl to interfere with local [[Comm unit/Legends|comm]] frequencies, thus nullifying the Rogues' signal transceivers, and Skywalker instead relied on the wisdom of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to judge which TIEs were friendly. Thorben retreated from the battle when one of his fighter's solar arrays was hit, after which Skywalker used his last regular shot to destroy an unfriendly TIE. The [[Delta Leader/Legends|squadron leader's]] ultra burst then took out the teezl and much of Admiral Giel's [[Helmsman (battlecruiser)|flagship]], but his return to Haven Base was not welcomed with open arms. In a briefing room he was shocked to discover, via a [[holograph]]ic recording from a [[Camera/Legends|camera]] on Thorben's TIE, that the final TIE he had destroyed had been Shira Brie's.<ref name="Screams in the Void" /> Facing severe backlash for killing a fellow Rogue,<ref name="Fact File 111 Shira" /> and with his faith in the Force severely shaken, Skywalker resigned his [[Officer/Legends|officer's]] commission and left Arbra.<ref name="Pariah">[[Star Wars (1977) 62|''Star Wars'' (1977) 62]]</ref> He soon discovered that the Force was indeed his ally: Brie had been an Imperial spy,<ref name="The Mind Spider">[[Star Wars (1977) 63|''Star Wars'' (1977) 63]]</ref> tasked with alienating Skywalker from the Alliance and delivering him into the hands of Darth Vader.<ref name="Fact File 111 Shira" />

====The road to Endor====
{{Quote|Wedge is in command of Rogue Squadron now, and he told me if I ever needed them they'd come running.|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Shadows novel" />}}
[[File:Roguevsnemesis.png|thumb|left|250px|A Rogue pilot in a Z-95 Headhunter goes up against the Star Destroyer ''Nemesis'' near Gelgelar.]]
At some point in the year after Hoth, Rogue Squadron teamed with Gold Squadron to [[Evacuation of Gelgelar|defend the evacuation]] of the Rebel [[Medcenter/Legends|hospital]] ''[[Hormuuz]]'' in the [[Gelgelar system/Legends|Gelgelar system]], which marked the Rebellion's beachhead in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]]. The hospital was under attack by Admiral [[Wooyou Senn]]'s [[Task Force Vengeance/Legends|Task Force ''Vengeance'']]. After the battle, while the wounded were being transferred to the [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigate]] [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']], the Rogues and Golds flew [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Headhunters]] to [[Skirmish near Gelgelar|cover]] the Rebel fleet's escape from the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Nemesis (Task Force Vengeance)|Nemesis]]. After being forced to retreat from the sector, the Rogues went on to participate in the Rebel [[Spreading the Rebellion|campaign]] to expand Alliance activities into the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]], piloting various starfighters and serving in a number of disparate mission profiles, including fighter interception and anti-[[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] striking. The first was [[Battle of Halbara/Legends|another defense]], this time of a Rebel convoy in the [[Halbara system/Legends|Halbara system]], and the Rogues next worked with Green Squadron and several capital ships to [[Attack on the Gelgelar system|steal]] supplies from the captured ''Hormuuz''.<ref name="Balance of Power">[[Star_Wars:_X-Wing_vs._TIE_Fighter#Expansion_pack|''Star Wars: X-Wing vs. Tie Fighter: Balance of Power'']]</ref>

Flying A-wings to the [[Almaran system]] to [[Mission to Almaran|gauge the strength]] of Task Force ''Vengeance'', the Rogues identified the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Vengeance (Executor-class)/Legends|''Vengeance'']] as Senn's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]]. They then supported the Alliance's [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Star Cruiser]] [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']] in the [[Goff system/Legends|Goff system]], where a Rebel trap [[Ambush in the Goff system|destroyed]] two of the Task Force's Star Destroyers. The campaign against Admiral Senn also saw Rogue Squadron hold off an Imperial counterattack in the [[Battle of Swellen]] while the Alliance captured the [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]] ''[[Compellor/Legends|Compellor]]'', [[First attack on the Peregrine|guard]] the ''Compellor'' as it arrived at [[Mobetta system/Legends|Mobetta]] and then [[Second attack on the Peregrine|hold off]] a second Imperial assault, [[Ambush in the Derilyn system|ambush]] an Imperial fleet that had been sent to reinforce Task Force ''Vengeance'', and [[Retreat from Gallofree|defend]] the [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility|X7 factory]] ''[[Gallofree]]'' from the Empire at Mobetta. Although the Rogues covered the retreat of the [[Airam (group)|Airam rebels]], the ''Compellor'' was lost. Rogue Squadron's next engagement was [[Mission to Kuras Drift|beating back]] an Imperial attack while the grateful Airam rebels were supplying the Alliance with [[Warhead/Legends|warheads]]. They then [[Battle of Aiqin 4|captured]] the Airam leader [[Ilay]], who was attempting to negotiate with Senn, and later [[Battle of Dega|destroyed]] Imperial supply freighters at [[Dega]]. A weakened Senn took his task force to the [[Nocto system/Legends|Nocto system]] to attack the Alliance, but the Rebels destroyed both the ''Vengeance'' and the [[Rage (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Rage'']], finally killing and defeating Senn.<ref name="Balance of Power" />

Captain Solo, meanwhile, had been [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|frozen]] in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] and taken by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] just before Skywalker's confrontation with Vader at Cloud City.<ref name="ESB" /> Six months into 3 ABY,<ref name="NEC" /> Fett's location was pinpointed on the moon [[Gall/Legends|Gall]] by a group of Solo's close friends: Skywalker, Organa, Calrissian, Chewbacca, R2-D2 and C-3PO. Given Solo's importance to the Alliance, his friends planned a rescue operation, and asked Antilles and the Rogues to participate. The squadron accordingly set up a [[Rebel base (Kile)|temporary base]] on [[Kile]], a moon of [[Zhar/Legends|Zhar]], and did some flybys of the [[Cadavine Sector Fleet Imperial Enclave|Imperial Enclave]] on Gall, which was also a moon of Zhar. Solo's group of friends soon rendezvoused with them at the base, as did Dash Rendar, who had been hired by Calrissian to lead them to Fett. After Antilles briefed the new arrivals, Skywalker devised a plan: He and the Rogues would distract the Imperial ships while Rendar led Calrissian to where Fett's [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']] was docked at the [[Imperial Enclave|enclave]].<ref name="Shadows novel" />

[[File:Battleovercoruscant.jpg|thumb|right|325px|Rogue Squadron escapes Coruscant through the wreckage of Prince Xizor's skyhook.]]
Skywalker flew into the [[Battle of Gall]] as Rogue Leader with Antilles as Rogue One. The young Jedi switched off his [[Targeting sensor/Legends|targeting sensor]] and allowed the Force to guide him, and the result was a large amount of TIE fighter scrap metal. Scotian was forced to retreat from the battle after taking a nasty hit to his fighter, and Rivan was killed by enemy lasers, but the Rogues managed to keep a massive [[Unidentified Imperial II-class Star Destroyer (Gall, dayside)|Star Destroyer]] from targeting them by drifting the engagement back and forth through space. When [[Unidentified Imperial II-class Star Destroyer (Gall, nightside)|another Destroyer]] came in from the moon's nightside, the Rogues made a final pass at the first warship before breaking away from the fight, hoping that they had bought the others enough time. Before he could jump to lightspeed, however, Skywalker found himself targeted by the guns of Janson's X-wing&mdash;the Rogue's [[Unidentified R2 unit (Wes Janson)|Artoo unit]] had taken control of his starfighter. Skywalker only survived the surprise due to a warning from the Force, and after maneuvering a pursuing TIE fighter into Janson's line of fire, he was able to take out Janson's engines and laser cannons.<ref name="Shadows novel" />

Janson's craft was towed back to base, where his droid was fitted with a [[Restraining bolt/Legends|restraining bolt]]. R2-D2 plugged into the rogue robot and discovered some grim news: it had been [[Programmer/Legends|programmed]] by someone to target Skywalker. That someone was Rogue Squadron's [[Crew chief/Legends|crew chief]],<ref name="Shadows novel" /> [[Viera Cheran]], who had been paid 10,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] Skywalker.<ref name="Shadows Sourcebook" /> She quickly destroyed the Artoo unit, and Antilles shot her in the chest when she turned her [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] on him and Skywalker. Meanwhile, Organa and the others returned to base empty-handed, as Fett had gotten away.<ref name="Shadows novel" /> The Rogues were next assigned to cover a meeting over the planet [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] between the ''Redemption'' and the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Razor (CR90 corvette)|''Razor'']], but the Rogues arrived with the ''Redemption'' to find the ''Razor'' [[Battle of Kothlis|under attack]]. When Antilles disabled the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Motivator (Imperial-class)|''Motivator'']], it crashed to Kothlis's surface, necessitating a commando mission to retrieve the data that had been stolen from the ''Razor''. The data was quite alarming to the Alliance: The Empire was constructing a [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]].<ref name="Rogue Squadron II" />

While with the Alliance Fleet, the Rogues received word from Dash Rendar that Skywalker, Organa, Calrissian, and Chewbacca were on the surface of Coruscant and would need assistance. Although Antilles did not trust the smuggler, he knew that his friends would be there, and brought his squadron to the outermost fringes of the [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant system]] to await for a signal; when he received a message from [[LE-BO2D9/Legends|Leebo]],<ref name="Let's Go">{{WEGCite|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook|story=Let's Go!}}</ref> he took the Rogues into the middle of a [[Battle over Coruscant|space battle]] to lend aid to the harrowed ''Millennium Falcon'' and to Rendar's [[Outrider/Legends|''Outrider'']]. Their opponents were [[StarViper-class_attack_platform/Legends|StarVipers]], fighters belonging to the criminal syndicate [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], who outnumbered them badly. However, Darth Vader arrived in the [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] to destroy his foe&mdash;Black Sun's [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]]&mdash;and the destruction of [[Falleen's Fist|Xizor's Skyhook]] opened an escape corridor for the Rebels, who quickly fled the system.<ref name="Shadows novel" /> 

Plans were put into place for a Rebel assault on the second Death Star, and the Rogues helped [[Mission to Zhar|cover]] the retrieval of the stolen Imperial ''Lambda''-class shuttle [[Tydirium/Legends|''Tydirium'']] from the [[Zhar system]] to the Alliance's ''Liberty''.<ref name="X-Wing Alliance">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref> The Rogues also [[Raid on Bespin|raided]] Imperial-held Cloud City for valuable tibanna gas.<ref name="Rogue Squadron II" />

====Endor and aftermath====
{{Quote|&hellip; if you are selected for this duty, you will be part of a storied tradition. Rogue Squadron is tasked with the most dangerous assignments, the missions that only a nimble and highly trained squad can handle&hellip;|Admiral Ackbar, addressing Rogue Squadron candidates|<ref name="Rogue Leader 3">[[X-Wing: Rogue Leader 3|''X-Wing: Rogue Leader'' 3]]</ref>}}
[[File:Insider221-Subscribercover-cropped.png|thumb|left|275px|The X-wings of Red Squadron follow the ''Millennium Falcon'' into the second Death Star.]]
In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the Alliance Fleet gathered near the planet Sullust and prepared to strike at the Empire's unfinished Death Star II battlestation, which sat in orbit of the moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="Return of the Jedi">{{Film|VI}}</ref> Rogue Squadron was directly attached to Admiral [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar's]] ''Home One'', the flagship of the entire fleet, but Antilles temporarily renamed the Rogues "Red Squadron" in honor of the original Red Squadron from the Battle of Yavin.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi Second Edition 41">[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi'', Second Edition]],</ref> Many top X-wing pilots had recently transferred to the new A-wing fighters,<ref name="Green Squadron Pilot CCG">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Green Squadron Pilot}}</ref> and the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] saw the Rogues divided among a number of ad hoc squadrons,<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> with Rogue veterans such as Gemmer Sojan<ref name="Warfare" /> and Tycho Celchu flying A-wings in Green Squadron<ref name="Tycho CCG">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Tycho Celchu}}</ref> and both Karie Neth<ref name="Death Star II Limited Karie Neth" /> and Kin Kian serving as gunners in [[Gray Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gray Squadron]].<ref name="Death Star II Limited Kin Kian" /> Antilles was allowed the opportunity to equip the Rogues with newer A-wings and B-wings, but he personally elected to stay in his X-wing.<ref name="CSWE Wedge" /> Red Squadron also included a [[Red Two (Battle of Endor)|Human male]] in a Y-wing as Red Two, [[Sila Kott/Legends|Sila Kott]] in an A-wing as Red Three,<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> Derek Klivian as Red Four,<ref name="Red Four CCG">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Red Squadron 4}}</ref> [[Grizz Frix/Legends|Grizz Frix]] as Red Five,<ref name="Hasbro Frix">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Shadows of the Dark Side|pack=(Toys R Us Exclusive) Battle Over Endor (2 of 2)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/tvcexbattleoverendor2.asp}}</ref> Keir Santage as Red Seven,<ref name="Red Seven CCG">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Red Squadron 7}}</ref> [[Randi]], [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]],<ref name="The Briefing of Red Group">{{WEGCite|story=The Briefing of Red Group|book=Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi|reprint=1}}</ref> [[Kirst (pilot)|Kirst]],<ref name="CSWE Kirst">{{CSWECite|II|220|Kirst}}</ref> and [[Wister]].<ref name="CSWE Wister">{{CSWECite|III|332|Wister}}</ref>

Before the battle, Antilles gathered Red Squadron into a briefing room and told them the plan of attack: Rebel starfighters would enter the Death Star's superstructure and fire on its [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]].<ref name="The Briefing of Red Group" /> A [[Endor strike team/Legends|strike team]] on the moon's surface would disable the [[SLD-26 planetary shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] that protected the Death Star before the Alliance Fleet arrived in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]], but upon their arrival, the fleet found that the shield was still up. What they thought was going to be a surprise attack was countered by a massive force of Imperial starfighters,<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> and although several Alliance squadrons were devastated by the [[Space warfare/Legends|onslaught]], Red Squadron remained mostly intact and [[Starfighter combat/Legends|racked up]] a large number of kills.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi Second Edition 41" /> Kott was killed by a [[TIE pilot]], however.<ref name="Return of the Jedi" />

The Death Star joined in the battle, firing its superlaser at Rebel capital ships, forcing the Alliance Fleet to attack Imperial Star Destroyers at point-blank range so as to avoid the battlestation's destructive power. Grizz Frix perished during the daring attacks. When the strike team finally destroyed the [[Endor shield generator bunker|shield generator]], Antilles, Santage, and several other pilots entered the unfinished Death Star. Santage was killed, but Antilles and [[Gold Leader/Legends|Gold Leader]] Lando Calrissian knocked out the reactor core, which started a chain reaction that destroyed the entire station. The [[Standard day/Legends|day]] was won, and [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was one of the Imperial casualties.<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> The Imperial [[Navy/Legends|Navy]] fought on for nearly four more hours before finally retreating.<ref name="TAB Sourcebook">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref>

The victory was costly for the Alliance, including a starfighter casualty rate of more than twenty percent, itself almost matched by shipboard casualties. Nearly three quarters of all surviving vessels required extensive repairs, and Ackbar ordered immediate repair and salvage operations.<ref name="TAB Sourcebook" /> A quickly-put-back-together Rogue Squadron<ref name="Atlas" /> aided with cleanup operations,<ref name="CSWE Kirst" /> and they were sent to help reestablish a sensor perimeter after the Rebels' [[sensor net]] was destroyed by the intruding Imperial [[Patrol ship/Legends|system patrol craft]] ''[[Daggerblade]]''.<ref name="TAB Sourcebook" /> One day after the Death Star's destruction, Antilles intercepted an Imperial [[message drone]] while flying patrol duty and accidentally set off its [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct cycle]]. He was rescued by Luke Skywalker, who flew under the Rogue Leader call sign and was able to disarm the explosives. The drone's message, intended for Imperial reception, revealed that an alien invasion force was attacking the planet Bakura, and the Alliance immediately dispatched assistance to the besieged world. The Rebel task force included Rogue Squadron.<ref name="Truce">''[[The Truce at Bakura]]''</ref>

The Rogues and the entire Alliance Task force [[Invasion of Bakura|engaged]] the strange [[Ssi-ruu]]k aliens upon their arrival at Bakura, with Antilles flying once again as Rogue Leader. At one point, all of Rogue Squadron were surrounded by enemy [[Swarm-class battle droid|fighters]], and were only able to escape when Skywalker&mdash;commanding from the [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]] ''[[Flurry]]''&mdash;used the Force to [[Mind trick/Legends|convince]] one Ssi-ruuvi pilot to ram into a squadron mate. After the Alliance's Red Squadron destroyed an enemy cruiser, the [[Ssi-ruuvi Fleet]] retreated into hyperspace. The Alliance ships then joined an Imperial orbital defense web while a team of Rebel diplomats went planetside.<ref name="Truce" />

[[File:NewRogues-XWRL3.jpg|thumb|right|310px|New Rogues being selected shortly after the Battle of Endor]]
The combined forces of the Rebels and Imperials were able to repel the [[Bakura Incident|next attack]] launched by the [[Ssi-ruuvi Imperium]], but the Alliance's success was quickly followed by an Imperial double cross. The Rogues protected Skywalker, who had commandeered the [[Shree-class battle cruiser|''Shree''-class battle cruiser]] [[Sibwarra|''Shriwirr'']] from the Ssi-ruuk, from the Empire's forces while Skywalker convinced Imperial Commander [[Pter Thanas]] to surrender.<ref name="Truce" /> The Rogues racked up a large number of kills against both Imperial and Si-ruuvi foes during the incident.<ref name="TAB Sourcebook" /> Back at Endor, Antilles and two other Rogues&mdash;Kirst and Wister&mdash;came upon several TIE fighters that remained in the Endor [[Star system/Legends|system]] while flying a cleanup operation. The resulting chase led them to the remains of the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] ''Executor'',<ref name="A Day in the Life">{{Tales|12|A Day in the Life}}</ref> downed during the Battle of Endor,<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> which took out Wister's fighter with its still-operational turbolasers. Antilles and Kirst were able to finish off the massive ship by using proton torpedoes to cause an avalanche, but Kirst was deeply impacted by Wister's death.<ref name="A Day in the Life" />

Seven days after the Battle of Endor, several of the Rogues were performing salvage duty and other cleanup at the Alliance's [[Endor Station]]. Other Rebel squadrons were out in the galaxy, assessing the [[Politics/Legends|political]] situations in major sectors, and Skywalker&mdash;once again acting as Rogue Leader&mdash; gathered several members of his squadron together for a mission to Corellia. One [[Standard week/Legends|week]] later, he had arrived in the planet's capital, Coronet City, along with Antilles, Celchu, Janson, and [[Blue Leader/Legends|Blue Leader]] [[Ten Numb/Legends|Ten Numb]]. Although two sweeps of the entire [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] had failed to detect any Imperial presence, the group was quickly [[Raid at Coronet|targeted]] by Imperial [[Sniper/Legends|snipers]] while in a [[Unidentified cantina (Coronet City)|Coronet cantina]]. [[Scout trooper/Legends|Biker scouts]] and AT-STs soon followed,<ref name="Rogue Leader 1">[[X-Wing: Rogue Leader 1|''X-Wing: Rogue Leader'' 1]]</ref> but the Rogues were able to send their attackers into retreat. They learned from a [[Weir's aide|captured officer]] that Coronet had been struck in order to send a message: the Empire still lived.<ref name="Rogue Leader 2">[[X-Wing: Rogue Leader 2|''X-Wing: Rogue Leader'' 2]]</ref>

Ten Numb was captured while pursuing the fleeing Imperials, and when the Rogues followed his [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] into space in their [[Snubfighter/Legends|snubfighters]], they were intercepted by TIE fighters. In fact suicide [[Drone/Legends|drones]], the TIEs all detonated, and the Rogues narrowly avoided the deadly explosions. Numb's signal was lost during combat with three remaining TIE drones, but R2-D2 was able to extrapolate his destination from his last signal.<ref name="Rogue Leader 2" /> The Rogues [[Mission to Tralus|followed]] Numb's captors to neighboring [[Tralus/Legends|Tralus]], where they learned that the Imperial General [[Weir/Legends|Weir]] had set up [[Weir's base|base]] in the underground [[Selonian Tunnels]]. Locating it with the aid of [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]], they held off Weir's stormtroopers largely thanks to [[Luke Skywalker's green lightsaber/Legends|Skywalker's lightsaber]].<ref name="Rogue Leader 3" />

[[File:SecondBattleofEndor-SW100.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Rogues and the ''Cobra'' defend Endor from the Nagai.]]
Antilles and Celchu commandeered TIEs to chase a fleeing Weir, taking out enemy pursuit and ultimately downing their target.
