Although Numb had been [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] to death, Weir was placed in Rebel custody and the Rogues returned to the Alliance fleet. Several days later, Skywalker gave permanent command of the Rogues to Antilles so that he could focus on rebuilding the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and the new Rogue Leader was surprised to find that a large number of pilots had volunteered to fly with Rogue Squadron.<ref name="Rogue Leader 3" /> By this point in time, the Rebel Alliance had transitioned into the Alliance of Free Planets, an interim government that was intended to be a stepping stone en route to establishing a New Republic.<ref name="TAB Sourcebook" /> About two weeks after Endor, Rogue Squadron were flying in a dark night sky when Antilles's X-wing was clipped by a TIE fighter. The rest of the Rogues cleaned up the TIE complement they were [[Skirmish above a luminous lake|facing]], but the Rogue Leader lost his instruments and engines and was forced to put down in a lake full of luminous [[Fish/Legends|fish]] to wait for rescue.<ref name="Lucky">{{Tales|23|Lucky (comic story)}}</ref>

A temporary Rogue Squadron was called into action for the Alliance of Free Planets<ref name="The Forgotten War" /> nearly a month after Endor<ref name="Endor and the Moddell Sector">{{GamerCite|9|Endor and the Moddell Sector}}</ref> when their Endor base was [[Second Battle of Endor|attacked]] by the [[Nagai expeditionary force]]. Antilles led the Rogues as they flew alongside Calrissian in his modified [[Mu-2 long range shuttle]] ''[[Cobra]]'',<ref name="The Forgotten War" /> Chewbacca and [[Nien Nunb/Legends|Nien Nunb]] in the ''Millennium Falcon'',<ref name="Marvel Star Wars 100">[[Star Wars (1977) 100|''Star Wars'' (1977) 100]]</ref> and a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Resurrector Squadron]] of [[Cabur-class starfighter]]s commanded by the [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protector]] [[Fenn Shysa]]. Led by Shira Brie, now known as the the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lady]] Lumiya, the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] pilots seemed to anticipate the allied fleet's every move and quickly overwhelmed them,<ref name="The Forgotten War" /> dealing massive losses to Shysa's squadron. Admiral Ackbar soon informed his space forces that a [[Bey|traitor]] in the Alliance's midst had transmitted all of their flight plans to the enemy, and that their only chance was to formulate a new strategy on the fly. Calrissian hurriedly told Antilles to start winging it and to order all ships to lock directly into both of their computers. As the allied forces began to follow the two's suddenly erratic flight paths, their unpredictable movements masked each other and allowed them to easily pick off their opponents, and Lumiya fled the system.<ref name="Marvel Star Wars 100" />

===New Republic heroes===
====The Empire lives====
{{Quote|Hey, Wedge&mdash;where'd all the gnurled bandits come from?''"<br />"''Ask me later, Janson. I thought this was going to be a milk run, too.|Wes Janson and Wedge Antilles battle TIE fighters on Rogue Squadron's first mission for the New Republic|<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 1" />}}
A few weeks after the Death Star's destruction,<ref name="X-Wing Omnibus 2">''[[Star Wars Omnibus: X-Wing Rogue Squadron Volume 2]]''</ref> Rogue Squadron [[Battle of Tandankin|struck]] at [[Tandankin]], a planet recently seized by the Empire's [[Grand Moff]] [[Nigel Nivers|Nivers]]. Flying as Red Leader, Antilles had his squadron target an AT-AT, but a lone stormtrooper with a [[Blaster rifle|big gun]] was able to disable the craft of [[Red Seven (Tandankin)|Red Seven]]. The downed pilot discovered a landing strip filled with dozens of TIE fighters, which Antilles neutralized by shooting down a nearby [[Tandankin monument|tower]]. Nivers was captured, and it took Skywalker regaling the world's citizens with tales of Antilles's heroics through the years to placate their anger over the destruction of what turned out to be an important monument.<ref name="Rogue Squadron Special">''[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron Special]]''</ref> The mission was Skywalker's last with Rogue Squadron, as he afterward made his resignation official.<ref name="NEGTC" /> The New Republic was officially [[Declaration of a New Republic/Legends|declared]] one month after the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] death,<ref name="HTTE Sourcebook">''[[Heir to the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> and Antilles engineered a demotion for himself from commander down to captain, in order to remain Rogue Leader in the face of New Republic pressure to move up to [[Fleet Command (New Republic)/Legends|fleet command]].<ref name="NEGTC" /> Celchu became the squadron's second in command,<ref name="X-Wing Handbook" /> and Skywalker continued to command naval units for a government that was unwilling to give up his military skills, later being promoted to general.<ref name="NEGTC" />

With its new roster, the Rogues undertook their first [[Mission to Cilpar|mission]] with a lean team of six: Antilles, Janson, Klivian, Celchu, [[Isplourrdacartha Estillo|Plourr Ilo]] and [[Dllr Nep]].<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 1" /> Around one month after the Death Star's destruction,<ref name="X-Wing Omnibus 1">''[[Star Wars Omnibus: X-Wing Rogue Squadron Volume 1]]''</ref> the Rogues were on [[Cilpar]]<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 1" /> to pick up supplies from the [[Cilpari Resistance]]<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 2">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 2|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 2]]</ref> and escort a food convoy to [[Mrlsst/Legends|Mrlsst]].<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 1" /> Their contact, codenamed Targeter, failed to show up for two weeks,<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 2" /> and they found themselves dogfighting Imperial TIE fighters. Although they won the day, Janson's X-wing crashed into the [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]], and he was retrieved by Celchu. The other four Rogues were soon captured by [[Elscol Loro]] and the distrustful Cilpari Resistance,<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 1" /> but the two groups eventually united against Moff [[Boren Tascl]], a common enemy. Janson and Celchu meanwhile rendezvoused with Targeter, whose real name was [[Winter Celchu|Winter]], and who was unsure of the extent of the Moff's resources. Owing to Janson's broken leg, she sent Celchu to infiltrate the local [[Imperial garrison (Cilpar)|Imperial base]].<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 2" />

[[File:Roguesmeetmirax-XWRS5.jpg|thumb|right|375px|Wedge Antilles introduces the Rogues to Mirax Terrik on Mrlsst.]]
Celchu presented himself as a TIE pilot to the Empire's [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Grode]]<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 2" /> and flew a TIE fighter in a search and destroy mission against the Rogues, where he covertly contacted his Artoo unit and instructed it to alert Antilles of his squadron's approach.<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 3">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 3|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 3]]</ref> By chance, Winter was on-[[Rogue Squadron Base|base]] and inside the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] of Celchu's X-wing when it suddenly took off, but she was able to override the droid just in time<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 4">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 4|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 4]]</ref> to shoot down what enemy craft Loro and the Rogues had missed, including Celchu's TIE.<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 3" /> He managed to [[Ejector seat/Legends|eject]] in time and and return to the Imperial base, and in the next skirmish, he flew a new TIE but blasted his Imperial squadron mates, helping his fellow Rogues clean up Tascl's forces while Loro stormed the Moff's palace.<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 4" /> Loro became the squadron's newest member, and she flew with them to Mrlsst<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 5">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 5|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 5]]</ref> two months after Endor<ref name="X-Wing Omnibus 1" /> to protect the food convoy. Above the planet, the Rogues were [[Mission to Mrlsst|ambushed]] by an [[Interdictor-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Interdictor''-class Star Destroyer]] and its TIEs, but proton torpedoes fired by Loro and Antilles took out the Destroyer and allowed the convoy to land.<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 5" />

On Mrlsst's surface, the Rogues met the young student [[Koyi Komad]]<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 6">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 6|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 6]]</ref> and ran into Antilles's old friend [[Mirax Terrik Horn|Mirax Terrik]],<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 5" /> as well as his old enemy, Imperial officer [[Loka Hask]].<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 6" /> They also came across the [[Ante-Endor Association]], a group claiming the Battle of Endor had never happened, and when Celchu confronted them he ended up brawling in the street.<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 5" /> Representing the New Republic, Antilles found himself bidding against Hask for a [[Phantom Project|Phantom Ship Project]] developed by the [[Mrlsst Trade and Science Academy|Mrlsst Academy]]. Accusations against the Rogues of stealing the project's [[Datacard/Legends|datacards]] led to Antilles being arrested, however,<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 6" /> and only a warning from Koyi Komad saved the rest of the squadron from the same fate. Terrik and Nep tracked down [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Rorax Falken]], who revealed that the Phantom Ship Project had been made up in order to milk the Empire for credits, while the other Rogues stormed Hask's base to rescue Antilles, with Janson's charge being made from a hospital [[Sleeper (furniture)|bed]].<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 7">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 7|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 7]]</ref> When Hask's Interdictor, the [[Dominator (Interdictor-class)|''Dominator'']], appeared in space, Terrik and Nep boarded her [[Baudo-class star yacht|yacht]], the ''[[Pulsar Skate]]'', and informed Antilles that they had found a [[gravitic polarization beam]] in [[Falken's Lab]]. Antilles authorized the use of it, and Hask and his ship were vanquished. The weapon was then submitted to the New Republic.<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 8">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 8|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 8]]</ref>

Five months after battling on Endor, the New Republic and the Nagai found themselves uneasy allies against the marauding [[Tof Kingdom]]. A joint [[Battle of Saijo|assault]] on the [[Tof/Legends|Tof]] stronghold of [[Saijo/Legends|Saijo]] with the aim of capturing the Tof Prince [[Sereno]] saw both Rogue Squadron and Gold Squadron deployed,<ref name="The Forgotten War" /> and Calrissian, piloting the ''Millennium Falcon'' alongside Chewbacca, told Antilles to destroy as many [[Tof starfighter]]s as possible until the enemy agreed to surrender. The flagship ''Merriweather'' did just that after half of its fighter escort had been taken out, and on the planet's surface Skywalker was able to acquire the target after his ally [[Bey]] subdued Lumiya.<ref name="Marvel Star Wars 107">[[Star Wars (1977) 107|''Star Wars'' (1977) 107]]</ref> The [[Nagai–Tof War]] was brought to an end,<ref name="The Forgotten War" /> and one month later<ref name="X-Wing Omnibus 2" /> the Rogues were sent on a mission to Tatooine,<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 9">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 9|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 9]]</ref> where a [[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] was on-world investigating Imperial arms dealing. Admiral Ackbar dispatched Rogue Squadron to aid her in case a strike force was required. While Janson, Nep, Ilo, and Klivian mixed with the locals in Mos Eisley to learn more about the ongoing gang wars that had resulted from the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|death]] of local [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]], Antilles met up with Biggs Darklighter's father [[Huff Darklighter|Huff]] alongside Celchu and Loro.<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 9" />

[[File:Tatooinepunchup.jpg|thumb|left|400px|The Rogues brawl with Kapp Dendo on Tatooine.]]
The dirtside Intelligence agent turned out to be Winter, who helped Antilles secure valuable intelligence from Darklighter about an Imperial weapons cache and the location of the lost prototype strike cruiser [[Eidolon (Strike-class)|''Eidolon'']]. Working with Winter was New Republic commando [[Kapp Dendo]], who allied with the Rogues despite an initial misunderstanding that led to a brawl, and the entire group found themsleves mixed up with the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gangster/Legends|gangster]] [[Firith Olan]].<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 10">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 10|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 10]]</ref> Antilles's group pursued Olan to [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], and although he escaped back to Tatooine with the Empire's Captain [[Marl Semtin/Legends|Marl Semtin]], the Rogues gained new allies in a disgruntled group of Imperial [[Special Intelligence]] troopers that Semtin had betrayed.<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 11">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 11|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 11]]</ref> On Tatooine, the events culminated with a [[Tatooine Campaign|battle]] that saw Semtin's forces defeated by the Rogues in the air while the Special Intelligence troopers stormed [[Eidolon Base]]. Following the battle, Loro parted ways with the squadron after she disobeyed one of Antilles's orders, and she went on to form a new partnership with former Special Intelligence trooper [[Sixtus Quin]]. Dendo personally rescued a downed Ilo during the battle, while Winter was relieved to learn that Celchu had survived what had seemed like a suicide run in his X-wing, surprising the pilot with a kiss.<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 12">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 12|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 12]]</ref>

Rogue Squadron's ranks grew from the mere six they had been boasting when Ackbar's aide, [[Firstpilot]] [[Rekush]], recommended that Antilles interview [[Feylis Ardele]] from the [[Commenor Militia]].<ref name="X-Wing Handbook" />  Other new recruits were the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Ibtisam]] and the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Nrin Vakil]],<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 13">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 13|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 13]]</ref> whose acrimony toward each other over a longstanding [[Species/Legends|species]] rivalry was kept in check by Antilles's orders,<ref name="X-Wing Handbook" /> and a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] pilot<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 13" /> named [[Herian I'ngre]].<ref name="X-Wing Handbook" /> Seven months after Endor,<ref name="X-Wing Omnibus 2" /> Antilles was using Ardele's experience flying TIE fighters during her training at [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]] and was pitting her against the rest of the Rogues in daily [[Flight simulator/Legends|simulations]].<ref name="X-Wing Handbook" /> During one such exercise, he also had I'ngre rig the simulator seats with electical charges in a bid to produce more realism. Just after the simulation, Antilles and Celchu were shocked to receive a visit from [[Grand Duke]] [[Gror Pernon]] of [[Eiattu 6]] and to learn that Plourr Ilo was Isplourrdacartha Estillo, the lost [[Prince/Legends|princess]] of his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. Rogue Squadron's next [[Eiattu Campaign|mission]] was to escort her home, an arrangement Ilo only accepted when she was told that her long-lost [[Harrandatha Estillo|brother]] was still alive.<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 13" />

====Striking from the shadows====
{{Quote|You lead well, but Alliance throws Rogues at impossible problems. Were you bad leader, all would have long since died.|Xarcce Huwla, upon joining Rogue Squadron|<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 21">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 21|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 21]]</ref>}}
As their world was in the throes of a [[Eiattu Civil War|civil war]], the Grand Duke hoped that the princess could inspire peace by talking her brother out of his [[People's Liberation Battalion|rebellion]] against the [[Priamsta|ruling nobles]]. The Rogues thus traveled to Eiattu 6, where Antilles and Celchu joined Ilo at a royal gala and met her betrothed, [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Rial Pernon]].<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 13" /> The rest of the squadron meanwhile explored the planet's jungles on the backs of [[thuvasaur]]s, where a sudden jungle firefight with Imperial stormtroopers was won with air support from Antilles, Celchu, Ilo, and Rial Pernon. They also received an assist from the local rebel forces, who welcomed the Rogues to their base; there they met Ilo's charismatic brother, Harrandatha, who led the People's Liberation Battalion against both the nobles and occupying Imperial forces. Ilo herself felt no sympathy for the nobles and declared that night at a formal dinner that their tyranny would thenceforth come to an end.<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 14">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 14|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 14]]</ref>

[[File:Ramborogues.jpg|thumb|right|350px|Rogue Squadron stalks through the jungles of Eiattu 6.]]
Reunited in the [[Eiattu 6's capital city|capital city]] the next day, Janson and Klivian reported their adventures to Antilles and Celchu, while the rest of the squadron found themselves arguing over which faction was most fit to lead the people of Eiattu 6. While he and Celchu attended the next in a series of meetings, Antilles assigned the rest of the Rogues to return to the jungles and locate the rest of the Imperial forces&mdash;a mission that ended in their capture by biker scouts. Ilo and Pernon, meanwhile, fought off a kidnap attempt by agents of the nobility, and as events reached their zenith, Ilo revealed that her brother was definitely dead and that the rebel leader must be an [[Harrandatha Estillo (impostor)|impostor]].<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 15">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 15|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 15]]</ref> In league and in love with the Rogue Imperial Moff [[Leonia Tavira]], the false Harrandatha mustered his forces for a strike on the capital while Tavira imprisoned the Rogues her soldiers had kidnapped. She told them that the outcome of the battle was immaterial to her, as even if her agent failed in seizing control of the planet, she had raided the royal treasury of enough credits to be left a made woman.<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 16">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 16|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 16]]</ref>

Antilles, Celchu, and Ilo took to their X-wings to eliminate Imperial forces that entered the battle for the capital, which allowed the People's Liberation Battalion to arrive at the central [[Imperial Citadel (Eiattu 6)|citadel]] unmolested. Ilo landed and exposed the charlatan, while the rest of the Rogues were rescued from their prison by Nrin Vakil, who had earlier been left to die in the jungles by Tavira's soldiers. However, they were unable to stop Tavira from fleeing the planet with a portion of her stolen funds. Ilo elected to remain with her people to help strengthen her weakened homeworld, and Antilles gifted her X-wing to her and promised that she always had a place in the squadron. The mission also saw the beginning of an evolution in Vakil and Ibitsam's relationship with a show of gratitude from the Mon Calamari following her rescue at the Quarren's hands.<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 16" /> Straight from Eiattu, Rogue Squadron departed on a mission to locate a missing [[Passenger liner/Legends|spaceliner]] full of [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] tourists.<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 17">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 17|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 17]]</ref>

Short one member without Ilo, the nine remaining Rogues launched to the [[Malrev system/Legends|Malrev system]]<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 17" /> eight months after the second Death Star's destruction.<ref name="X-Wing Omnibus 2" /> The spaceliner ''[[Starfaring]]'' was quickly located on [[Malrev IV]], but only after Antilles's fighter was [[Malrev incident|shot down]] by TIE fighters. A tense meeting at the passengers' campsite led to the Bothans brawling with Vakil, Klivian, and Janson, but an attack from the planet's native [[Irrukiine]] united the two groups in defense. Antilles, meanwhile, was rescued by a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] sorcerer who could [[Qâzoi Kyantuska|control]] the Irrukiine with his mind.<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 17" /> The sorcerer used [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]] to repair the Rogue Leader's nearly lifeless body, but he was unable to convince Antilles to surrender to its seductive influence. Back at the Bothan camp, however, the other Rogues found their emotions in various states of havoc. Dllr Nep was the most susceptible, and after Antilles escaped the sorcerer's [[Sith Temple (Malrev IV)|temple]], Nep willingly entered it.<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 18">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 18|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 18]]</ref>

Believing that he was hearing beautiful [[Music/Legends|music]], Nep could only break free from the influence of [[Cartariun]], the sorcerer, via [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathic]] help from Herian I'ngre, who was recovering from injuries in a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]]. By drawing on the temple's [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] energy, Nep overpowered Cartariun and his Irrukiine goons, which broke the sorcerer's control over a large force of Irrukiine TIE pilots who were haranguing the rest of the Rogues. The struggle was ended by the arrival of the Bothan [[Girov Dza'tey]], who shot Nep<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 19">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 19|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 19]]</ref> and killed Cartariun, wanting the temple's dark powers for himself. The squadron then undertook an aerial assault on the temple while the Bothans attacked on the ground, and with Dza'tey focused on controlling his Irrukiine drones, Nep used his mental link with I'ngre to guide her X-wing into the temple. The sudden arrival of Plourr Ilo helped distract Dza'tey further, and I'ngre was able to destroy the nexus of dark power, although both she and Nep gave their lives in the process.<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 20">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 20|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 20]]</ref> Ilo remained with the Rogues and was flying with them<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 21" /> one month later<ref name="X-Wing Omnibus 3">''[[Star Wars Omnibus: X-Wing Rogue Squadron Volume 3]]''</ref> when they gathered reconnaissance at [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]].<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 21" />

[[File:Wedgevsbaron.jpg|thumb|left|350px|Wedge Antilles dogfights Baron Soontir Fel over Brentaal IV.]]
Rogue Squadron were involved in another battle<ref name="Galactic Battlegrounds">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref> eight months after Endor<ref name="NEC" /> when they helped Solo, Chewbacca, and Calrissian [[Liberation of Kashyyyk/Legends|liberate]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] from [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Peccati Syn]] and Moff [[Hindane Darcc/Legends|Hindane Darc]].<ref name="Galactic Battlegrounds" /> At Brentaal<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 21" /> the following month,<ref name="X-Wing Omnibus 3" /> Nrin Vakil flew a [[T-65BR X-wing reconnaissance starfighter|Recon-X starfighter]] while his fellow Rogues protected him from TIE fighters. After his data sweep, the squadron returned to Rebel [[Base Delta-Nine]], where Antilles and Celchu welcomed four new members of the squadron: [[Dar Keyis]], [[Standro Jcir]], [[Avan Beruss]], and [[Xarcce Huwla]]. Citing the high odds of dying in the near-impossible tasks the Rogues were assigned, Huwla requested a transfer, but agreed to fly with the squadron until her request could be processed. Two weeks of training then commenced for their next mission: joining Colonel [[Horton Salm/Legends|Horton Salm's]] [[Aggressor Wing]] in a [[New Republic task force (Brentaal IV)|task force]] and [[Battle of Brentaal IV (Galactic Civil War)|capturing]] Brentaal IV.<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 21" />

After the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|naval force]] took Brentaal IV's [[Brentaal Moonbase|moon base]],<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 22">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 22|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 22]]</ref> Rogue Squadron learned that they had tussled with elements of the Empire's notorious [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Wing]].<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 21" /> Numerous squadron members worried about a potential skirmish with the 181st's leader, [[Baron of the Empire/Legends|Baron]] [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]], but they were cheered to discover that Koyi Komad was their new [[Chief/Legends|chief]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]]. When they attacked Brentaal's capital of [[Vuultin]], Aggressor Wing simultaneously struck at the spaceport city of [[Oradin]], and it was the latter group that found themselves in Fel's sights. Imperial Admiral [[Lon Isoto]] ordered the [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] back to Vuultin, however, and the Rogues withdrew to the [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']]. Oradin was theirs,<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 22" /> and Vuultin was taken in a later assault, with Janson and Ibtisam&mdash;earlier shot down but rescued by Kapp Dendo's [[Commando Team One]]&mdash;assisting from the ground. Fel engaged Antilles in a dogfight over Brentaal IV, and the Rogue Leader was only able to best him with help from a disabling shot by Colonel Salm's ion cannon. Dar Keyis and Standro Jcir were two of the battle's casualties.<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 24">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 24|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 24]]</ref>

During Fel's debriefing, the Baron revealed that he was [[Wedding of Soontir Fel and Wynssa Starflare|married]] to Antilles's estranged sister,<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 24" /> famous [[Actor/Legends|actress]] [[Syal Antilles Fel|Wynssa Starflare]]. Fel also shared his life story, including details of the 181st's role in destroying Renegade Flight at Derra IV, and he revealed that he had grown disillusioned with the Empire. He agreed to defect on the condition that the New Republic help find and protect his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], who had gone into hiding.<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 25">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 25|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 25]]</ref> Antilles [[Mission to Corellia (Rogue Squadron)|dispatched]] Ilo, Klivian, and Janson to Corellia to find her, and Fel was welcomed into Rogue Squadron, despite the strong objections of Vakil.<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 26">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 26|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 26]]</ref> Although the trio did not locate Starflare, they did help [[Fel dynasty|Fel's family]] rescue a kidnapped child, [[Fyric Fel|Fyric]], with the aid of [[Corellian Security Force]] officers [[Iella Wessiri Antilles|Iella Wessiri]] and [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]].<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 27">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 27|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 27]]</ref> Soontir Fel took to an X-wing quickly and saw [[Raid on pirates|action]] with his new squadron against a [[Kavil's Corsairs|group]] of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] in [[TYE-wing]] [[Ugly/Legends|uglies]], and he and Celchu were next assigned to [[Operation on Eiattu|escort]] Leia Organa Solo to Eiattu 6. As Fel had once been a symbol of the Empire's power, the New Republic hoped his new allegiance would signify their decline. The group's transport to Eiattu was Han Solo's ''Millennium Falcon''.<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 28">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 28|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 28]]</ref>

[[File:Ibtisamdeath.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Rogue Squadron mourns the death of Ibtisam.]]
Ilo, Fel, and Solo learned that Eiattu's Count [[Arian Laabann|Laabann]] had sold information to Leonia Tavira&mdash;information that led to Celchu and Winter's capture. Meanwhile, on [[Axxila/Legends|Axxila]], Antilles and Organa [[Undercover operation on Axxila|secretly met]] with [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]], current ruler of the Empire, who wished to defect from the power-hungry Imperials who were trying to force him out.<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 29">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 29|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 29]]</ref> With help from Solo in the ''Falcon'' and an escaped Celchu and Winter in a Y-wing, the Rogues chased Tavira's pirates off of Axxila, and Fel was able to order Imperial Admiral [[Delak Krennel]]'s [[Reckoning (Imperial II-class)|Star Destroyer]] away with a bogus [[AT3 Directive]]. The order succeeded after the directive was confirmed by Pestage, who was now working as a secret New Republic ally,<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 31">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 30|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 30]]</ref> but his duplicity did not go unnoticed by the Empire. The ambitious [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] Ysanne Isard began to plot against him.<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 32">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 32|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 32]]</ref>

When an Imperial warrant was issued for Pestage's arrest<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 32" /> [[5 ABY/Legends|twelve months after]] the Battle of Endor,<ref name="X-Wing Omnibus 2" /> the [[New Republic Provisional Council]] moved to rescue him, with Rogue Squadron recruited for the task. The full squadron was recalled from some leisure time that saw Ibtisam and Nrin Vakil growing closer, and Ardele and Beruss pursuing a relationship.<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 32" /> Alongside Aggressor Wing and Commando Team One, the Rogues [[Evacuation of Ciutric|struck]] at [[Ciutric IV]] and made contact with Pestage on the ground,<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 33">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 33|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 33]]</ref> but Ibtisam was killed during a skirmish with TIE fighters. Her death deeply affected Vakil, who had hoped to use his friendship with his former foe to heal the rift between their two peoples.<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 34">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 34|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 34]]</ref> As the New Republic forces and Mirax Terrik's ''Pulsar Skate'' cut an escape route through Delak Krennel's ''Reckoning'' and the Interdictor ''[[Binder]]'', Pestage slipped away from them to join Krennel as a warlord of the new [[Ciutric Hegemony]], only to have his neck snapped by his would-be ally. The Rogues held a [[Funeral/Legends|funeral]] for Ibtisam,<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 35">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 35|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 35]]</ref> and a grief-stricken Vakil took a leave of absence from them before eventually transferring to a training squadron.<ref name="Isard's Revenge">''[[X-Wing: Isard's Revenge]]''</ref> Isard, meanwhile, saw to it that each member of the [[Imperial Ruling Council]] met with their deaths, and she ascended to the leadership of the Empire.<ref name="Rogue Squadron Comic 35" />

====Mayhem at Mindor====
{{Quote|Luke's in danger.''"<br />"''What kind of danger?''"<br />"''The fatal kind.''" (watches Celchu spring away) "''Where's he going?''"<br />"''To round up the rest of the Rogues. Fifteen minutes.|Leia Organa and Wedge Antilles, just before launching for Mindor|<ref name="Mindor" />}}
The year 5 ABY<ref name="Essential Reader's Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> also saw the New Republic face off against [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Cronal|Shadowspawn]], a marauder who had been raiding Republic territory for two months and costing thousands of civilian lives. Antilles hatched a plan to load special [[flechette torpedo]]es with tracking devices that would lodge themselves in the [[Hull/Legends|hulls]] of Shadowspawn's [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]], and Rogue Squadron subsequently [[Battle of the Corellian Queen|ambushed]] the warlord's forces on the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] in upgraded [[T-65B X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65B X-wings]]. After bursting out of a replica of the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Corellian Queen]]'', the Rogues engaged the marauders, and Klivian and Janson quickly shredded four Defenders each despite the loss of one of Klivian's wings and his [[Cybernetics/Legends|mechanical left hand]]. Ardele and Beruss were both forced to eject, and Klivian's crippled starfighter received manual pickup from Janson, but the Rogues suffered no casualties and the retreating marauders were traced to their base in the [[Taspan system]]. General Calrissian of [[New Republic Special Operations]] informed Antilles that General Skywalker's [[Rapid Response Task Force]] would take over the operation at that point, but Rogue Squadron's part in the operation soon turned out to be far from over.<ref name="Mindor" />

While Leia Organa negotiated with a [[Unidentified Mandalorian mercenary commander|Mandalorian mercenary commander]] inside an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] in an obscure [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Unidentified star system (Inner Rim)|system]], the Rogues were on-station with Calrissian, who was bringing the Mandalorian Protector and former mercenary Fenn Shysa in as an intermediary. Organa felt a premonition during the negotiations that her brother, Skywalker, was in danger, prompting Han Solo and Chewbacca to dash off in the ''Millennium Falcon'' to help him. A desperate Organa let the Force lead her around the asteroid's [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] until she found Celchu, whom she told she needed an emergency ride. Antilles overheard and was reluctant to disobey Calrissian's orders until she revealed that Skywalker was in danger, at which point he quickly rounded up the rest of the squadron. When they arrived at the planet [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]], with Organa inside Celchu's B-wing, they found the ''Millennium Falcon'' helping the Republic task force [[Battle of Mindor|take out]] Shadowspawn's [[Gravity well/Legends|gravity well]] projectors. If the projectors sent enough asteroids crashing into the [[Taspan|sun]], the resulting [[Solar flare/Legends|stellar flares]] would sterilize the entire system.<ref name="Mindor" />

[[File:PrereleaseMindorCoverArt.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Rogue Squadron came to General Skywalker's aid at the Battle of Mindor.]]
Organa was transferred to the ''Falcon'', and together with Solo, the Rogues carved their way through Shadowspawn's TIE interceptors and [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] stations toward the planet's surface, microjumping through lightspeed from asteroid cluster to asteroid cluster and being yanked from hyperspace each time by the gravity wells. Solo advised them to fly using their [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]] in order to make use of the [[Solo Slide]], a tactic that moved the asteroids by firing repulsors at them. Rogue Squadron proved adept at the new tactic, impressing Solo with their finesse, and the ''Falcon'' was able to make it through the gravity wells and land on the planet to look for the missing General Skywalker. Antilles and his pilots remained in the air to clear an escape route out of the system but quickly found themselves swarmed by TIEs. A downside of their tactic was that the stellar flares would now begin in less than twelve hours, down from the previous estimate of two days that had depended on a fully intact gravity well network.<ref name="Mindor" />

Working with Captain [[Tirossk]] of the Rapid Response Task Force, the Rogues and various other fighter squadrons protected [[CC-7700/E interdiction cruiser|Slash-E interdiction cruisers]] from an overwhelming enemy fighter screen, and their low spirits were only lifted by the arrival of General Calrissian in the [[Remember Alderaan (Star Cruiser)|''Remember Alderaan'']]. With him were the Mandalorian mercenaries, recently hired by him, and when Antilles and Celchu docked aboard his cruiser he became more interested in the tactical situation than in punishing them. Antilles estimated it would be at least eighteen hours before the gravity well situation allowed an escape window to open. The fleet took cover above Mindor's nightside, but the Rogues and two other squadrons distracted the enemy forces by covering decoy [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] before joining the fleet's attack on Shadowspawn's dirtside [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]] [[Shadow Base|base]]. During the melee, a commandeered ''Millennium Falcon'' downed Klivian's craft, and two other Rogue pilots were also taken out, but Calrissian ordered the squadron to focus its fire on the base's [[gravity gun]].<ref name="Mindor" />

Rogue Squadron dogfought their foes over the base while its interior was stormed by Shysa and the Mandalorians, but the volcano suddenly rose into the sky. A solid mass of [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]]-proof stone, it could launch into space and protect its occupants from the stellar flares. Disaster was only averted when Skywalker broadcast a call for Shadowspawn's forces to power down their gravity stations and surrender unconditionally&mdash;believing that he was the heir to Palpatine and their new Emperor, the Imperials complied. However, Shadowspawn used a fail-safe to reactivate the stations and [[Possession/Legends|possess]] his soldiers' minds, driving his TIE pilots into suicide runs against the Republic fleet. Believing they would not survive, the Rogues and their allies yet threw themselves into a desperate defense, but Skywalker was ultimately able to defeat Shadowspawn and free his soldiers from their mindless rage. The act of mercy killed them all, and a disgusted Skywalker went on to resign his commission from the New Republic military. Although the Republic forces escaped, the planet Mindor was destroyed by the sun's stellar flares.<ref name="Mindor" />

[[File:Tea-rogue.jpg|thumb|right|325px|Members of Rogue Squadron, left to right: Wedge Antilles, Plourr Ilo, Hobbie Klivian, Corran Horn, and Tycho Celchu]]
Nearly seven months after joining the New Republic, Soontir Fel was safely reunited with his wife, and he soon afterward helped Rogue Squadron win a key [[Battle between Rogue Squadron and Ysanne Isard's forces|battle]] against Ysanne Isard's forces. An enraged Isard set into motion a plan to capture him&mdash;a plan spearheaded by Grand Admiral [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]. Based in the Unknown Regions, Thrawn was fighting a war with dire threats<ref name="NEGTC" /> and would-be warlords against whom he believed there was no guarantee of victory, even if the Empire and New Republic were to combine their forces. With his people, the [[Chiss]], especially vulnerable to those threats, he set up his [[Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo's Household Phalanx|Household Phalanx]] on the planet [[Nirauan/Legends|Nirauan]] to protect them.<ref name="Vision of the Future">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref> He needed skilled warriors, and when Fel was captured by Isard around 5.5 ABY and sent to [[Hand of Thrawn|Thrawn's base]] on Nirauan, the former Baron heard the Grand Admiral out and agreed to join his fight<ref name="NEGTC" /> against the Unknown Regions threats, which were dangers to the entire galaxy.<ref name="Fact File 140 Soontir">{{FactFile|140|FEL 1-2|Baron Soontir Fel}}</ref>

Fel's wife and [[Chak Fel|their]] [[Davin Fel|children]] were also captured by Isard and handed over to Thrawn, and the family relocated to Nirauan.<ref name="Fact File 122 Syal">{{FactFile|122|WYN 1-4|Wynssa Starflare}}</ref> Imperial forces were covertly working under Thrawn alongside the rogue Chiss of his Household Phalanx,<ref name="Vision of the Future" /> and the wider organization was called the [[Empire of the Hand]].<ref name="Survivor's Quest">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref> When Fel disappeared, the New Republic assumed that he had been executed by Isard,<ref name="Vision of the Future" /> to whom the Rogues lost another member around the same time&mdash;in 5.5 ABY,<ref name="Note on the date of Tycho's capture">[[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu's]] entry in ''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' dates his capture by [[Ysanne Isard]] at one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Tatooine Campaign]], which takes place [[4 ABY/Legends|six months after]] the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], according to ''[[Star Wars Omnibus: X-Wing Rogue Squadron Volume 2]]''.</ref> Tycho Celchu infiltrated the Imperial capital world of Coruscant in a TIE fighter on a New Republic [[Scouting mission to Coruscant|espionage mission]], but was uncovered and captured by Isard. He managed to escape after a few months in the hellish [[Lusankya (prison)|Lusankya prison]], but many in the New Republic suspected that he was a [[Brain/Legends|brainwashed]] [[Sleeper agent/Legends|sleeper agent]].<ref name="NEC" />

====Reorganization====
{{Quote|So you're all now part of Rogue Squadron. What you can expect of the future is this: endless amounts of boredom and routine punctuated by moments of sheer terror. As good as you are, statistical studies of fighter pilots indicate most of you will die in your first five missions. While survivability goes up after that, the odds are still not good that you will live to see the complete destruction of the Empire. The reason for that is that you will be there to see bits and pieces of it being lopped off. Rogue Squadron will be given tough assignments and will be expected to complete them, specifically because we are the best there is.|Wedge Antilles addresses his new pilots|<ref name="Rogue Squadron" />}}
About a year and a half after Endor, Admiral Ackbar approached Antilles with plans from the New Republic Provisional Council for re-forming Rogue Squadron<ref name="Rogue Squadron" />&mdash;they directed Antilles to rebuild the legendary unit from the ground up,<ref name="Who's Who">{{InsiderCite|59|Who's Who in Rogue Squadron}}</ref> revitalizing it<ref name="Rogue Squadron" /> with the galaxy's best pilots.<ref name="Who's Who" /> Having seen too many new members die soon after joining the Rogues, Antilles saw the wisdom in the decision; although all of the squadron's veterans wanted to see it continue unbroken, they also wanted its pilots to get the necessary training for survival.<ref name="Rogue Squadron" /> Rogue Squadron was temporarily disbanded,<ref name="NEGTC" /> and Antilles was taken off active duty.<ref name="EC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref> The Rogues became an important symbol of New Republic propaganda,<ref name="Rogue Squadron" /> and Antilles was sent on a nearly year-long publicity tour,<ref name="NEGTC" /> visiting new member worlds to deliver speeches, kiss [[Youngling/Legends|babies]], and pose for [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]].<ref name="Rogue Squadron" /> The squadron's exploits were played up<ref name="Who's Who" /> in an effort to depict the new government as heroes, rather than the bandits they had been cast as by the Empire.<ref name="Rogue Squadron" />

[[File:WedgeJapanese.png|thumb|left|180px|Wedge Antilles rebuilt Rogue Squadron in 6.5 ABY.]]
Klivian and Janson were assigned to train new squadrons,<ref name="Rogue Squadron" /> and Antilles was recalled to active duty in 6.5 ABY<ref name="EC" /> to help interview and test hundreds of pilots for the empty Rogue positions. The New Republic needed an elite group of pilots who could perform the impossible jobs for which Rogue Squadron was known, and who could live up to its legend.<ref name="Rogue Squadron" /> After some last-minute negotiations with Ackbar and with General Horton Salm over some political appointments to the squadron, Antilles had his twelve,<ref name="Rogue Squadron" /> and preparations for the New Republic's push toward Coruscant could begin.<ref name="EC" /> The New Republic believed it was important that their allies, including the Bothans and the planet Thyferra, have representatives in the celebrated squadron, but Antilles was able to secure Celchu as his [[Executive officer/Legends|executive officer]], provided that his friend&mdash;still under heavy suspicion by many&mdash;only fly a Z-95 Headhunter with low-powered lasers during training missions and remain under house arrest when not flying. The [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[M-3PO (Emtrey)/Legends|Emtrey]] served as Antilles's administrative assistant, and the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] [[Zraii]] as the squadron's technician.<ref name="Rogue Squadron" />

At the New Republic's [[Folor Base]], not long after the new pilots trained with the [[Redemption scenario|''Redemption scenario]], Antilles gathered them together for the first time: former CorSec agent Corran Horn, former [[Lawyer/Legends|lawyer]] [[Nawara Ven]], [[Gand]] pilot [[Ooryl Qrygg]], Thyferrans [[Bror Jace]] and [[Erisi Dlarit]], Kessel native [[Lujayne Forge]], Bespin native [[Rhysati Ynr]], [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Andoorni Hui]], [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavenan]] [[Riv Shiel]], Bothan [[Peshk Vri'syk]], and [[Gavin Darklighter]], cousin to former Red Squadron pilot Biggs Darklighter. They had been chosen for both their elite flying abilities and for other skills, as Ackbar wanted them to operate as more than just a fighter squadron&mdash;he envisioned them operating independently if necessary, performing operations that usually required far more than twelve operatives.<ref name="Rogue Squadron" /> Antilles wanted pilots who could also serve as commandos, and he had prioritized ground-based skills when faced with applicants of equal piloting skill.<ref name="Wraith Squadron" /> He reminded his new team that statistically, most fighter pilots died within their first five missions, and he told them of his plans to intensely train them over the following month.<ref name="Rogue Squadron" />

The new squadron was put through a training exercise in a gunnery and bombing range on [[Folor]] known as the [[Trench (Folor)|Trench]], which saw the hotshot Corran Horn learn a humbling lesson about teamwork when Antilles fed his targeting data to his fellows, improving the squadron's result at the expense of his individual score. Another mission saw them stage a training attack on General Salm's Y-wings, scoring an eight to one simulated kill ratio and infuriating the general. Antilles felt that six months of advanced training was necessary, but the New Republic worried over potential moves against Coruscant by Imperial warlords, and the Rogues were officially activated by Admiral Ackbar. Moved coreward to [[Talasea]], they were assigned to escort ships that were going even deeper toward the galactic capital; as the New Republic began its own push to Coruscant, safe worlds and supply depots were being set up along their route.<ref name="Rogue Squadron" />

[[File:Corran-jpn.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Hotshot Rogue pilot Corran Horn]]
The Provisional Council insisted that Rogue Squadron's mission be publicized in order to send a message to Imperial citizens waiting to be liberated, and Ackbar was cognizant of the risk that such publicity posed to the pilots. As such, he committed to keeping each of their destinations secret, even from them. Navigational data would only be fed to them immediately prior to each hyperspace jump, and they would also be kept in the dark about their mission's true purpose, told instead that they were embarking on an extended training exercise. Leading Vri'syk as Rogue Two, Ven as Rogue Three, and Jace as Rogue Four, Antilles commanded [[One Flight]] as Rogue Leader; [[Two Flight]] was headed by Ynr as Rogue Seven and also included Darklighter as Rogue Five, Shiel as Rogue Six, and Dlarit as Rogue Eight; while Corran Horn was promoted to lieutenant and given [[Three Flight]]. As Rogue Nine, he commanded Qrygg, Forge, and Hui&mdash;Rogues Ten, Eleven, and Twelve, respectively.<ref name="Rogue Squadron" />

En route to Talasea in the [[Morobe system]] on their first official mission, the Rogues were pulled from hyperspace in the [[Chorax system/Legends|Chorax system]] by the Imperial Interdictor cruiser [[Corusca Rainbow|''Black Asp'']]. The cruiser's real target was the ''Pulsar Skate'', which was in-system at the time, and Antilles ordered his squadron to [[Battle in the Chorax system|engage]] the cruiser's complement of TIE interceptors. Several were taken out, and a combined proton torpedo volley from the Rogues prompted the interdictor to flee, but Horn's X-wing took damage from the ''Black Asp''{{'s}} ion cannon and was only saved from two vengeful interceptors when Celchu, flying the unarmed shuttle ''[[Forbidden]]'' as [[Rogue Null]], fed Horn targeting data that allowed him to destroy both foes. Toed to Talasea by the ''Pulsar Skate'', Horn was greeted coldly by Mirax Terrik, whose father [[Booster Terrik]] had once been locked up by Horn's father, [[Hal Horn]].<ref name="Rogue Squadron" />

After two weeks on the ground at Talasea, the Rogues launched for [[Hensara III]], where the crew of the New Republic [[Imperial Customs Frigate|frigate]] [[Battle of Yavin (starship)|''Battle of Yavin'']] had hidden their ship in a deep lake so as to evade the eyes of the Imperial ''Strike''-class medium cruiser [[Havoc (Strike-class)|''Havoc'']]. In order to obscure their point of origin from prying eyes, Rogue Squadron extended their journey over three hyperjumps before arriving in the [[Hensara system/Legends|Hensara system]] along with the ''Pulsar Skate'' and the Corellian [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] ''[[Eridain]]''. While Antilles took One and Two Flights into the planet's atmosphere, Three Flight flew [[Combat aerospace patrol]] at the atmosphere's edge in case further Imperial forces showed up. ''Havoc'' did just that, but the Rogues [[Rout of Hensara|routed]] its TIE complement and allowed the ''Pulsar Skate'' to recover their targets. Back at Talasea, Horn and Jace engaged in a boasting contest over which of them had been the best pilot in the engagement.<ref name="Rogue Squadron" />

[[File:Lujayne-forge-jpn.jpg|thumb|left|Lujayne Forge's death deeply affected her fellow Rogues.]]
Soon afterward, Forge was killed in her [[Sleep/Legends|sleep]] by stormtroopers who [[Raid on Talasea|raided]] the Rogues' [[Talasea base]], as were support staff members [[Carter (sentry)|Carter]] and [[Pirgi]]. Horn and Qrygg woke up early in the raid and were able to set actions into motion that disarmed explosives set by the Imperials, but Horn, Darklighter, and Hui all took blaster fire and were convened to bacta tanks aboard the medical [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] ''[[Reprieve]]'' following a quick evacuation. Forge's death hit her squadron-mates hard, and a memorial service for her and her fallen comrades was held aboard the ''Reprieve'', but the New Republic forces were able to capture the full enemy [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] that had been operating on-world. Ackbar planned a counter-attack lest the enemy feel emboldened by the damage they had caused, and when it was discovered that the stormtroopers had come from the planet [[Vladet]], a [[Defense of Vladet|strike]] on the [[Grand Isle|Imperial base]] there was authorized. With Hui still not well enough to fly, an understrength Rogue Squadron joined the Y-wings of General Salm's [[Defender Wing]], with Captain [[Afyon]]'s ''Eridain'' operating as a command and control center.<ref name="Rogue Squadron" />

Salm's [[Champion Squadron|Champion]] and [[Guardian Squadron]]s went into Vladet's atmosphere first, each with an escort of four Rogues, while [[Warden Squadron]] and its escort of two followed behind. The Y-wings took out the Empire's volcano base while the X-wings handled the four TIE fighters that constituted its defenses, but trouble arose when two larger Imperial ships arrived in space: the [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class cruiser]] ''[[Expeditious]]'' and the [[Lancer-class frigate/Legends|''Lancer''-class frigate]] [[Ravager (Lancer-class)|''Ravager'']]. Antilles and Salm had different views on how to evade a snubfighter-killing ''Lancer'', but Horn insisted he could get close enough to it to get targeting data he could then send to the slower Y-wings. He went through with the plan even when General Salm forbade it, and a salvo of proton torpedoes from Warden Squadron targeted his homing beacon but slammed into ''Ravager'' when he juked out of the way at the last minute. With the ''Lancer'' out of the picture, the New Republic forces fled the [[Rachuk system/Legends|system]], although Horn was confined to quarters aboard the ''Reprieve'' while Antilles talked Salm out of court-martialing the pilot. During his confinement, he started to grow closer to two of his visitors: Erisi Dlarit and Mirax Terrik.<ref name="Rogue Squadron" />

====The path to Coruscant====
{{Quote|I still think the whole of Rogue Squadron is out of line, but I think things are going to go badly at Blackmoon. With Horn and the rest of your pilots there, maybe things won't end up becoming the nightmare that I'm afraid is going to haunt me for the next two weeks.|General Horton Salm, before the First Battle of Borleias|<ref name="Rogue Squadron" />}}
When General [[Laryn Kre'fey]] proposed a strike at a coreward planet codenamed Blackmoon, Antilles, Salm, and Ackbar all shared reservations about the general's incomplete intelligence and his insistence on taking the world via orbital bombardment. Salm felt they needed all the help they could get and agreed to drop his charges against Horn, and over the next two weeks, the Rogues learned their roles in the assault via simulations. Briefings seemed to them to be more about morale-building than about facts, however, and they arrived at the planet [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]] full of misgivings. Their [[New Republic task force (Borleias)|task force]] was anchored by the Star Destroyer ''[[Emancipator]]'', which immediately began pounding the dirtside Imperial base's shields&mdash;what the New Republic did not know, however, was that the Empire's General [[Evir Derricote]] was augmenting the shields with a secret [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]]. He gradually slackened the shields' strength so as to deceive his foes, and a confident General Kre'fey declared that resistance had ended.<ref name="Rogue Squadron" />

[[File:RogueSquadron_cover_art.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The rebuilt Rogue Squadron flies at the First Battle of Borleias.]]
A Y-wing sweep of the base was called off, and Defender Wing was ordered home, while a trepidatious Rogue Squadron was instructed to escort [[New Republic Special Forces/Legends|commando]]-filled [[Assault shuttle/Legends|assault shuttles]] to the surface. Their skepticism was proven justified when ion cannon fire from the surface suddenly lashed out at the shuttle ''[[Modaran]]'', which drifted into a renewed Imperial energy shield and exploded. TIES began streaming out of launch tunnels from the base, and heavy ion cannon fire continued, hitting the ''Emancipator'' and destroying Peshk Vri'syk's X-wing, killing the pilot. The Rogues fought hard to defend the shuttles from the Imperial fighters, but Andoorni Hui was killed by an interceptor, and Qrygg, Dlarit and Ven were all forced to eject. The New Republic forces started fleeing into hyperspace, but the Rogues remained behind to screen their extravehicular pilots until they could be rescued, even as two more interceptor squadrons joined the fray.<ref name="Rogue Squadron" />

The New Republic [[Bulk cruiser/Legends|bulk cruiser]] ''[[Mon Valle]]'' was taken out of the fight before it could jump, and the six remaining Rogues battled overwhelming odds while Celchu began rescuing the three drifting pilots with his shuttle, the ''Forbidden''. Although he was unarmed, he was still able to get a missile lock on an interceptor, which sent it juking away and into the path of one of Horn's torpedoes. The maneuver did little to affect the tide of the battle, but General Salm disobeyed an order to leave the system and brought Defender Wing's Y-wings into the fray, scaring their enemies off and saving Rogue Squadron. All in all, the [[First Battle of Borleias]] was a disaster for the New Republic, with General Kre'fey himself perishing in the fight. The Rogues lost two of their number, and Qrygg's right arm was severed at the elbow by debris from his X-wing while he floated helplessly in space.<ref name="Rogue Squadron" />

Back at the Rogues' [[Noquivzor base recreation center|base]] on [[Noquivzor]], the three pilots who had gone extravehicular healed in bacta tanks, and Riv Shiel reported for medical care. Lieutenant [[Judder Page/Legends|Judder Page]] of the [[Katarn Commandos]] told Horn that he had wanted to wait three weeks to use a [[Meteor shower/Legends|meteor shower]] as cover for ground reconnaissance of the Imperial base, but an overeager Kre'fey had refused to delay. The two officers speculated that the base's unexpected resources had been kept secret from even the Empire itself, while General Salm suggested to Antilles that a leak from the New Republic had possibly tipped the Empire off. Although the coordinates of "Blackmoon" had been erased from every ship's astromech droid and [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computers]], Horn's droid [[Whistler]] used his special criminal investigation and forensic circuitry package from Horn's CorSec days to analyze wind currents and deduce that the planet they had struck was in fact Borleias.<ref name="Rogue Squadron" />

With that information, Antilles and Salm learned that the generator of a planetside [[Alderaan Biotics facility]] had allowed Derricote to boost his shields, and they proposed to Ackbar a [[Second Battle of Borleias|second strike at Borleias]] that would see Page and his commandos go in first to disable the facility. A nearby Imperial Star Destroyer, the [[Eviscerator/Legends|''Eviscerator'']], would be kept busy by a Defender Wing&ndash;led feint at nearby [[Jagga II]]. Antilles still kept Borleias's name a secret, telling his pilots they were striking at a planet called [[Phenaru Prime]], and when he briefed them, he told them of the short window they had to destroy one of the biotics facility's power conduits so Page's Commandos could use it to enter the base. Emtrey revealed that they could supplement their fuel reserves with some auxiliary [[Fuel pod/Legends|fuel pods]] he had procured, but even so, using the meteor shower as cover coming in would severely deplete their fuel reserves, increasing the chances they would not make it out. Regardless, every surviving Rogue volunteered for the mission, and Antilles chose Horn, Ynr, Jace, Darklighter, and Ven to fly with him in the six X-wings they still had available. Shiel, Dlarit and Celchu flew as opposition to those six in simulator runs while Qrygg's arm healed.<ref name="Rogue Squadron" />

[[File:Bror_jace.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Bror Jace scored the most kills at the Second Battle of Borleias.]]
The simulations proved tricky, but Horn and Jace stayed motivated by keeping up their contest with each other over who was getting more kills. With his mind on the following day's mission, Horn turned down offers from both Dlarit and Terrik to spend the night with them. Back at Borleias, the X-wings entered the world's atmosphere from a nearby [[Blackmoon|moon]] with [[Ablative heatshield|ablative sheathes]] fitted over their noses, giving them the appearance of [[Meteorite/Legends|meteorites]] burning up on entry. While Two and Three Flights dealt with approaching TIEs, Antilles and Horn approached the power conduit, although they ended up dealing with their own TIE fighters. Horn lost his auxiliary fuel pod during an aerial duel, forcing him to get clear after he and his Rogue Leader both missed their first passes at the conduit. Left alone, Antilles destroyed a [[HAVw A5 Juggernaut|Juggernaut]] [[assault vehicle]] and used the [[Fire/Legends|fire]] from its burning hulk to get eyes on the conduit. He blew his target, but his subsequent order for the Rogues to head home was complicated by the sudden disappearance of Horn.<ref name="Rogue Squadron" />

Horn was, in fact, taking out two TIE interceptors that he had spotted making an approach on the ''[[Devonian]]'', the shuttle that was ferrying Page's Commandos to the surface. The move deprived him of his remaining fuel, prompting Antilles to order him to ground on the lunar surface while the rest of the squadron drew two waves of interceptors to the [[Pyria|sunny]] side of the moon. The squadron quickly compared their kill counts, celebrating Darklighter's new status as an [[Ace/Legends|ace]], and then Horn hid his craft in a frozen [[Magma/Legends|lava]] tube on the side of a volcano. When he realized that the interceptors searching for him would find him before his friends did, he began to fire his torpedoes. Meanwhile, the other five Rogues dispatched of ten interceptors before reaching critical fuel levels and jumping to lightspeed; as Antilles hurriedly planned a rescue mission for Horn, he realized that the lieutenant had breached his emotional armor and become a friend. That mission proved unnecessary when Horn was rescued by the ''Pulsar Skate'', piloted by Terrik and Celchu&mdash;the two had discovered a potential security breach and followed the Rogues to Borleias after getting its location from Emtrey.<ref name="Rogue Squadron" />

Back at Noquivzor, the Rogues celebrated their victory, although Jace was less than enthusiastic to learn he had gotten the most kills after Emtrey notified him of a serious illness in his family. He was granted leave to return home to Thyferra,<ref name="Rogue Squadron" /> but he was feared dead when X-wing debris was discovered on his route home. The remaining Rogues relocated to Borleias, and over the following month, delegations from current and potential members of the New Republic frequently stopped by. The squadron's work schedule largely consisted of routine patrols of those ships, with the occasional turning back of prodding Imperial vessels. A small [[Skirmish near Borleias|skirmish]] occurred at the end of the month when the modified [[Dwarf Star-class freighter|''Dwarf Star''-class freighter]] ''[[Vengeance Derra IV]]'', sent by the Imperial Warlord [[Zsinj]], arrived with four TIE fighters and two TIE bombers. The freighter fled to lightspeed after its TIEs were taken out by Horn and his backup, the Y-wings [[Champion Five]] and [[Champion Six]].<ref name="Wedge's Gamble">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref>

Captain [[Aril Nunb]] and Lieutenant [[Pash Cracken/Legends|Pash Cracken]] arrived on Borleias and were added to the Rogues' roster, and the New Republic prepared to move toward the core and capture Coruscant from its new strategic position. A tip from Mirax Terrik sent eight Rogues, led by Captain Nunb, to [[Mrisst/Legends|Mrisst]], where ''Vengeance Derra IV'' had been spotted. The freighter was in the midst of a cargo transfer with the transport ''[[Contruum's Pride]]'', but it quickly scrambled TIEs to [[Battle of Mrisst (6 ABY)|attack]] its pursuers. Nunb's One Flight, with Horn, Ynr, and Dlarit, took care of the enemy fighters, while Two Flight brought down ''Vengeance Derra IV''{{'s}} shields with proton torpedoes. The Rogues then convinced ''Contruum's Pride'' to help stabilize the now-derelict and atmosphere-bound freighter, and the day was won. Soon afterward, Rogue squadron was selected to infiltrate the Imperial capital world and bring down its [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shields]].<ref name="Wedge's Gamble" />

====On the capital====
{{Quote|In rebuilding the squadron care was taken to choose the best individuals possible&mdash;both in the area of their flying skills and for a host of other skills. Rogue Squadron is uniquely qualified for this mission.|Admiral Ackbar, while planning the siege of Coruscant from the Empire|<ref name="Wedge's Gamble" />}}
[[File:HunterSquadron-TERC.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Rogue Squadron fly Z-95 Headhunters to take down Coruscant's planetary shields.]]
[[Borsk Fey'lya]] of the Provisional Council proposed an addendum to their plans: [[Mission to Kessel (Galactic Civil War)|Release]] members of Black Sun from the prison world of Kessel and reunite them with their criminal allies in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]], thus giving the Rogues unlikely but effective allies in their fight against the Empire. At Kessel, Lieutenant Page's commandos secured the landing zone, which allowed Antilles, Horn, and Ven to land while the rest of the Rogues remained on guard in the air. After meeting Lujayne Forge's [[Myda Forge|mother]] and [[Kassar Forge|father]] and negotiating with [[Administrator/Legends|Administrator]] [[Moruth Doole]], the three Rogues secured the services of sixteen criminals; in return for having them taken off his hands, Doole released 150 political prisoners to the New Republic. Tagging along with the criminals was [[Inyri Forge]], the rebellious younger sister of Lujayne, who was breaking her parent's [[Heart/Legends|hearts]] by cavorting with Black Sun member [[Zekka Thyne]].<ref name="Wedge's Gamble" />

After Kessel, the Rogues went into Coruscant in small cells of two or three, with Ven, Shiel and Darklighter riding in aboard Mirax Terrik's ''Pulsar Skate''. Antilles and Cracken rode the [[Dairkan Starliner]] ''[[Jewel of Churba]]'' in disguise, while Horn and Dlarit concurrently traveled aboard its exclusive ultra-deck. Once on-world, Antilles and Cracken rendezvoused with Iella Wessiri, now working for New Republic Intelligence, while Horn and Dlarit met up with an agent named Rima who was later revealed to be Winter. The Rogues gained an ally in [[Asyr Sei'lar]], a Bothan from the [[Alien Combine]] group, but Aril Nunb was captured by General Evir Derricote when the Combine was raided by Imperials. Horn began to distrust Celchu after he thought he saw him meeting with [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] agent [[Kirtan Loor]], but when he rendezvoused with Antilles, he was told that [[Zsinj's Empire|Zsinj's forces]] had [[Battle of Noquivzor|attacked]] Rogue Squadron's base on Noquivzor and that Celchu had been killed. The attack prompted the Provisional Council to accelerate their invasion plans, and the motley crew of Rogues, NRI agents, alien rights activists, and criminals got to work.<ref name="Wedge's Gamble" />

Antilles had in fact secretly brought his Executive Officer in beforehand as backup, and although Celchu denied having met with Kirtan Loor, Horn's suspicion remained strong. When Darklighter suggested creating a [[Lightning (phenomenon)/Legends|lightning]] storm to bring down the planetary shields, the group hatched a plan to use a [[EVS Construction Droid|construction droid]] to gain access to an [[Orbital Solar Energy Transfer Satellite|orbital mirror]] [[SCC Number Four|control center]], which they could use to vaporize a [[Water/Legends|water]] reservoir and create a powerful enough storm. Antilles, Terrik, Wessiri, and Emtrey manned the construction droid while Winter, Darklighter, Qrygg and Celchu headed to the [[Subsidiary computer center|control center]], and Horn, Dlarit, Ynr, Cracken, Forge and Sei'lar [[Hunter Squadron (New Republic)|flew cover]] in Z-95 Headhunters that Celchu had procured. Despite resistance from TIEs, the gamble worked, and most of Coruscant's power stations were knocked out by the lightning. A final, stubborn station was destroyed by a concussion [[Missile/Legends|missile]] and a crashing TIE interceptor that was brought down by Horn, and the planetary shields dropped. A New Republic fleet arrived to [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|liberate]] the planet, but dirtside, Horn's [[Hunter Lead|headhunter]] lost throttle control and crashed.<ref name="Wedge's Gamble" />

The galactic capital was conquered with minimal resistance, with Antilles suspecting that Ysanne Isard had traded the world for her safe escape from it. Although Aril Nunb was found alive, the Rogue Leader was stung by the loss of Horn, especially when General Airen Cracken informed him that Celchu had been arrested for the man's murder. Among other suspicions held by New Republic Intelligence, Celchu had known the command codes for Horn's headhunter. In reality, however, Horn had been captured by Isard and brought to Lusankya.<ref name="Wedge's Gamble" /> Asyr Sei'lar and Inyri Forge were both added to Rogue squadron&mdash;Antilles would have been happy to recruit them after the aid they had lent to the mission, but he was resentful of the reality that they were political appointees. The same was true of [[Portha]], a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who was attached to the Rogues as a security detail. Horn's apparent death was used by the New Republic to rally more troops and raise overall morale, while Celchu, also blamed for the death of Bror Jace, was brought on [[Trial of Tycho Celchu|trial]] and defended by Nawara Ven<ref name="The Krytos Trap" /> in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].<ref name="NEC" />

Holding the galactic capital immediately proved troublesome for the New Republic, as the deadly [[Krytos virus]] began to ravage all non-human species who were on the world. Intended to weaken and divide the new government, it had been developed under Kirtan Loor, who had also remained on Coruscant to lead a [[Palpatine Counter-Insurgency Front]] under orders from Isard. She, meanwhile, stayed focused on breaking Corran Horn, putting him in the highest security area on ''Lusankya''. On Coruscant, Antilles told the Provisional Council that he was ready to resign his commission over Celchu's treatment, but Senator Organa convinced him to stay on and help battle the Krytos threat&mdash;Warlord Zsinj had recently seized a convoy of bacta traveling from Thyferra to Coruscant, and the medicinal substance was desperately needed in the fight against the virus. Although the entire squadron had rallied around Celchu's innocence, they agreed to [[Raid on Yag-prime|raid]] the [[Yag-prime]] [[Empress-class space station|space station]] where the bacta had been taken. Launching alongside Defender Wing, the Rogues captured their target with ease.<ref name="The Krytos Trap" />

[[File:Tycho-funeral.jpg|thumb|left|175px|The trial of Tycho Celchu eroded public trust in the New Republic.]]
Several members of the squadron reluctantly testified in the trial of their comrade, but the proceedings were placed on hold when the Provisional Council learned that the Rylothean [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[ryll kor]] could be used to combat the effects of the virus. Nawara Ven was deemed to be a necessary diplomat to negotiate with his fellow Twi'leks, and so all of Rogue Squadron were sent to Ryloth as brokering agents. After being ferried to the planet aboard the [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|transport]] ''[[Courage of Sullust]]'' and the ''Pulsar Skate'', the Rogues were immediately treated to [[Twi'janii|hospitality]] at [[Kala'uun Starport]] in the form of music and dancing, but the festivities were interrupted by the Twi'lek warrior [[Tal'dira]]. Although furious at the [[Koh'shak|starport master]] for leaving him out of the negotiations, he voiced respect for the warrior tendencies of their guests and took the initiative of offering them the spice they desired. Rogue Squadron later launched from Coruscant to the [[Alderaan system/Legends|Alderaan system]] to meet with Thyferra's [[Xucphra Corporation]] and obtain some bacta, but Zsinj's [[Iron Fist (Executor-class)|''Iron Fist'']] beat them to the rendezvous and destroyed the Xucphra transports.<ref name="The Krytos Trap" />

''Iron Fist'' left before the Rogues' arrival, but it left the strike cruiser ''[[Termagant]]'' to be [[Ambush at Alderaan|disabled]] by the Rogues. Several squadron members went on to provide commentary for a government report on the battle, which was made to counter Zsinj's own propaganda&mdash;the Warlord claimed his actions had been to save Coruscant's citizens from tainted bacta. As Ackbar and Antilles began preparing a task force to strike back at Zsinj, various members of Rogue Squadron found themselves entangled in others' schemes, with Borsk Fey'lya attempting to bring Asyr Sei'lar into his fold and Kirtan Loor arranging a clandestine meeting with Nawara Ven. Hoping to free himself from Isard, Loor told Ven he could prove that Celchu had never met with him if he would be guaranteed immunity from any New Republic prosecution.<ref name="The Krytos Trap" />

Despite his betrayal of Isard, Loor went through with a planned [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] attack on a [[bacta storage facility]] by the Palpatine Counter-Insurgency Front in order to assuage Isard's fears about him. The New Republic had nearly been brought to its knees by the virus and the concurrent bacta shortage, and public confidence in the government had been further eroded by Zsinj's destruction of the bacta convoy and by Tycho Celchu's trial. Although the latter had been intended to restore faith in the government, the prosecution's case had been weakened by Ven's spirited defense of his colleague and by all of the Rogues' public disgust with it. A chance to save face, and lives, was dealt to the government by wild card [[Fliry Vorru]], a criminal who was playing various sides against each other, when he sold Loor out and tipped Fey'lya off about the planned strike. Rogue Squadron immediately [[Mission above Imperial City|mobilized]] to fly cover for a commando force, and they made short work of the terrorists' airspeeders and AT-ST walkers in the air above [[Galactic City/Legends|Imperial City]].<ref name="The Krytos Trap" />

The easy victory proved illusory, however, when TIE fighters and interceptors suddenly appeared to engage the Rogues, and a Super Star Destroyer blasted out of Coruscant's cityscape. The ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'', home of its namesake prison, had been hiding beneath the surface for years, and Isard was fleeing the planet after Corran Horn had escaped from her clutches. Although Horn burst into his own murder trial to declare Celchu innocent, an actual spy in Rogue Squadron's ranks was discovered when Erisi Dlarit boarded Isard's ship, claiming to be caught in a [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]]. Her ruse was revealed when her [[R5-series astromech droid|R5 unit]] reported contradictory data to Antilles, and she and the ''Lusankya'' escaped. In the following days, Rogue Squadron flew various pursuit and cover missions against suddenly abandoned and emboldened Palpatine Counter-Insurgency Front cells before finally learning of and destroying their safehouses. A ceremony was held to welcome back Horn and to publicly exonerate Celchu, but the joy was tempered by the revelation that Airen Cracken had known of Celchu's innocence all along, allowing the trial to go forth in order to lull the real spy into a false sense of security.<ref name="The Krytos Trap" />

[[File:IsardMad_copy.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Ysanne Isard, the target of the Rogues' guerrilla war]]
The ceremony also celebrated [[rylca]], a newly-developed cure for the Krytos virus synthesized from bacta and ryll kor. New Republic [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] publicly presented all of Rogue Squadron with the [[Coruscant Star of Valor]], a newly created award intended to be the military's highest possible honor. Luke Skywalker was a surprise attendee at the proceedings, revealing to the Rogues that Horn was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], but Horn turned down his offer to train as a Jedi in order to pursue Isard. An eavesdropping Councilor Fey'lya stated, however, that no action would be taken against her, as she had established a new base of power on Thyferra, and the New Republic could not interfere in a planet's internal politics. Eleven of the twelve Rogues immediately resigned their commissions<ref name="The Krytos Trap" />&mdash;the lone holdout was Pash Cracken, who wanted very much to join his comrades but was dissuaded by Antilles. As Pash's father was the head of New Republic Intelligence, Antilles felt that his participation in their planned guerrilla war against Isard would lead the public to believe that it was an official New Republic operation.<ref name="The Bacta War" />

====The Bacta War====
{{Quote|No choice at all Luke. We're, ah, we were Rogue Squadron. We do.|Wedge Antilles to Luke Skywalker on going after Ysanne Isard|<ref name="The Krytos Trap" />}}
Although the Rogues were kicked out of their former [[Rogue Squadron Headquarters|headquarters]], adoring private citizens were willing to donate their apartments and offices, and Pash Cracken offered the use of the Yag-prime space station as a staging area, as his new [[Cracken Flight Group|flight group]] had been assigned to patrol the [[Yag'Dhul system/Legends|Yag'Dhul system]]. Funding for their operation came from credits that Isard had placed in various accounts to help frame Celchu, and from selling the now-collectible Z-95 headhunters that had been used to liberate Coruscant. Both Mirax Terrik and Winter went to work on procuring suitable weapons. Also helping the Rogues was [[Qlaern Hirf]], a native [[Vratix/Legends|Vratix]] of Thyferra who played a large role in producing the planet's bacta supply,<ref name="The Bacta War" /> and who was the one responsible for synthesizing rylca, the cure to the Krytos virus.<ref name="The Krytos Trap" /> Hirf helped Winter brief the rogue Rogues about Isard's operation, which also included Fliry Vorru and Erisi Dlarit as major players.<ref name="The Bacta War" />

The group's plan was to eliminate the threat of Isard's four Star Destroyers, and their first step in that plan was sending Terrik, Horn, and Darklighter to Tatooine to procure an arms cache from Darklighter's uncle Huff. Additionally, sympathetic New Republic officials doctored some books in order to list all of the Rogues' former equipment&mdash;including their X-wings, astromech droids, and Emtrey&mdash;to be listed as missing parts and surplussed out to Yag-prime. Also arriving at Yag-prime were the squadron's [[Elscol Loro's anti-Imperial organization|old friends]] Elscol Loro and Sixtus Quin, who were eager to join their fight. When Loro suggested they kick off their campaign by making Isard angry, Rogue Squadron [[Raid on Thyferran Convoy Delta-Two-Niner|raided]] one of Thyferra's bacta convoys in the Chorax system.<ref name="The Bacta War" />

The convoy was defended by Z-95 Headhunters, TIE fighters, and TYE-wing uglies, but the Rogues made short work of them, with Celchu once again flying as a bona fide Rogue. Following the victory, Antilles convinced the [[Bacta Tanker]]s of the convoy to deliver their cargo to a bacta-strapped colony on [[Halanit]]. His next move was to infiltrate Thyferra itself, and he sent Horn, Loro, Quin, Mirax Terrik, and Iella Wessiri in on [[Mimban Cloudrider|one of]] the captured tankers. There, they met up with a very-much-alive Bror Jace, who had faked his death in order to organize a secret alliance between Thyferra's [[Zaltin Corporation]]&mdash;rivals of the Isard-controlled Xucphra&mdash;and the native Vratix's [[Ashern]] commandos.<ref name="The Bacta War" />

[[File:Corrupter-VSD.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''Corrupter'', a major thorn in Rogue Squadron's side throughout the Bacta War]]
Jace returned to Yag-prime with Terrik and Horn, while Wessiri, Loro and Quin remained onworld to work with the Ashern. Antilles gladly gave Jace back his old spot in Rogue Squadron, and his forces were additionally bolstered by the arrival of Tal'dira and a squadron of [[Chir'daki]] fighters. Intel from Jace sent the Rogues and the Chir'daki on another [[Ambush of the bacta tankers|raid]] of a bacta convoy, and they arrived in a [[Unidentified star system (red dwarf)|system]] with a [[Red dwarf/Legends|red dwarf]] to ambush three freighters whose course had been deviated thanks to Ashern slicing.
