Although defenseless, the Bacta Tankers were hesitant to surrender due to threats from Isard against their families, but Antilles quickly promised to entreat the Ashern to help save them.<ref name="The Bacta War" />

The ''[[Xucphra Rose]]'' quickly surrendered, and Horn, Qrygg and two Chir'daki escorted it to its new destination of Halanit. The ''[[Xucphra Meander]]'' followed suit, but an unconvinced ''[[Xucphra Alazhi]]'' prepared to fire on the ''Meander''. Darklighter and Shiel quickly disabled it, allowing Ynr, Forge, and two more Chir'daki to escort the ''Meander'' to Coruscant. Antilles finally convinced the crew of the ''Alazhi'' that he would do his best to protect their families, but the [[Victory II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory II''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Corrupter/Legends|Corrupter]]'' arrived on the scene and annihilated the remaining tanker. Riv Shiel and two Chir'daki were also lost in the melee, and the rest of Antilles's forces desperately jumped to lightspeed.<ref name="The Bacta War" />

Eventually, the Rogues managed to lure the Star Destroyer [[Freedom|''Avarice'']] to the New Republic, and they heavily damaged ''Lusankya'', making her surrender. Ysanne Isard was presumed dead, shot down by the Rogues as she tried to escape. Thyferra was liberated, and Rogue Squadron gained a pilot in Tal'dira. However, Nawara Ven became the Squadron's XO, never to fly an X-Wing again, for he had lost his leg and wasn't able to fly well enough with a prosthetic.<ref name="The Bacta War" />

====The hunt for Zsinj====
{{Quote|We're going to destroy them, Darillian. Annihilate them even more thoroughly than I destroyed Talon Squadron.|Admiral Trigit, planning the destruction of Rogue Squadron|<ref name="Wraith Squadron" />}}
Rogue Squadron's resignations were never documented by the New Republic&mdash;Leia Organa of the Provisional Council later explained to Antilles that they had been "creatively misfiled"&mdash;and while they were away, the government brought Klivian and Janson back from training duty to cobble together a temporary Rogue Squadron that could be visible for morale purposes. Their promised reward was a permanent return to the Rogues' ranks upon Antilles's homecoming. Rogue veterans like Will Scotian, [[Gayla Riemann]], [[Carithlee]], and several more were recruited for the auxiliary squadron, and its roster was rounded out by two pilots each from [[Gauntlet Squadron]] and [[Corsair Squadron]]. When Antilles's Rogues returned to Coruscant<ref name="Wraith Squadron" /> in 7.5 ABY,<ref name="NEC" /> Klivian's squadron flew up to meet them and informed them that [[New Republic High Command/Legends|New Republic High Command]] was broadcasting their arrival over the [[HoloNet/Legends|holonet]]. Taking on the "Red Squadron" designation out of respect, Klivian's group engaged the Rogues in a friendly contest of aerial maneuvers as they all descended to [[Imperial Plaza]].<ref name="Wraith Squadron" />

Antilles was whisked to a platform in front of an adoring crowd, where Organa spoke about his recent accomplishments, alerting the Rogue Leader to the fact that the Bacta War had been retroactively sanctioned as an official New Republic operation. A night of raucous celebration followed, with Rogues old and new partying together. It was Aril Nunb's last night with the squadron,<ref name="Wraith Squadron" /> as she planned to retain command of the [[Thranta-class War Cruiser|cruiser]] [[Valiant (Thranta-class War Cruiser)|''Valiant'']] that she had captained during the Bacta War.<ref name="The Bacta War" /> Antilles met with Admiral Ackbar the next morning to outline what he had planned for his immediate future: a new X-wing squadron with a full range of intrusion and subversion skills, that would operate as commandos first and pilots second, to serve in the New Republic's [[Hunt for Zsinj|hunt for Warlord Zsinj]]. He would act as the commander for both the new squadron and the Rogues, but he would personally lead the new group with Janson as his second-in-command. Celchu would take over as Rogue Leader, with Klivian as his second and Nawara Ven as his Executive Officer. Ackbar agreed, on the condition that if Antilles's plan failed, he would accept a promotion to general and join Ackbar's advisory staff. [[Wraith Squadron]] was thus born.<ref name="Wraith Squadron" />

[[File:Rogue_Squadron_Scalf.jpg|thumb|right|275px|Antilles' Rogues (left) perform aerial maneuvers with the ersatz Rogue Squadron in 7 ABY.]]
The ersatz Rogue Squadron was disbanded, its pilots and fighter craft returned to their original units. The X-wings of Antilles's Rogues were owned by Celchu, but Antilles had him loan them to the New Republic as part of the deal with Ackbar. They were sent to ''Home One'' for repairs and new paint jobs, where Antilles spoke with Celchu and laid out the Rogues' next mission: they would openly join the hunt for Zsinj while the Wraiths would do so more covertly. First, however, a simulation for both squadrons was put together of a recent [[Ambush at Gravan Seven|battle]] that had wiped out the New Republic's [[Talon Squadron (New Republic)|Talon Squadron]].<ref name="Wraith Squadron" />

Although the Wraiths impersonated the Rogues on occasion as part of their covert ops, Rogue Squadron didn't actually join the campaign until General [[Edor Crespin]] put them in a task force with ''Home One'', two frigates, and a number of A-wings, which he sent to Talasea to await Zsinj's Admiral [[Apwar Trigit|Trigit]]. Wraith Squadron, however, were able to [[Battle of Talasea|take out]] Trigit's [[Provocateur|two]] [[Constrictor|ships]] before the task force had a chance to join them. Trigit himself had avoided the battle after realizing it was a trap, and after the Rogues and the Wraiths caught up with each other on Talasea's surface, Wraith Squadron's [[Garik Loran|Face Loran]] learned that Zsinj and Trigit planned to deal a blow to the New Republic by destroying its legendary Rogue Squadron.<ref name="Wraith Squadron" />

Posing as the [[Zurel Darillian|captain]] of the captured Imperial corvette [[Ession Strike|''Night Caller'']], Loran had been in communication with both Trigit and Zsinj, who ordered him to spring a [[Battle of Ession|trap]] for the Rogues at the planet [[Ession]]. Convinced that the Rogues were tracking ''Night Caller'', Zsinj had his Star Destroyer [[Implacable (Star Destroyer)/Legends|''Implacable'']], commanded by Trigit, lie in wait with the corvette on [[Ession's primary moon]]. Rogue, [[Blue Squadron (New Republic)|Blue]], and [[Green Squadron (New Republic)|Green Squadrons]] entered the [[Lucaya system|system]] concealed inside the [[Super Transport VI|Super Transport]] ''[[Red Feathers]]'', bursting out from it just after an escape pod containing the Katarn Commandos subtly slipped out. While the commandos made their way to Ession's surface to sabotage TIE fighter launch tubes and deny Trigit reinforcements from dirtside, Wraith Squadron launched from ''Night Caller'' and joined the corvette in firing on the unsuspecting ''Implacable''. Meanwhile, Rogue, Blue, and Green Squadrons kept the Star Destroyer's TIE complement busy.<ref name="Wraith Squadron" />

After taking a beating, ''Implacable'' recalled its TIE fighters, which were chased by the X-wings of the Rogues and the A-wings of the Blues while the Y-wing bombers of Green Squadron took care of the now-grounded TIEs down on Ession. Reaching the Star Destroyer in time to rescue the Wraiths from overwhelming odds, Rogue and Blue Squadrons joined in a massive dogfight, with Rogue Two saving Loran from a pursuing TIE. The New Republic's fighters were still massively outnumbered, but the Rogues' coordinated skill in particular began eating away at the enemy forces. Trigit abandoned his doomed ship, which subsequently crashed into the moon, but his forces only agreed to Antilles's ceasefire offer when a [[Tetran Cowall|man]] posing as Soontir Fel ordered them to. Trigit refused to surrender and attempted to flee in a TIE interceptor; he met his end from the proton torpedoes of the Wraith [[Myn Donos]].<ref name="Wraith Squadron" />

Following the battle, the Rogues were assigned to General Han Solo aboard the ''[[Mon Remonda/Legends|Mon Remonda]]'' alongside the B-wings of [[Nova Squadron/Legends|Nova Squadron]] and the A-wings of [[Polearm Squadron/Legends|Polearm Squadron]]. The [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|star cruiser]] patrolled the borders of Zsinj's Empire and jumped in whenever intelligence presented it with a good target to destroy, and the task force gathered data on the probable movements of ''Iron Fist'', Zsinj's Super Star Destroyer, which continued to elude them. Officially, the Wraiths were also attached to the ''Mon Remonda'', but their unique mission profile saw them spend considerable time away while [[Halmad campaign|operating]] their own [[Hawk-bat Independent Space Force|pirate band]]. Solo and Rogue Squadron assembled in one of the [[Star Cruiser/Legends|star cruiser's]] hangars to welcome the Wraiths when they finally did arrive onboard, with introductions made all around for the benefit of the squadrons' new members. Antilles then led a briefing about an intercepted signal from the planet [[Lavisar/Legends|Lavisar]], which revealed that the world held a detachment of Zsinj's elite [[Raptors]] and was possibly a part of the Warlord's financial empire.<ref name="Iron Fist">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref>

[[File:Zsinj-EC.png|thumb|left|200px|Warlord Zsinj, the target of Rogue and Wraith Squadrons late in 7 ABY]]
Antilles faced a dilemma: He suspected that Zsinj had leaked the signal in an attempt to gauge the New Republic's response, but he also felt that varying their usual routine would let Zsinj know they were on to him. Additional reports suggested the warlord had been leaking intelligence in order to get the ''Mon Remonda'' to attack worlds that were not actually his, leaving them battered and easy for conquest by his empire. With all that in mind, Klivian suggested they respond predictably to Lavisar but turn tail and run when engaged by the planet's defenses. Meanwhile, an intelligence team would land on-world and negotiate with the [[Carmal|governor]]. The plan was adopted, and during the [[Battle of Lavisar|operation]], Rogue Squadron waited in the [[Lavisar system/Legends|Lavisar system's]] outermost [[planetary ring]] in case Zsinj had set a trap. The mission went off without a hitch, however, and the lack of any engagement from Raptors confirmed that their presence had been a false lead planted by Zsinj. The Rogues and Wraiths returned to the ''Mon Remonda'', and shortly afterward, the Wraiths slipped back to their [[Hawk-bat Base|pirate base]].<ref name="Iron Fist" />

Zsinj was impressed by the so-called pirates and hired them to help raid the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] and steal the Super Star Destroyer ''[[Razor's Kiss]]''. As an engagement with him at [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] would be too costly, Antilles planned to ambush him after he absconded with his prize. The Wraiths returned to the [[Solo Fleet]] after the [[Battle of Kuat (Hunt for Zsinj)|raid]] and located the Star Destroyer with a tracking program they had planted on it, and the fleet quickly launched. In deep space, Rogue, Wraith, Polearm and Nova Squadrons all launched to [[Battle for the Razor's Kiss|engage]] both ''Razor's Kiss'' and ''Iron Fist'', and ''Mon Remonda'' positioned itself in front of the Star Destroyers, blocking a clean hyperspace jump. A frustrated Zsinj was forced to stand and fight, but the Wraith [[Shalla Nelprin]] swiftly destroyed the shield generators on ''Razor's Kiss'' from a captured TIE interceptor. Antilles led all four squadrons on a strafing run of the shieldless warship, with the X-wings unleashing proton torpedoes, and ''Razor's Kiss'' was handily taken out of the fight.<ref name="Iron Fist" />

Waves of TIEs poured from ''Iron Fist'', and Antilles ordered his four squadrons to concentrate on holding them off while taking shots at Zsinj's flagship whenever possible. Polearm and Rogue Squadrons flew into the enemy's midst to break off their inertia, while Nova and Wraith Squadrons hung back, and Garik Loran watched in awe as the Rogues broke into pairs and began to expertly carve up their targets. Among their foes was the Soontir Fel impostor and his [[Zsinj's impostor 181st Imperial Fighter Group|false 181st Imperial Fighter Group]]. While the ''Mon Remonda'' and ''Iron Fist'' exchanged barrages, other elements of the Solo fleet joined the battle, and General Crespin's A-wing led the Y-wings of [[Screaming Wookiee Squadron]] from the Nebulon-B frigate ''[[Tedevium]]'' into the fray. Zsinj recalled his fighters after losing his port-side shield projector, and the New Republic squadrons scored a number of kills with their parting shots, but ''Iron Fist'' had knocked out the ''Mon Remonda''{{'s}} engines and was able to jump to lightspeed. The battle was capped off with a big explosion as ''Razor's Kiss'' came apart.<ref name="Iron Fist" />

Not long after the battle, Antilles relinquished day-to-day command of Wraith Squadron to [[Brevet]]-Captain Loran and transferred back to Rogue Squadron, and flying under him were Celchu as Rogue Two, [[Pedna Scotian]] as Rogue Three, Klivian as Rogue Four, Tal'dira as Rogue Five, Darklighter as Rogue Six, [[Ran Kether]] as Rogue Seven, [[Koobis Nu]] as Rogue Eight, Horn as Rogue Nine, Qrygg as Rogue Ten, Sei'lar as Rogue Eleven, and Inyri Forge as Rogue Twelve. Nawara Ven remained their Executive Officer, and Koyi Komad their mechanic. Antilles announced the change to both squadrons during a briefing at [[Sivantlie Base]] on Coruscant while ''Mon Remonda'' was undergoing repairs, and he also revealed that the Wraiths would remain on active duty aboard the cruiser unless another prolonged field mission arose. Rogue, Wraith, Polearm and Nova Squadrons all launched from the newly-repaired flagship of the Solo fleet when it arrived at [[Levian Two]], where [[Beta Sector|dirtside agents]] informed them they had just missed a Raptor raid.<ref name="Solo Command">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref>

[[File:Solo_Command_by_Chris_Trevas.jpg|thumb|right|300px|General Solo commanded Rogue Squadron from the ''Mon Remonda'' during the hunt for Zsinj.]]
A huge force of enemy ships, including ''Iron Fist'', suddenly [[Battle of Levian Two|emerged]] from hyperspace, outnumbering Solo's armada of the ''Mon Remonda'', fellow Mon Calamari Star Cruiser ''[[Mon Karren/Legends|Mon Karren]]'', ''Tedevium'', and the [[Marauder-class Assault Corvette/Legends|''Marauder''-class corvette]] ''[[Etherhawk]]''. Solo immediately summoned his fleet's Group Two, but Zsinj had his own reinforcements, and their abrupt arrival prompted Solo to flee in order to live and fight another day. Escorting the B-wings of Nova Squadron, the Rogues and the Wraiths returned to the Solo Fleet's Group One as it cruised toward ''Iron Fist'' on its way out of the system. They salvoed ''Iron Fist''{{'s}} port engines with proton torpedoes, and Nova Squadron fired their ion cannons, prompting Zsinj to recall his starfighters for protection. Now free from TIE harassment from all sides, ''Mon Remonda'' and ''Mon Karren'' flew close together and concentrated their shields against ''Iron Fist''{{'s}} turbolaser barrages, keeping themselves protected enough to survive the last bit of distance to their jump site.<ref name="Solo Command" />

====Closing in====
{{Quote|Wraith Squadron has an admirable history of executing missions on its own, with minimal support&hellip; or no support at all. Let's assume that Zsinj has come to this realization. What we're going to do is change the rules on him. The Wraiths will be going in with their usual tactics&hellip; but they'll have a little support standing ready. By which I mean Rogue Squadron.|Wedge Antilles, changing the game on Warlord Zsinj|<ref name="Solo Command" />}}
Back aboard the ''Mon Remonda'', the Rogues and the other pilots brooded over the fact that Zsinj had figured out their response patterns well enough to be waiting for them, and with a fleet larger than their intelligence had known he could field. A plan was hatched to use a fake ''Millennium Falcon'' and be the ones to bait Zsinj for a change, but in the meantime, the ''Mon Remonda'' would break away from the larger fleet and [[Mission to Saffalore|pursue]] a lead at [[Saffalore]]. Antilles explained the roles of Rogue and Wraith Squadrons at a briefing: They would create a [[Comet/Legends|meteor]] shower from an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] in the [[Saffalore system/Legends|system]] and hide behind it on their way to Saffalore's surface, where the Rogues would set up base camp as the Wraiths investigated a [[Binring Biomedical Product]] facility. The insertion went off smoothly, and the Rogues concealed their landed X-wings with [[Camouflage net|camouflage covers]] near the capital city of [[Lurark]] while the Wraiths proceeded to their target.<ref name="Solo Command" />

The lead turned out to be another trap of Zsinj's, and when the Wraiths finally punched through jamming and called for much-needed backup, the Rogues raced to their aid. Two Flight blew a hole in a tunnel to allow the trapped Wraiths to escape while One and Three Flights took care of [[Shrike Squadron (Saffalore)|TIEs]] from the local Imperial air base. Scotian and Qrygg skimmed along the city's rooftops and fed their sensor data to their squadmates, dropping to street level as soon as they were targeted. Their fellows then rose up from the streets and blasted away at the TIEs with the sensor data they had received. One and Three Flights then strafed the air base while Two Flight escorted the Wraiths out of the medical facility, and they returned to the ''Mon Remonda'', with the Wraiths badly beat-up and mostly not fit to fly. Consolation came in the form of Zsinj's Dr. [[Edda Gast|Gast]], whom the Wraiths had kidnapped from the facility.<ref name="Solo Command" />

The doctor knew about two of the warlord's [[Project Chubar|secret]] [[Project Minefield|operations]], and a furious Zsinj had [[Galey]], an agent of his on ''Mon Remonda'', attempt to kill and silence Gast. First, Galey used a codephrase to [[Project Funeral|activate]] the Rogue Tal'dira, as well as Polearm Two [[Nuro Tualin]]&mdash;another Twi'lek&mdash;as both were unknowingly brainwashed sleeper agents, part of a plan by Zsinj to strain relations between Humans and nonhumans within the New Republic. Meanwhile, ''Mon Remonda'' was hurtling toward the [[Jussafet system/Legends|Jussafet system]], on the border between Zsinj's space and the territory of the Empire proper, where Raptors had invaded [[Jussafet Four]]. The New Republic had intercepted a distress call that was sent to the Empire, and the Solo Fleet intended to go in first. Rogue and Nova Squadrons were assigned to purge the system's [[Jussafet asteroids|asteroid belt]] of Zsinj's forces while the Polerarms headed to the planet, but after they [[Battle of Jussafet Four|launched]], Tal'dira fired on Antilles while Tualin went on a suicide run against ''Mon Remonda''{{'s}} shields.<ref name="Solo Command" />

[[File:RogueSquadron-TEA.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The X-wings of Rogue Squadron]]
Horn managed to warn Antilles before Tal'dira's shots were fired, but the mad Twi'lek was still able to damage his commander's X-wing. Celchu slipped between the two craft, and as Tal'dira's brainwashing would only allow him to fire on Antilles, the Rogue Leader stayed out of harm's way until Horn reluctantly took out his Twi'lek teammate. The Wraith [[Tyria Sarkin Tainer|Tyria Sarkin]] meanwhile destroyed Tualin's fighter, and the mission continued despite the grimness of the situation. With Antilles transferring to Janson's X-wing, Rogue and Nova Squadrons blasted TIEs and a corvette out of the asteroid belt while the Polearms, the Wraiths, and landed soldiers took care of dirtside Raptors. Before they left the system, the Star Destroyer [[Agonizer (starship)|''Agonizer'']]&mdash;part of the Galactic Empire proper,<ref name="Solo Command" /> currently led by [[Ars Dangor/Legends|Ars Dangor]] at the head of a resurrected Ruling Council<ref name="Warfare" />&mdash;arrived and requested a meeting with Antilles. Brevet-Captain Loran was sent instead, and Admiral [[Teren Rogriss]] proposed to him that the Empire and New Republic cooperate in taking down Warlord Zsinj.<ref name="Solo Command" />

Solo accepted the offer, but the simultaneous attacks by the Twi'leks prompted a worried Provisional Council to suspend Nawara Ven, Koyi Komad, and the Wraith [[Dia Passik]] from duty. Antilles, devastated after delivering the news to them, called the Wraiths together for an informal speculation and planning session in the flagship's pilots' lounge, and Horn, Celchu, and Klivian attended from Rogue Squadron. There, they discussed ways to unequivocally prove that the attacks were Zsinj's doing and not an alien conspiracy against humankind. Horn and Emtrey also helped secure a fake ''Millennium Falcon'' from a scrapyard in the Corellian system, and the squadrons' spirits were lifted by a pair of parties: first, a welcoming back for Janson and and fellow Wraith [[Hohass Ekwesh]] from time spent in bacta tanks, and second, a day-long shindig organized by Solo and Antilles for the entire ship's complement. At the latter, names and rank insignia were forbidden, and pilots were required to bring their astromech droids to the festivities. The suspended Twi'leks were allowed to attend, and the [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] games, droid races, and dancing all helped boost morale shipwide.<ref name="Solo Command" />

Getting back to business, the Rogue and the Wraiths were briefed on their next assignment: a [[Raid on Kidriff 5|mission]] to Zsinj-held [[Kidriff 5]] in the fake ''Falcon'', dubbed the ''[[Millennium Falsehood]]''. While the rest of the Rogues waited in space with the Wraiths, Celchu would escort the ship to the surface as its pilots, Antilles and Chewbacca, dropped off a [[Bland One|pair]] [[Bland Two|of]] intelligence agents to meet with a pro-New Republic faction on-world. Antilles hoped to repeat the process on several other worlds to establish a pattern and attract the warlord's attention. The operation went smoothly, with Antilles waiting to depart until local forces detected him. Manning the ''Falsehood''{{'s}} [[Quad laser cannon|quad turrets]], he helped Celchu hold off two squads of pursuing TIEs until the Rogues and Wraiths arrived, and the only damage taken in the proceeding battle was to Koobis Nu's shields. Before the New Republic forces could jump to hyperspace, a shell-shocked Myn Donos learned that his fellow Wraith Lara Notsil was secretly [[Gara Petothel]], a former Imperial spy who had caused Donos's former command, Talon Squadron, to be destroyed. The proton torpedoes he fired at her were prematurely dedicated at the last second, and Petothel fled into hyperspace.<ref name="Solo Command" />

Antilles made the difficult decision to not discipline Donos, whom he deemed to have not been in his right mind, nor to discipline Loran, who had made the call to reveal Petothel's identity while the Wraiths were still in the air with weapons hot. Good news came to the frustrated commander from Dr. Gast, who recovered from her near-fatal incident and cooperated with the New Republic's quest to crack Zsinj's alien brainwashing operation. General Airen Cracken also reported that suggestions from the Rogues and Wraiths had helped foil two assassination attempts on Coruscant by [[Unidentified Sullustan (Zsinj's plot)|brainwashed]] [[Unidentified Bothan (Zsinj's plot)|agents]], and Antilles moved forward with the next stage of their campaign: hitting worlds that provided Zsinj with credits and materiel, while also continuing with the ''Millennium Falsehood''{{'s}} itinerary. Meanwhile, Intelligence would ferret out Zsinj-controlled businesses in New Republic territory, while Imperial Intelligence would do the same in their own space thanks to Solo's cooperation with Admiral Rogriss.<ref name="Solo Command" />

[[File:Celchu-Falsehood.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Tycho Celchu escorts the ''Millennium Falsehood''.]]
Rogue Squadron's first [[Raid on Belsmuth II|strike]] was at [[Belsmuth II]], where they and Nova Squadron decimated an academy for the warlord's pilots and officers. Over the next week, all four squadrons under Antilles's command executed mission after mission, sometimes flying two in a single day. Some missions required a squadron to fly alone, some required a squadron to escort and protect the Novas' B-wings, and some required a squadron to very publicly escort the ''Millennium Falsehood''. All of the pilots aboard ''Mon Remonda'' began to lose track of what day it was, but after one week, their missions and Rogriss's missions had cost Zsinj millions of credits. During a Wraith Squadron [[Raid on Comkin V|mission]] to [[Comkin V]] that destroyed the [[Reprisal (Dreadnaught-class)|''Reprisal'']], one of the warlord's [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|dreadnaughts]], Gara Petothel was seen [[Broadaxe Squadron|flying for]] the enemy, but her laser blasts transferred a message to the ''Falsehood''{{'s}} comm unit. She told them she was working on a plan to give them ''Iron Fist''{{'s}} location, and that the warlord expected the "''Millennium Falcon''" to next appear at [[Vahaba]].<ref name="Solo Command" />

While ''Mon Remonda'' hid in the [[Vahaba asteroid belt]], the ''[[Stellar Web]]''&mdash;an interdictor borrowed from Rogriss in order to trap ''Iron Fist'' in a gravity well&mdash;lurked nearby. Zsinj did indeed bring his flagship to the [[Battle of Vahaba|battle]], and as the Rogues and the rest of the fleet formed up, Solo dispatched the Star Destroyers [[Skyhook (Star Destroyer)|''Skyhook'']] and ''[[Crynyd]]'' to protect the interdictor. Antilles flew as Rogue Leader and led a group of starfighter squadrons to ''Iron Fist'', which kept its TIEs aboard, as Zsinj hoped to escape from the interdictor and jump to lightspeed as soon as possible. His ship had its own laser cannons, however, which prompted Antilles to organize his squadrons into a [[Trench Run Defense|trench run formation]] and [[Hull skimming|skim]] ''Iron Fist''{{'s}} hull. More than 200 starfighters battered away at its shields, and after running the gauntlet, they switched up their tactics to execute more standard strafing runs.<ref name="Solo Command" />

Zsinj was only able to escape the trap when his Star Destroyer ''[[Serpent's Smile]]'' took heavy damage; he ordered the ship be abandoned so it could collide with the ''Stellar Web''. Rogriss avoided the collision by reversing his ship's [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well generators]] to push at the oncoming ship, instead of pulling it in. ''Iron Fist'' took heavy damage from Antilles's squadrons throughout the battle, but many New Republic starfighters were also lost during their strafing runs. No Rogues were killed, although Klivian was disabled by an ion canon and Asyr Sei'lar was forced to eject. The remaining Rogues continued to attack the bow of Zsinj's flagship while ''Mon Remonda'', ''Mon Kerran'', and ''[[Mon Delindo]]'' came up on her stern. Zsinj, however, was now away from the interdictor, and he fled into hyperspace, leaving his Star Destroyer ''[[Red Gauntlet]]'' alone and forced to surrender. Solo despaired over losing his prey yet again, but after Rogriss said his goodbyes and departed with the ''Stellar Web'', a message came from Petothel: she had sabotaged ''Iron Fist''{{'s}} [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], stranding it in the [[Selaggis system/Legends|Selaggis system]] while its fellow ships continued unaware to their rendezvous point.<ref name="Solo Command" />

A desperate Zsinj put out a call for aid to any pirate groups that had helped him in the past, which included Wraith Squadron, whose pirate ruse had never been compromised. A modest number of his forces had not yet entered hyperspace from Vahaba and were able to join him as well, setting the stage for a tight [[Battle of Selaggis|engagement]] over [[Selaggis VI]]. There, the starfighter squadrons of the Solo Fleet formed up, with the Rogues and Wraiths flying in a task force led by Antilles. As they searched for ''Iron Fist'' within the planet's asteroid ring, Zsinj sent TIEs toward ''Mon Remonda''; Antilles's force began a careful descent into the asteroids as soon as their quarry was spotted by [[Polearm One]], [[Todra Mayn]]. Their assault runs were urgently broken off when Myn Donos felt deja vu from an old simulation&mdash;based off a real battle, the sim had seen ''Iron Fist'' wait for enemy squadrons to hop through an asteroid field before opening fire on the asteroids themselves, superheating them and turning them into bombs. With new orders to stay away from the larger asteroids, the snubfighters proceeded with their attack runs.<ref name="Solo Command" />

[[File:BattleofSelaggis.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Battle of Selaggis]]
Zsinj recalled his TIEs to deal with the New Republic starfighters, while the rest of his fleet emerged from hiding to engage Solo's capital ships. Meanwhile, a program designed by Petothel and her droid [[Tonin]] broadcasted diagnostic data for all of Zsinj's ships to Solo. When Zsinj confirmed that Rogue Squadron were among his assailants, he executed a plan to finally destroy them: he dispatched the impostor 181st fighter wing, hoping that Antilles would be drawn away from the fight by the promise of confronting Soontir Fel and learning the whereabouts of his sister. The gambit worked, as a suspicious Antilles, fresh off of vaping TIEs alongside Celchu, drew both the Rogues and Wraiths away from the dogfights to pursue the False 181st to [[Selcaron|one of]] the planet's moons. When the 181st's interceptors made a strafing run over some ruins, Antilles ordered his squadrons to engage on the slight chance that there were lives down there to protect. Meanwhile, Zsinj realized that he was outmatched, as Solo's secondary group of ships were holding their own against his forces while Solo's main group had not yet engaged. With his hyperdrive nearly repaired, the dejected warlord began issuing orders for his ships to flee at their discretion.<ref name="Solo Command" />

The Rogues and Wraiths broke into pairs to deal with the enemy interceptors over a rain-lashed moon, with Antilles and Celchu facing off against two pilots, one of whom they believed to be Fel. Celchu's X-wing was disabled after he flew through the exploding wreckage of "Fel's" [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmate]], but Antilles was able to send the surviving interceptor into a crash landing. Meanwhile, Corran Horn's Force senses revealed that the enemy duos they faced each included one [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid-piloted fighter]], allowing he and his fellows to decimate their foes after jamming the area to disrupt the droids' coordination. Antilles was disheartened when he confronted his prey on the ground and realized he was not the real deal; the imitator laughed at the Rogue Leader as three of Zsinj's new [[TIE/rpt starfighter|TIE Raptors]] closed in on them. Antilles was only saved from annihilation by Petothel, who arrived on the scene to destroy two Raptors while Antilles returned to his X-wing in time to smoke the third.<ref name="Solo Command" />

That third Raptor was able to take out Petothel's X-wing before its destruction, and a dispirited Antilles returned to his squadrons, who had been busy defeating Raptors of their own thanks to command from "[[Wraith Eight (callsign)|Wraith Eight]]," [[Voort saBinring|Voort "Piggy" saBinring]]. Back in the battle's primary theater, Solo captured or destroyed nearly all of Zsinj's fleet, but ''Iron Fist'' used explosive asteroids as a screen to put distance between itself and ''Mon Remonda''. It disappeared after entering Zsinj's [[orbital nightcloak]], and another ship, ''[[Second Death]]''&mdash;hidden in the nightcloak&mdash;detonated, leading Solo to believe that ''Iron Fist'' had been destroyed. With his empire in shambles, Zsinj fled to his secret [[Rancor Base]], and Solo's fleet returned to Coruscant.<ref name="Solo Command" />

En route, Antilles gathered the Rogues, Wraiths, and the few survivors from Polearm and Nova Squadrons together to give them some updates: First, a final transmission from Petothel had provided enough information to completely dismantle Zsinj's brainwashing project. Secondly, Rogue Squadron would be relieved from carrier duty and assigned planet-based duty in the near future, while the Wraiths would be recommissioned into an intelligence unit. Janson and Myn Donos both elected to transfer to the Rogues, and Donos received one more piece of news: a personal message from Petothel, who had survived and was now known as Kirney Slaine, extending an olive branch to him.<ref name="Solo Command" />

Upon his return to Coruscant in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> Solo [[Gambling|won]] a deed to the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] from a [[Drackmarian]] named [[Omogg]] in a game of sabacc<ref name="Courtship">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>&mdash;in reality, Omogg's people had been conquered by Zsinj, and she was subtly attempting to direct Solo to the warlord's secret base above that planet.<ref name="Warfare" /> A frustrated and love-sick Solo resigned his commission and took Leia Organa to Dathomir, where, after an adventure involving the [[Hapan]] Prince [[Isolder]] and the Force-sensitive [[Witches of Dathomir]], he came face to face with his foe. Following a pitched [[Battle of Dathomir (Hunt for Zsinj)|battle]], both Zsinj and ''Iron Fist'' were vanquished by the ''Millennium Falcon''{{'s}} concussion missiles and the [[Hapan Royal Navy]]'s proton torpedoes. Solo and Organa were soon [[Wedding of Han Solo and Leia Organa/Legends|married]],<ref name="Courtship" /> and the New Republic went on to seize much of the warlord's territory, culminating their [[Post–Zsinj campaigns|campaign]] with the [[Taking of Kuat|capture of Kuat]]. They now controlled three quarters of the settled galaxy.<ref name="NEC" /> Although Zsinj's orbital nightcloak was destroyed over Dathomir,<ref name="Courtship" /> it was not the only one produced, and at some point during the New Republic's reign, Rogue Squadron took out another nightcloak with one X-wing and a single proton torpedo.<ref name="Imperial Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>

====The last Grand Admiral====
{{Quote|Thanks for the warning; now get back to the ''Quenfis''.''"<br />"''Like blazes we will. Rogue Squadron: Let's go.|Han Solo and Wedge Antilles, the latter defying an order from Borsk Fey'lya at the ''Katana'' fleet|<ref name="Dark Force Rising">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref>}}
By the year [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], [[Imperial Space|Imperial territory]] had been reduced to a quarter of its former size, most of it in outlying sectors along the Rim, but when the brilliant Grand Admiral Thrawn returned from the Unknown Regions and reorganized the Imperial fleet, he began to [[Thrawn campaign|execute]] strategic raids along the Empire's border with the New Republic.<ref name="NEC" /> After a hit-and-fade [[Attack on Bpfassh|attack]] on the [[Bpfassh system/Legends|Bpfassh system]], Han Solo and the ''Millennium Falcon'' were sent to reassure the people of [[Bpfassh]] that their government was stil able to protect them, and Rogue Squadron were assigned to escort Solo and his twenty-ship convoy.<ref name="Heir to the Empire">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref> At that time, the Rogues were attached to Ackbar's office in the New Republic Provisonal Council and answered directly to the Admiral.<ref name="HTTE Sourcebook" /> Antilles was on-world with Han and Leia Organa Solo when Thrawn's [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] commandos [[Mission to Bpfassh|attacked]], and only Organa Solo's Force powers saved them from boarding a [[Millennium Falcon (fake)|decoy ''Falcon'']]. After Solo cut through the enemy ship's [[Coolant/Legends|coolant]] lines and released [[korfaise]] gas into the air, Rogue Squadron swooped in to protect them. The group's next assignment was escort duty to [[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van]], with their X-wings remaining aboard the frigate ''[[Larkhess]]'' as its undermanned crew hauled cargo from Coruscant. Outside of the [[Sluis Van Shipyards]], Antilles noticed a suspiciously empty [[A-class bulk freighter|freighter]] lurking nearby and ordered the Rogues to their fighters, but as soon as they were spaceborne the freighter blew up.<ref name="Heir to the Empire />

[[File:CloakSquadron-HTTE6.jpg|thumb|right|300px|TIE fighters surprise the Rogues at the Battle of Sluis Van.]]
Out from the explosion poured a [[Cloak Force|wave of TIE fighters]], concurrent with the arrival of an Imperial fleet. Rogue Squadron's only backup was the ''Millennium Falcon'', coincidentally also at Sluis Van, with both Skywalker and Calrissian among Solo's passengers. After he and Rogue Five took out some TIEs, Antilles was fired upon by a friendly Mon Calamari Star Cruiser that had a strange cone-shaped ship nestled against it, and he spotted another such ship being escorted through the [[Battle of Sluis Van|battle]] by four TIE fighters. The ''Falcon'' helped him polish those four off, and Solo revealed that the strange cones were [[Plasma-Jet Mole Miner|mole miners]], recently stolen from Calrissian's [[Nomad City|mining operation]] on [[Nkllon/Legends|Nkllon]]. The Imperials were using the miners to burrow into New Republic ships' hulls and commandeer them; without sufficient backup, Solo made it a priority to destroy whichever ones hadn't yet attached themselves to anything. After Antilles and Rogue Five took care of one miner's TIE escort, a [[Zero-G assault stormtrooper|space trooper]] popped out of the cone and impeded the ''Falcon'', leaving it to Antilles to take out the miner as well.<ref name="Heir to the Empire />

The battle came to an end when Calrissian used his command codes to activate every mole miner, which then cut through the lengths of their captured ships and left them all disabled. Denied their prizes, the Empire's Star Destroyers withdrew,<ref name="Heir to the Empire" /> but the New Republic military forces at the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] remained on full alert in the battle's aftermath.<ref name="Dark Force Rising" /> A new recruit of Antilles's around this time was [[Kenn Nitram]],<ref name="A Day at the Races">{{WEGCite|story=A Day at the Races|book=Dark Force Rising Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref> who flew as Rogue Three.<ref name="CSWE Rogue Three">{{CSWECite|III|107|Rogue Three}}</ref> Rogue Squadron were later back on Coruscant when Skywalker asked Antilles to gather them up and meet him at a spaceport; their X-wings were loaded into a transport for a five-day journey to the location of the lost [[Katana fleet]], which had been found by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] [[Talon Karrde]]. Joining them on the unsanctioned mission were a team of technicians, whom Karrde, Skywalker, and others hoped could get to the fleet before the ambitious New Republic [[Senator/Legends|senator]] Borsk Fey'lya did. At their destination, Rogue Squadron flew escort for the transport as it approached [[Katana|one]] of the Katana Fleet's [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaughts]] and unloaded a boarding team.<ref name="Dark Force Rising" />

Fey'lya arrived on the scene in short order aboard the escort frigate ''[[Quenfis]]'' and ordered the arrest of Skywalker's entire party. Antilles argued with Fey'lya over his comm, insisting that his orders had come from [[Councillor/Legends|Councilor]] Organa Solo, until Fey'lya's underling Captain [[Sarin Virgilio|Virgilio]] ordered him to surrender. Antilles was ready to refuse, even as the ''Quenfis''{{'s}} own X-wing squadrons bore down on the Rogues, but the arrival of the Imperial Star Destroyer [[Judicator/Legends|''Judicator'']] rendered the discussion moot. The Rogues immediately moved to cover the dreadnaught that Skywalker and Solo had entered, and the boarding team's technicians were able to bring the ancient ship's weapons online and into the [[Battle for the Katana fleet|battle]], but Fey'lya ordered his own squadrons to retreat. Only after Organa Solo and Karrde, who were aboard the ''Quenfis'', tricked Fey'lya into announcing that he considered military forces to be mere tools in his own political ascendency, did his forces abandon him and rally to Rogue Squadron's cause.<ref name="Dark Force Rising" />

The three New Republic squadrons were able to overwhelm the ''Judicator''{{'s}} [[F7 "Landing Brick" Drop-Ship|drop ships]], TIE fighters, and TIE interceptors, but a single drop ship made it through to cause trouble for Skywalker's team. As the Rogues did battle with more TIEs, both sides received reinforcements: several ships loyal to Karrde and several more loyal to former senator [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] for the New Republic, and the Star Destroyer ''[[Peremptory]]'' for the Empire. The ''Judicator'' fled after Solo used the dreadnaught's [[Slave circuit|slave rig]] to send one of the Katana fleet's other ships crashing into the ''Peremptory'' and destroying it&mdash;the victory was tainted, however, by the discovery that Grand Admiral Thrawn had already seized all but fifteen of the legendary fleet's dreadnaughts and was crewing them with [[Cloning/Legends|clones]].<ref name="Dark Force Rising" />

[[File:Battle_of_Qat_Chrystac.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Rogue Squadron were forced to retreat from Grand Admiral Thrawn's forces at Qat Chrystac.]]
One month into the ensuing war, Rogue Squadron were accompanying the ''Millennium Falcon'' on a diplomatic mission to [[Filve]] in a bid to reassure the anxious [[Filvian]] government, when Thrawn's forces suddenly [[Battle of Filve|attacked]]. Although they took out a wave of TIEs, the New Republic forces opted to flee from overwhelming enemy force and a stubbornly closed planetary shield. After drawing out their escape in a bid to give the Filvians more time to organize a defense, they were only able to jump to lightspeed with the help of a [[Cracken Twist]], which broadcasted false jump coordinates to any eavesdropping Imperials. The Imperial [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Joruus C'baoth]], obsessed with capturing Organa Solo and her unborn [[Twin/Legends|twins]], subsequently broke off the attack and chased the false coordinates to a dead end. A later [[Battle of Qat Chrystac|battle]], fought at [[Qat Chrystac/Legends|Qat Chrystac]] under General Bel Iblis's command, was a massive fleet engagement between the Empire and the New Republic. Antilles was annoyed when Bel Iblis forbade Rogue Squadron from aiding the outmatched star cruiser ''[[Orthavan]]'', but the general in fact needed them in position to draw a group of TIE fighters into the path of a surprise [[A-wing Slash/Legends|A-wing slash]]. The technique was small consolation, however; after an Imperial [[Interdiction field/Legends|interdiction field]] went down, the New Republic forces were forced to retreat from a superior foe.<ref name="The Last Command">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>

Back on Coruscant, Antilles and two of his pilots helped covertly escort a ship full of Noghri warriors to a landing pad at the behest of Skywalker, Solo, and Organa Solo&mdash;the aliens had recently switched sides and sworn fealty to Organa Solo.<ref name="The Last Command" /> Meanwhile, the war against [[Thrawn's confederation]] continued to go poorly, as Antilles learned from Pash Cracken while catching up at a briefing led by Ackbar. He also learned that the New Republic would strike at the Imperial-held [[Bilbringi Shipyards]] to steal a [[crystal gravfield trap]], which was needed to clear out [[Cloaking device|cloaked]] asteroids that Thrawn had deposited over Coruscant. In order to plant false intelligence and deceive Thrawn into defending another crystal gravfield trap, this one at [[Tangrene]], Antilles spent some time with Janson and Klivian on a [[Unidentified planet (Dona Laza)|planet]]<ref name="The Last Command" /> located in the [[Dona Laza sector/Legends|Dona Laza sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Dona Laza]] [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]]|system=[[Dona Laza system/Legends|Dona Laza system]]|legends=1}}</ref><ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Dona Laza system/Legends|Dona Laza system]]</ref> While making themselves visible, they encountered [[Aves]], a lieutenant of Talon Karrde. Believing that Karrde would sell any information to the Empire, the Rogues hinted that Tangrene was their next destination.<ref name="The Last Command" />

Grand Admiral Thrawn anticipated the deception, however, and the New Republic task force was pulled out of hyperspace in the [[Bilbringi system/Legends|Bilbringi system]] by Imperial interdictors, well back from their target. Rogue Squadron [[Battle of Bilbringi (9 ABY)|dueled]] with TIE interceptors as their new goal became to simply stay alive.<ref name="The Last Command" /> By this point in Thrawn's campaign, the Rogue Roster was made up of Antilles, Celchu, [[Flight officer/Legends|Flight officer]] [[Lyyr Zatoq]], Klivian, Janson, Darklighter, Myn Donos, [[Khe-Jeen Slee]], Horn, Qrygg, Sei'lar, and Inyri Forge, and the entire squadron set to work destroying their foes.<ref name="Isard's Revenge" /> Opposing their task force were around two dozen Imperial Star Destroyers, eight interdictors, thirty of the ''Katana'' fleet's dreadnaughts, numerous ''Strike''- and ''Carrack''-class [[Light cruiser/Legends|light cruisers]], and a starfighter complement that boasted the 181st Imperial [[Fighter wing/Legends|Fighter Wing]]; flying alongside the Rogues were eleven Mon Calamari Star Cruisers, two [[Assault Frigate Mark I|Assault Frigates]], the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Freedom]]'', various escort ships, and squadrons of A-, B-, X- and Y-wings.<ref name="Warfare" />

As Thrawn gloated from the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] of his flagship, the [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']], Admiral Ackbar struggled to hold his star cruisers in combat formation, but Antilles and Celchu realized that a massive Imperial armada arrayed against them meant that the shipyards were not being defended. A sudden comm call from Aves surprised the Rogue Leader, as he learned that Karrde's [[Smugglers' Alliance]] was also there to steal the crystal gravfield trap. Aves asked if there were a particular combat area Antilles wanted him to shoot up while he escaped from the melee with the prize, and Antilles suggested he knock out the nearby [[Golan II Space Defense SpaceGun|Golan II defense platforms]], which would allow a New Republic incursion into the shipyards. As Aves's people got to work,<ref name="The Last Command" /> the Rogues began to fire sustained salvos of proton torpedoes at the Golan, which overwhelmed its shields and allowed two [[Tyrant's Bane|Assault]] [[Liberty Star|Frigates]] to swoop in for the kill.<ref name="Isard's Revenge" />

[[File:Golanassault-TLC6.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Antilles plans an assault on two Golan platforms during the Battle of Bilbringi.]]
As Rebel fighters poured into the shipyards, a suddenly less-confident Thrawn<ref name="The Last Command" /> was forced to re-deploy some of his forces,<ref name="Warfare" /> but his end came suddenly from the [[Knife/Legends|knife]] of his Noghri [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] [[Rukh/Legends|Rukh]], who was avenging Thrawn's betrayal of his people.<ref name="The Last Command" /> Word of his death spread to the panicking Imperials, and the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} Captain [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Pellaeon]] ordered a retreat.<ref name="Warfare" /> Unable to comprehend what they were witnessing, Rogue Squadron were ordered back to ''Home One''. There, Ackbar informed Antilles of what had happened before insisting he finally accept a promotion to general, as the other Rogues had been following his lead and refusing overdue promotions of their own. Additionally, with a general at their head, Rogue Squadron could use their experience in the Bacta War and play a leading role in The New Republic's plan to [[Hegemony theater|liberate]] the Ciutric Hegemony from Imperial Warlord Delak Krennel.<ref name="Isard's Revenge" />

====Empire's end====
{{Quote|I say let the Imperials keep coming, because every time a new admiral crawls out of the Outer Rim or some Imperial goon finds a lost superweapon, Rogue Squadron gets a new starfighter. Seems like a good deal to me.|Wedge Antilles|<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>}}
The New Republic took one of the Ciutric Hegemony's outlying planets, [[Liinade III]] and then prepared to attack Ciutric itself, the capital planet of the Hegemony, while simultaneously looking for clues that would lead to the remaining ''Lusankya'' prisoners. One of them, [[Urlor Sette]], unexpectedly turned up at a party for the squadron, but when Corran Horn recognized him and said his name, an implanted device killed Sette. The Squadron went on a mission to Commenor, finding some of the prisoners and learning that Isard might be alive.<ref name="Isard's Revenge" />

During the attack on one of Krennel's outlying planets, Horn was shot down. He found a secret facility that showed evidence of a Pulsar Station, not unlike the Death Star, and the Rogues moved to attack it at a moon orbiting a gas giant, only to be ambushed. They were saved by two squadrons of [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defenders]], Stranger and Interloper Squadrons, under the command of Colonel [[Broak Vessery]], and taken to a secret base, having suffered the death of 2 pilots and the critical injury and presumed death of 2 more. Surprisingly, they met Ysanne Isard, who was responsible for their rescue. She revealed that the Isard they had thought they had killed was a clone, and she had survived to make herself a threat, and that all Isard wanted was her demise.<ref name="Isard's Revenge" />

[[File:Rogue_Squadron.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Rogue Squadron rec-room]]The squadron was trained to use TIE Defenders and then attacked Ciutric. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] attacked at the same time, killing Krennel in the ensuing space battle. The real Isard tried to recapture ''Lusankya'' at Bilbringi, but was shot and killed in the attempt by Iella Wessiri. The real Isard had already betrayed Rogue Squadron by not supporting them in their attempt to kill the clone Isard and rescue the rest of the ''Lusankya'' prisoners at Ciutric. Rogue Squadron was successful, however, and the clone of Isard was killed.<ref name="Isard's Revenge" />

While the New Republic was still celebrating their victory over Thrawn, the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] mounted a [[Second Battle of Coruscant|massive attack]] on Coruscant<ref name="A Change of Command">{{WEGCite|story=A Change of Command|book=The Jedi Academy Sourcebook}}</ref> in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].<ref name="NEC" /> Rogue Squadron covered the New Republic's retreat from the embattled world,<ref name="A Change of Command" /> with Antilles helping coordinate the evacuation.<ref name="DESB">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> Due to devastating losses in [[New Republic Army]] Command, Ackbar promoted him to general and transferred him to the [[Army/Legends|army]] as a figure around whom the [[Troop/Legends|troops]] could rally, but the two reached a compromise: Antilles would be his [[Fighter Command Liaison]] and would retain command of the Rogues, able to fly any missions that did not interfere with his new duties.<ref name="A Change of Command" /> He was also given command of a fighter wing, which he renamed [[Rogue Wing]].<ref name="DESB" /> Grown out of Rogue Squadron, it was composed of seventy-two starfighters over twelve squadrons.<ref name="CSWE Rogue Wing">{{CSWECite|III|107|Rogue Wing}}</ref> Meanwhile, an [[Imperial Civil War]] erupted within the leaderless Empire, and the New Republic took advantage of the confusion by sending their own captured Star Destroyers into war zones to stir up further chaos. The X-wings of Rogue Wing were aboard those Destroyers, and most were safely on the ''Emancipator'' when Antilles and the [[Liberator (Imperial I-class)|''Liberator'']] went down over Coruscant.<ref name="DESB" />

After escaping the still-raging battle in Coruscant's Imperial City, Antilles and Lando Calrissian were sent to the [[Battle of Calamari]], where Antilles coordinated the planet's air defense alongside General Bel Iblis.<ref name="DESB" /> [[Dac/Legends|Calamari]] was being ravaged by [[World Devastator]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]] under the command of Luke Skywalker, who had been turned to the dark side and was serving as the Empire's [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] under a [[Essence transfer|reborn]] Emperor Palpatine.<ref name="Dark Empire 3">[[Dark Empire 3|''Dark Empire'' 3]]</ref> Rogue Squadron was deployed into the battle, with Antilles piloting a [[V-wing airspeeder]] and Kasan Moor once again flying for the Rogues.<ref name="Rogue Squadron game chapter 4">[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron'']]</ref> The battle was finally won when R2-D2 beamed the Emperor's master control signal&mdash;given to him by Skywalker, whose dark turn had partially been a deep undercover ruse&mdash;into the World Devastators' control computers, which caused the massive machines to turn on and destroy each other.<ref name="Dark Empire 6">[[Dark Empire 6|''Dark Empire'' 6]]</ref>

Executing a plan conceived by Antilles to [[Battle of the Emperor's Citadel|infiltrate]] the [[Emperor's Citadel]], Rogue Squadron's X-wing fighters later hijacked a shipment of [[X-1 Viper]] [[Battle droid/Legends|war droids]] on board the freighter ''[[Hyperspace Roamer]]'' bound for the Imperial [[Throneworld/Legends|throneworld]] of [[Byss/Legends|Byss]], allowing New Republic agents, including Antilles himself, to stow away within the Vipers.<ref name="DEIIa">[[Dark Empire II (audio drama)|''Dark Empire II'' audio drama]]</ref> Although Palpatine managed to unite the feuding Imperial factions into a [[Dark Empire]], his [[Battle of Onderon (Galactic Civil War)|final death]] halted his [[Operation Shadow Hand|destructive campaign]] and saw the Imperial fleet again splinter into warlordism.<ref name="EC" /> With the Empire in ruins, the New Republic was able to retake Coruscant, with Antilles commanding Rogue Squadron during the siege.<ref name="EGTC Wedge">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]'' {{C|Wedge Antilles}}</ref>

[[File:Rogue_Squadron_CE4.png|thumb|right|300px|Rogue Squadron fights in the battle of Phaeda.]]
With secure control of the galaxy once more, the New Republic began to reassess its [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|military forces]] in the wake of the new and advanced weaponry the Dark Empire had used against them. Although Rogue Squadron was a nearly mythical name by this point, Antilles's superiors wanted it changed, and they ordered him to reconfigure it into a versatile unit composed of several different kinds of fighters, which they felt would allow for more flexibility in battle. Antilles's protests were overruled, and his distaste for bureaucracy prompted him to command the Rogues from afar, stationed on the bridge of the ''Lusankya''. Over one hundred fighters from a broad range of ships in ''Lusankya''{{'s}} hangars were available for Rogue Squadron alone, the new version of which saw its first round of action in the [[Battle of Phaeda]]<ref name="CE Handbook Wedge" /> in 11 ABY.<ref name="NEC" /> The Rogues arrived at the planet to defend its [[Phaeda New Republic outpost|New Republic outpost]] from the [[Steadfast (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Steadfast'']], a Star Destroyer of Lord [[Carnor Jax]]'s [[Crimson Empire]], in a squadron composed of E-wings, B-wings,<ref name="Crimson Empire 4">[[Crimson Empire 4|''Crimson Empire'' 4]]</ref> and A-wings.<ref name="CE Handbook Wedge" /> A diversionary force, Rogue Squadron kept the ''Steadfast''{{'s}} TIEs occupied until ''Lusankya'' emerged from hyperspace, and the Imperials were soon defeated. The ''Steadfast'' was captured and Phaeda was liberated,<ref name="Crimson Empire 5" /> and not long afterward, central Imperial leadership [[Battle of Ord Cantrell|collapsed]], and the Galactic Empire ceased to exist.<ref name="Atlas" />

Later in 11 ABY, the Rogues were once again a squadron exclusively composed of X-wings. They were assigned to [[Hunting/Legends|hunt]] for the [[Invids]], an elusive pirate group led by ex-Imperial Moff Leonia Tavira, who eluded every attempt by the New Republic to capture her. The Rogues found themselves with about a week of down time in between raids. On one [[Battle of Alakatha|raid]], they intercepted a group of Invid ugly starfighters in the [[K'vath system]] and easily disposed of them, capturing the modified bulk cruiser ''[[Booty Full]]''. The New Republic capital ships waiting just outside of the system were disappointed, however, that Tavira's Star Destroyer ''[[Invidious]]'' was not present. Squadron members flying under Rogue Leader Celchu included Corran Horn as Rogue Nine, Darklighter, Klivian, Janson, Qrygg, [[Reme Pollar]], [[Vurrulf]], and [[Ghufran]], but Horn left the squadron shortly afterward in order to train as a Jedi in a redeemed Master Luke Skywalker's [[New Jedi Order]].<ref name="I, Jedi" />

Horn ended up going undercover with the Invids during a hunt for his missing wife, [[Mirax Terrik Horn|Mirax]], and when the New Republic tracked the ''Invidious'' to [[Xa Fel/Legends|Xa Fel]] and [[Battle of Xa Fel (11 ABY)|attacked]], the Rogues were unaware that they were flying against Horn. Commanding [[Rock Squadron]], Horn dodged away from Darklighter but was forced to disable Qrygg's ship with an ion blast; he then narrowly avoided Celchu's proton torpedoes before escaping. He was eventually able to [[Battle of Susevfi|rescue]] his wife from the Force-sensitive [[Jensaarai/Legends|Jensaarai]], who had been helping Tavira anticipate the New Republic's strikes, and the threat of the ''Invidious'' was effectively neutralized. The Rogues removed the Invid-affiliated [[Khuiumin Survivors]] from their base on [[Courkrus]] and brought them to [[Susevfi]], where Celchu arranged for them to become the planet's new defense force.<ref name="I, Jedi" />

[[File:Roguesvsdoomgiver.jpg|thumb|275px|left|Rogue Squadron attacks the ''Doomgiver'' above Yavin 4.]]
In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> while Luke Skywalker was investigating the [[Valley of the Jedi]] on the planet [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]], he called on Rogue Squadron to help chase the forces of the the Dark Jedi [[Desann]] away from the site. Skywalker and his [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi trainee]] [[Kyle Katarn]] later [[Mission to Cairn Installation|infiltrated]] Desann's ''[[Doomgiver]]'' flagship, and Katarn sent a warning to the Rogues about the Dark Jedi's planned [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Empire Reborn)|attack]] on the [[Jedi Praxeum]] on Yavin 4. Above the jungle moon, the Rogues assaulted the carrier after Katarn sabotaged its shields, but Desann was still able to land on the surface with his ground forces. He was killed by Katarn in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], however, and Rogue Squadron destroyed the ''Doomgiver'' when Celchu took out its bridge.<ref name="Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]''</ref>

====An Empire restored====
{{Quote|Rogue Squadron's attached to Bel Iblis these days, isn't it?''"<br />"''You think Bel Iblis is up to something?''"<br />"''That walking sack of annoyance is always up to something.|Imperial agents [[Drend Navett]] and [[Klif]] in 19 ABY|<ref name="Vision of the Future" />}}
Although the Empire was dead, Imperial Admiral [[Natasi Daala|Daala]] [[Imperial Reunification|united]] the holdings of twelve Warlords sequestered in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] in 12 ABY, and Admiral Pellaeon then took her [[United Warlord Fleets]] to the galaxy's northern quadrant and absorbed various surviving Imperial Rim factions into a new government: the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].<ref name="Atlas" /> He quickly demonstrated the might of his new Empire with the [[Orinda campaign]], taking the Super Star Destroyer [[Reaper (Executor-class)|''Reaper'']] and the 181st Imperial Fighter Wing to [[Orinda/Legends|Orinda]] and [[Raid on Orinda|capturing]] it. He also took six systems coreward of Orinda along the [[Entralla Route/Legends|Entralla Route]], and the New Republic responded by sending in Rogue Squadron and the ''Lusankya'', commanded by General Antilles.<ref name="Warfare" />

As the two dreadnaughts stalked each other through the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], the Rogues clashed with the 181st in a series of strikes and parries, with the first engagements occuring in the [[Darkon system/Legends|Darkon]] and [[Traval-Pacor system/Legends|Traval-Pacor systems]]. The ''Lusankya'' and the Rogues won [[Battle of Darkon|both]] [[Battle of the Traval-Pacor system|battles]] against their counterparts, securing the systems, but the 181st fought the Rogues to a [[Battle of Orocco|stalemate]] at [[Orocco]] afterward. After the 181st [[Battle of Tyan|bested]] the ''Lusankya'' at [[Tyan]], the New Republic military sent Admiral [[Areta Bell]] and the [[Endurance-class fleet carrier|fleet carrier]] [[Endurance (Endurance-class)|''Endurance'']] to support their forces, and Pellaeon gradually fell back, [[Battle of Obredaan|losing]] to the combined New Republic forces at [[Obredaan]].<ref name="Warfare" />

[[File:LusankyavsReaper-EGW.jpg|thumb|right|325px|The Battle of Orinda]]
Although Antilles was merely hoping to destroy what he thought was the Empire's last Super Star Destroyer, Bell was under pressure to prove that starfighters, and especially her E-wings, were superior to dreadnaughts. Orinda played host to a [[Battle of Orinda|final showdown]], where Rogue Squadron and the rest of the New Republic forces engaged the ''Reaper'' and the 181st, and where Pellaeon sprang a trap. Six interdictor cruisers and the dreadnaught [[Dominion (Star Dreadnought)|''Dominion'']], commanded by Admiral Teren Rogriss, emerged from hyperspace and destroyed the ''Endurance'', along with the E-wing squadrons in its hold. As the ''Lusankya''{{'s}} shields became a sheet of flame, Antilles prepared to abandon ship, but when the Rogues punched a hole in the interdictor screen he was able to flee with them. The Remnant's southern borders were secured,<ref name="Warfare" /> but the New Republic fortified surrounding systems.<ref name="EC" />

A situation on the newly discovered planet of [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]] called for Antilles to return to the cockpit with Celchu, Janson and Klivian in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]]. The diplomatic envoys succeeded in bringing the neutral world to the New Republic, with the four pilots using Rogue Squadron markings on their X-wings while flying as "Red Flight" with the call signs Red One through Red Four. In the process, they found themselves [[Battle of Adumar|facing off]] against new 181st leader [[Turr Phennir/Legends|Turr Phennir]] and [[Unidentified 181st pilot|three]] [[Unidentified 181st pilot 2|of]] [[Unidentified 181st pilot 3|his]] pilots.<ref name="Starfighters of Adumar">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref> By the year [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]], Antilles was once again commanding Rogue Squadron,<ref name="Assault at Selonia">''[[Assault at Selonia]]''</ref> and in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]] the Rogues were assigned permanently to General Bel Iblis.<ref name="Vision of the Future" /> Although the Imperial Remnant was on its last legs, the Rogues still had no love for the Empire, and the fact that the New Republic's bureaucracy contained ex-Imperials was a particular sore spot for them. When Bel Iblis was sent to a [[Morishim New Republic starfighter base|starfighter base]] on [[Morishim]], Antilles, Celchu, and Janson ran into Lando Calrissian in a crowded marketplace on the surface, and the four learned some shocking news: a group of Bothans were responsible for the long-ago [[Caamas Firestorm|destruction]] of [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]].<ref name="Specter of the Past">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref>

They launched into space when an Imperial corvette and Star Destroyer [[Mission to Morishim|arrived]] in the system, but to their surprise, the Destroyer tractored the corvette and jammed its communications. The Rogues were helpless to save the smaller vessel, but from his [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]], the ''[[Lady Luck/Legends|Lady Luck]]'', Calrissian led them in diluting the jamming enough to receive a fragmented message from the corvette before the Destroyer jumped to lightspeed. Precisely which Bothan [[clan]] had been complicit in Caamas's destruction was unknown, but many New Republic member worlds began calling for retribution against the Bothans as a species, kicking off the [[Caamas Document Crisis]]. Ancient planetary rivalries began to resurface, and riots sprang up throughout New Republic space, including [[Combined Clans Center Building riot|one]] on [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] that was instigated by Imperial [[Vengeance (organization)|agents]].<ref name="Specter of the Past" />

[[File:Roguesquadronheadquarters.jpg|thumb|left|350px|Rogues at their Coruscant headquarters in 19 ABY]]
The agents were loyal to Moff [[Vilim Disra|Disra]], who had formed a [[Sinister Triumvirate]] within the Imperial Remnant and was conspiring against Pellaeon. The triumvirate was secretly goading the New Republic toward collapsing from within, while their Supreme Commander meanwhile intended to sue for peace&mdash;the corvette at Morishim, intercepted by Disra's forces, had been one of Pellaeon's overtures. The crisis continued, and Rogue Squadron were near [[Sif'kric]] when the native [[Sif'krie]] sent a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress call]] regarding their belligerent [[Frezh]]lik neighbors. Anticipating a large Frezhlik invasion fleet during the brief hyperspace journey, Bel Iblis's small task force was surprised to be greeted by an aged and ramshackle armada. Although the Frezhlik insisted their presence above the planet was peaceful, the Rogues realized they were using intimidation to [[Blockade of Sif'kric|blockade]] the planet and prevent the Sif'krie from exporting a harvest of [[pommwomm]] plants, which would soon spoil and rob the planet of twenty percent of its gross annual product.<ref name="Specter of the Past" />

Further attempts at diplomacy by Bel Iblis led to the Frezhlik [[Plarx|Speaker]] revealing that his people sought punishment for the Bothan government, while the Frezhlik did not. Frustrated that New Republic regulations prevented him from interfering in intra-system politics, Bel Iblis turned to Corran Horn, whose father-in-law Booster Terrik had business interests in the [[Mezeg sector/Legends|sector]]. When Horn ID'd a Sif'krie [[Hoopster's Prank|freighter]] as one of Terrik's, Bel Iblis allowed Rogue Squadron to investigate it under the pretense of a suspicion of smuggling. The Rogues barrelled straight through the Frezhlik formation on a direct route to their target, and the spooked Speaker ordered his [[Kruk battle-wagon|battle wagons]] to open fire. Bel Iblis coldly ordered his ships to overpower their attackers, and the task force next launched for [[Mengjini]], where a [[HoloNet relay/Legends|HoloNet relay]] had been taken down by dissidents.<ref name="Specter of the Past" />

As the crisis escalated, the government of [[Di'tai'ni]] requested Bel Iblis's help in settling a labor dispute on their world, which the Rogues realized was suspiciously close to the [[Both system]]. The general ordered them to sleep in their X-wings so as to always be ready to fly at a moment's notice, and sure enough, one week after their engagement at Sif'kric, they were woken up by a panic call from Bothawui. Arriving ahead of the rest of their task force, Rogue Squadron found an armada from the [[Leresen system/Legends|Leresen system]] arrayed against them, anchored by six capital ships. As two [[Leresai]] had been killed at the riot on Bothawui, they were demanding twenty Bothan lives in return, in accordance with Leresen law. Horn's Jedi senses warned him of danger if the Rogues' X-wings locked their [[S-foils/Legends|S-foils]] in attack position, and the reason why soon became clear: Two Leresen techs on Di'tai'ni had sabotaged their weapons systems. The squadron could only watch helplessly as the Leresai destroyed a small space station in orbit of the planet.<ref name="Specter of the Past" />

[[File:Corran-Wedge-Union.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Antilles and Horn in 19 ABY]]
The brewing schism in the New Republic saw warships from numerous member worlds arrive at Bothawui for a standoff&mdash;half of them were calling for Bothan punishment, while the other half felt as the Di'tai'ni did and had sprung to the Bothans' defense.<ref name="Vision of the Future" /> Further complicating matters was the apparent return of Grand Admiral Thrawn, who offered to sit down with Bothan clan leaders and discern who was responsible for Caamas, an offer that led to even more infighting within the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]].<ref name="Specter of the Past" /> When Antilles and Bel Iblis contacted Ackbar to request that their task force be sent to Bothawui to help keep the peace, the admiral regretted that the Senate and [[New Republic High Council|High Council]] would never allow it, and he instead ordered Bel Iblis to prepare for a raid on the Imperial [[Ubiqtorate base]] at [[Yaga Minor/Legends|Yaga Minor]]. Their goal was to find an intact copy of the [[Caamas Document]], which could reveal exactly which Bothan clans were to blame for Caamas's destruction. Although the [[Yaga Minor system/Legends|Yaga Minor system]] was one of the most heavily-defended locations in the known galaxy, New Republic [[President/Legends|President]] [[Ponc Gavrisom]] felt such a raid was necessary to prevent an all-out civil war.<ref name="Vision of the Future" />

Bel Iblis was ordered to move to [[Ord Trasi/Legends|Ord Trasi]], but he privately informed Antilles that the Rogues were technically attached to him, and not to his task force. Suspecting that someone, possibly the shadowy [[Vengeance (organization)|Vengeance]] organization, would take advantage of the chaos by disabling Bothawui's planetary shields, he sent Antilles and Horn to the planet's surface to prevent such a sabotage. They were able to gain some headway in their mission, but when Bel Iblis recalled them to the squadron, they left the completion of their task in the hands of [[Moranda Savich]], an agent of Talon Karrde's [[Car'das/Legends|organization]] with whom they had linked up while planetside. Rogue Squadron then attended a briefing aboard Booster Terrik's Star Destroyer, the ''[[Errant Venture/Legends|Errant Venture]]'', where Bel Iblis outlined his plan to steal the Caamas Document: Disguised as the Imperial Remnant's missing Star Destroyer ''[[Tyrannic]]'', the ''Errant Venture'' would pretend to be fleeing from a large New Republic task force. The Rogues and the rest of the task force would distract the [[Ubiqtorate/Legends|Ubiqtorate]] base's defense perimeter while Terrik and Bel Iblis, safely inside that perimeter aboard the ''Errant Venture'', attempted to get a team of slicers into the base.<ref name="Vision of the Future" />

Antilles and Horn realized that the two men did not expect to get out alive, but they quietly resolved to do all they could to save them. Unluckily for the New Republic, Disra was at Yaga Minor when they [[Battle of Yaga Minor (Galactic Civil War)|struck]], and the Moff immediately saw through their ruse&mdash;the ''Tyrannic'' was not in fact missing, but rather hiding under a cloaking device near Bothawui under the secret orders of Disra himself. He allowed the ''Errant Venture'' to enter the base's defense perimeter but immediately trapped it under a number of heavy-lift tractor beams. Outside the perimeter, Rogue Squadron and the rest of the attack force stayed far back, and they avoided taking any damage by staying at the edge of the kill zone of the base's Golan weapons platforms. When they saw Bel Iblis firing turbolasers at the tractor beams that had captured him, however, Captain [[Tre-na]] of the heavy cruiser [[Peregrine (Dreadnaught-class)|''Peregrine'']] ordered all forces to hit the base hard.<ref name="Vision of the Future" />

Before the Rogues could respond, Antilles was contacted by Talon Karrde, who claimed to have an Imperial code that could get him through the perimeter and a bargaining chip that could end the battle. He needed Rogue Squadron to escort his ''[[Wild Karrde]]'' through the New Republic's lines, and Antilles obliged, taking the Rogues across the perimeter to help destroy the tractor beams trapping the ''Errant Venture''. Karrde, having used the mysterious [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]] [[Monk/Legends|monks]]' [[Fold space]] technique to instantaneously travel there from the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]], picking up Admiral Pellaeon along the way, employed his Imperial code to safely dock in a hangar bay of the Star Destroyer [[Relentless (Dorja)|''Relentless'']]. Pellaeon confronted Disra on the bridge with a datacard, [[Hunt for Jorj Car'das|obtained]] in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] by Karrde, that exposed the supposed Thrawn as [[Flim (Human)|Flim]], an impostor. An exhausted and relieved Flim obeyed Pellaeon's orders and, in his final performance as "Thrawn," commanded all Imperial forces at Yaga Minor to cease fire.<ref name="Vision of the Future" />

[[File:Nicedayforawhitewedding.jpg|thumb|left|350px|Darklighter, Antilles and Celchu defend the wedding of Luke Skywalker and Mara Jade.]]
Concurrently, Skywalker, [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], and R2-D2 stole a copy of the Caamas Document from Soontir Fel while on a [[Mission to Nirauan]]. Pellaeon and Gavrisom swiftly signed a [[Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty|treaty]] that formally ended the Galactic Civil War.<ref name="Vision of the Future" /> Not long afterward, news of Skywalker and Jade's impending [[Wedding of Luke Skywalker and Mara Jade|wedding]] reached Rogue Squadron Headquarters on Coruscant,<ref name="Union 1" /> and several squadron members joined the groom-to-be for his bachelor party at the planet's [[Red Rancor]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]. They survived a bar-room brawl,<ref name="Union 2">[[Union 2|''Union'' 2]]</ref> but on the day of the ceremony they learned of a sabotage plan by a group of disgruntled ex-Imperials. Antilles quickly rounded up a team that included Celchu, Janson, Klivian, and Darklighter, and they were able to take out the attackers and their hired [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gangs]]. Imperial ringleader [[Derran Takkar]] slipped through their defenses and confronted the couple on the altar, however, but Skywalker was able to talk him out of downloading a [[Computer virus/Legends|computer virus]] into the New Republic's systems. The wedding continued as planned, and Skywalker and Jade became husband and wife.<ref name="Union 4">[[Union 4|''Union'' 4]]</ref>

====Invaders from beyond====
{{Quote|This won't even be close to a fair fight. Once we scrape fighter cover off the ground troops, we'll be slaughtering them as fast as we can. Scatter shots from the lasers may only burn paint from a fighter, but they'll broil a warrior in a second. It will not be pretty. What it is, though, is ''necessary''.|Rogue Leader Gavin Darklighter, preparing to protect helpless refugees from the Yuuzhan Vong|<ref name="Onslaught" />}}
Following the New Republic's peace accords with the Imperial Remnant, a number of Rogue veterans retired from the military, including Antilles, Celchu, Horn, Klivian, and Janson.<ref name="Onslaught" /> Celchu retired shortly after Antilles did, and he handed command of Rogue Squadron over to Gavin Darklighter,<ref name="CSWE Tycho">{{CSWECite|I|114|Celchu, Tycho}}</ref> a decision that he and Antilles had both made. Antilles's faith in Darklighter helped him during his early days as Rogue Leader, and he chose veteran pilots Inyri Forge and [[Alinn Varth]], Rogues Five and Nine respectively, as his flight leaders. Peacetime saw many young pilots shift their careers toward interstellar goods transport and its promises of lucrative pay, but Darklighter still faced the difficult task of weeding out many young recruits. By 25 ABY, members of his squadron included [[Kral Nevil]] as Rogue Two, [[Ligg Panat]] as Rogue Seven, [[Dinger]] as Rogue Eleven, and [[Tik (Rogue Squadron)|Tik]] as Rogue Twelve. They flew the T-65A3 version of the X-wing starfighter, which had been tested against pirates during peacetime.<ref name="Onslaught" />

When Leia Organa Solo appeared before the New Republic Senate with warnings of an [[Praetorite Vong|invading alien force]] in the Outer Rim, her pleas fell on deaf ears, but a [[Skipchaser|simulation]] was made of the invaders from data she had brought with her. Darklighter lasted a mere twenty-five seconds against an enemy [[Yorik-et|coralskipper]] fighter craft, while his commanding Admiral [[Traest Kre'fey]] failed in fifteen, as the craft was equipped with [[dovin basal]] vortices&mdash;miniature [[Black hole/Legends|black holes]] that could swallow laser blasts and take down enemy shields. Kre'fey decided to independently investigate the Rim, disguising his actions by having Rogue Squadron simulate pirate attacks. He thus would not be openly defying Chief of State Borsk Fey'lya, and he could give the Rogues complete freedom of movement. They traveled to the Rim aboard the [[Bothan Assault Cruiser]] ''[[Ralroost]]''.<ref name="Onslaught" />

[[File:GavinDarklighter-NEGTC.png|thumb|right|175px|Gavin Darklighter flew as Rogue Leader during the Yuuzhan Vong War.]]
In a [[Unidentified star system (Outer Rim)|nameless Outer Rim system]], Kre'fey deployed Rogue Squadron to an [[asteroid]] belt where a salvage freighter had recently reported contact with fighters of unknown origin. A group of uglies emerged from the asteroids, variously lacking shields, sensors, or fully-powered weapons, and the Rogues only [[Second skirmish in the Outer Rim|fought back]] against their outmatched foes with low-powered laser blasts. When the [[Privateer/Legends|privateers']] lead craft, the severely-damaged freighter ''[[Free Lance]]'', showed its face, Darklighter convinced its captain to surrender. Back aboard ''Ralroost'', the haggard and exhausted Captain [[Urias Xhaxin]] described his harrowing [[Skirmish in the Outer Rim|encounter]] with coralskippers, their miniature gravitic anomalies, and their [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] weapons, that his forces had only survived after a blind hyperjump away. Kre'fey overlooked the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Xhaxin in exchange for any knowledge he had on the new enemy, and a probe was sent to the site of his earlier battle.
