When its data proved inconclusive, a [[Snoop|reconaissance X-wing]] was launched instead.<ref name="Onslaught" />

Having spent most of their transit time running simulations against coralskippers, the Rogues flew cover for the recon craft. When six of the rock-like, organic coralskippers emerged from inside the ruined hulls of other ships, Rogue Squadron found themselves [[Third skirmish in the Outer Rim|facing off]] against the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] for the first time. One of Darklighter's proton torpedoes was straightaway swallowed by a coralskipper's miniature black holes, and so the Rogues switched over to a strategy they had devised in the simulator: firing successive cycles of short, low-powered shots that hit the coralskippers too quickly to all be caught by the gravitic anomalies, alternated with full-power quad volleys that could then punch through the distracted vortices. The Rogues also expanded their [[Acceleration compensator/Legends|inertial compensators]] to protect their own shields from the enemy's gravity weapons. Although their strategy worked, both Tik and Dinger were killed by one of the miniature black holes, a vortex from which Darklighter himself barely escaped, losing his shields in the process.<ref name="Onslaught" />

The ''Ralroost'' then escorted a convoy of [[Agamarian]] ships to Dubrillion, which was being harassed by the Yuuzhan Vong. Rogue Squadron were forced to beat back six coralskippers upon arrival, and over the next four days, the enemy forces in the system routinely sent out raids that Darklighter believed were designed to test the response times of their X-wings and the various other New Republic ships. Kre'fey met with Leia Organa Solo and Senator [[Elegos A'Kla]], who were there to see Lando Calrissian&mdash;in charge of a mining operation on the planet, he was spearheading the [[Evacuation of Dubrillion|evacuation]]. The Rogues were assigned to protect the Agamarian ships as they fled the system with [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]], with a full wing of Dubrillion residents backing them up in uglies, and Darklighter studied the locals' [[Lando's Folly|flying records]] in the hope of replenishing his depleted squadron. Despite his apprehension over putting the teenage daughter of one of his heroes in danger, Organa Solo convinced him to recruit her daughter, [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], a Jedi and an accomplished pilot. Jaina took over as Rogue Eleven with [[Anni Capstan]] as the new Rogue Twelve.<ref name="Onslaught" />

As the Agamarian convoy moved out of the system, Rogue Squadron, the uglies, and the ''Ralroost'' protected it from a Yuuzhan Vong [[Miid ro'ik|warship]]. While the Dubrillion squadrons battled the ship's attending coralskippers, the Rogues were assigned to the warship itself, designated [[Rock-One]]. The squadron's X-wings made a run over the warship's organic hull, firing on it and on the coralskippers still attached to it, while the warship shot balls of plasma at the fleeing refugees. Jaina quickly made a discovery: the dovin basal shielding on the tips of the ship's organic spines was relaxed just before the tips fired plasma, which made them vulnerable to attack for a brief window. Her astromech droid [[Sparky (droid)|Sparky]] let her know when that happened, and her proton torpedoes were able to do massive damage. Not so successful was the convoy's escape from the system, as the warship used its dovin basals to create a large gravity well right in their path. With the path to [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]] blocked, the ''Ralroost'' sent everyone along a different hyperlane to Dantooine. The New Republic forces escaped, but at least one evacuation ship was destroyed by the warship during the fray.<ref name="Onslaught" />

[[File:Leiaonslaught.jpg|thumb|left|200px|With Rogue Squadron's help, Leia Organa Solo sought to resettle refugees on Dantooine.]]
Organa Solo remained on Dantooine to resettle the refugees, as food and supplies were insufficient to carry them a far distance. Kre'fey returned to Coruscant to report to his superiors and secure additional aid. Darklighter, Calrissian, and some New Republic troops stayed on-world with Organa Solo, and the Rogue Leader had his squadron and the uglies establish a perimeter around her refugee camp. Also on-world were [[Solo family/Legends|Organa Solo's family]]: her Jedi sons [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]] and [[Anakin Solo]], her brother Luke Skywalker, and Skywalker's wife Mara Jade Skywalker. The four Jedi reported that Yuuzhan Vong troops had been landing on Dantooine, and Darklighter began to prepare for battle. The Rogues and the uglies planned their defense alongside the captains of the freighters that had carried the refugees, and during a briefing aboard Senator A'Kla's [[Impervious (shuttle)|shuttle]], Major Varth explained that the Rogues would team up with the ugly [[Savage Squadron]] to engage coralskippers and prevent them from providing ground support to their troops, while the ugly [[Tough Squadron]] would harry said troops. Solo suggested detonating proton torpedoes just shy of enemy dovin basals, in order to do some damage without the missiles being completely sucked in. Darklighter told the pilots that protecting the refugees was their top priority, even if it meant slaughtering Yuuzhan Vong [[Warrior caste|warriors]] with their ships' lasers.<ref name="Onslaught" />

As they waited for the [[Battle of Dantooine (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Dantooine]] to begin, the pilots put in time in simulators, while meanwhile, the presence of the Jedi gave hope to everyone at the refugee camp. After nightfall one day, Yuuzhan Vong ground troops began advancing toward the camp, and Rogue Squadron lifted off to engage two squadrons of coralskippers. Their scatter-shot technique helped them pick some of the fighters off; some of the Rogues also lent support to Tough Squadron as they harried the enemy ground forces, which included large [[Rakamat|organic]] [[Thrall herder|vehicles]] as well as [[Chazrach]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] soldiers. The line of warriors was simply too long, however, and even when A'Kla's shuttle and the freighters rose into the air to fire at them, they reached the camp. The Jedi and the New Republic troopers met them there in pitched combat. Skywalker soon commed Darklighter with a request: he needed two Rogues to launch four torpedoes simultaneously at one of the larger ground vehicles, using telemetry from A'Kla's shuttle to make the shot.<ref name="Onslaught" />

Darklighter and Jaina obliged, and the vehicle opened up a large black hole to absorb the torpedoes. From the shuttle, Skywalker opened himself to the Force and got a hold on the void; distracted by the approaching torpedoes, it was unable to prevent the Jedi Master from telekinetically causing the black hole to consume its own vehicle. The torpedoes then struck the ground and cut a large slice in the enemy lines. Rogue Squadron continued to assault those lines, but they were frustrated when some of their shots merely ricocheted off of the warriors' [[Vonduun Skerr Kyrric|armor]]. Half of the squadron's roster had been killed in aerial combat with coralskippers, with only Darklighter, Nevil, Forge, Varth, Capstan and Jaina surviving. Savage Squadron was meanwhile reduced to a single flight, and the Toughs were completely wiped out. The advancing Yuuzhan Vong finally proved too much for the defenders to handle, and with half of the refugees already slain, Organa Solo decided to evacuate aboard the freighters.<ref name="Onslaught" />

The remaining Rogues covered the freighters as they lifted off, but they found a Yuuzhan Vong warship interdicting them in orbit. The suddenly arriving ''Ralroost'' and the ''[[Corusca Fire]]'' hammered it with torpedoes and concussion missiles, forcing it to retreat, and the exhausted New Republic forces took the surviving refugees to Agamar before returning to Coruscant. There, Darklighter and Kre'fey found Chief of State Fey'lya and his [[New Republic Advisory Council|Advisory Council]] still unwilling to accept the significance of the new threat, and their response was to threaten a mass resignation of the entire New Republic military. Only with help from Organa Solo and Elegos A'Kla were they able to secure Fey'lya's provisional support, and the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] had officially begun. A dejected Darklighter was cheered by the sudden arrival of Antilles and Celchu, who were ready to aid him in the conflict,<ref name="Onslaught" /> and the two Rogue veterans began working with Jaina Solo and her Force senses to help choose new pilots for the squadron.<ref name="Ruin">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]''</ref>

[[File:Coralskipper-NEGVV.png|thumb|right|250px|Yuuzhan Vong coralskippers killed many members of Rogue Squadron.]]
The rebuilt Rogues' first mission was to help [[Battle of Garqi|insert]] several of Master Luke Skywalker's Jedi, including Jaina's brother Jacen, onto [[Invasion of Garqi|occupied]] [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]]. Antilles flew a recon X-wing designated [[Rogue Alpha]], and the squadron, launching from ''Ralroost'', kept enemy coralskippers busy while the freighter ''[[Lost Hope]]'' descended to the planet's surface. Although Jaina and Capstan destroyed the two enemy fighters that broke off to pursue ''Lost Hope'', the freighter blew up in a pre-planned explosion, which allowed the smaller shuttle [[Best Chance (shuttle)|''Best Chance'']]&mdash;secreted inside the freighter&mdash;to covertly land on the planet. Operational security had led to the maneuver being kept secret from Rogue Squadron, and Jaina only learned that her brother had survived the explosion upon returning to ''Ralroost''.<ref name="Ruin" />

Rogue Squadron continued flying simulations aboard ''Ralroost'', and the cruiser next launched for [[Sernpidal/Legends|Sernpidal]], which had been [[Destruction of Sernpidal|destroyed]] when the Yuuzhan Vong had [[Yo'gand's Core|crashed]] a [[Dobido|moon]] into it,<ref name="Ruin" /> with Chewbacca among the casualties.<ref name="NEC" /> Kre'fey suspected a nefarious reason for the world's destruction, and Rogue Squadron's reconaissance provided an answer: Yuuzhan Vong [[biot]]echnology was using chunks of the destroyed world to build an [[Shipwomb|organic shipyard]]. Back at Garqi, the Rogues helped extract the Jedi strike team, and they engaged a Yuuzhan Vong force while the ''Best Chance'' returned to ''Ralroost''. Flying alongside the Rogues were a squadron designated [[Hammer Group]].<ref name="Ruin" />

Rogue Squadron's proton torpedoes proved effective against coralskippers when two were fired in succession with the first programmed to detonate prematurely&mdash;when the coralskippers dedicated their dovin basals to propulsion rather than defense, thus escaping the first explosion, the second torpedo could sneak past their defenses. The tactic only worked until the tangle of dogfighting ships became too thick for precision firing, however. A pair of [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyers]] supported ''Ralroost'', but despite it all, the New Republic forces were outnumbered. The sudden arrival of Gilad Pellaeon in the ''Chimaera'' tipped the battle in their favor, as Organa Solo had recently visited [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]] to request the Imperial Remnant's assistance in the war.<ref name="Ruin" />

With Pellaeon was [[Force Spike]], a group of [[Nssis-class Clawcraft|Chiss clawcraft]] from Thrawn's Household Phalanx that cut through the coralskippers with ease. Their leader was Colonel [[Jagged Fel]], son of Baron Soontir Fel. Back aboard ''Ralroost'', Kre'fey and Pellaeon concluded that the enemy would attack [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]], as their biotechnology was vulnerable to the pollen from [[bafforr tree]]s that grew on both Ithor and Garqi. Pellaeon's TIE pilots proved less than equal matches to the Rogues in subsequent simulations, although Fel's squadron turned out to be deadly enemies. The colonel did not show himself until a reception aboard the [[Ithorian Herdship]] ''[[Tafanda Bay]]'', where he introduced himself to Jaina Solo. Unimpressed with his frankness were Borsk Fey'lya and the members of his Advisory Council, who had come to Ithor but were still suspected by the military of looking out for their own political interests.<ref name="Ruin" />

Rogue Squadron continued flying simulations in preparation for the defense of Ithor, while the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[High Priest/Legends|High Priest]] [[Relal Tawron]] granted the Jedi access to the normally-forbidden surface of the planet. Meanwhile, the evacuation of Ithor began. When the shuttle of Elegos A'Kla&mdash;who had earlier surrendered to the Yuuzhan Vong in order to learn more about what exactly they wanted&mdash;appeared in-[[Ottega system/Legends|system]] covered with [[yorik coral]], Jaina Solo and Capstan were scrambled to fly reconnaissance. It was then tractored into the ''Chimaera'', where it was opened to shockingly reveal A'Kla's [[Skeleton/Legends|skeleton]]. Not long afterward, the enemy fleet arrived, and the [[Battle of Ithor]] began.<ref name="Ruin" />

Rogue Squadron launched from the ''Ralroost'' and attacked Yuuzhan Vong [[Crate|landing craft]] in an effort to minimize the number of troops that could land on-world. Meanwhile, the capital ships of the combined New Republic&ndash;Imperial Remnant fleet faced off against the relentless enemy armada. Although the landing craft were slow and plodding targets for the Rogues, they were well-defended by coralskippers, and four Rogue pilots were killed, including Capstan. The squadron destroyed several of their targets, including ones headed for the ''Tafanda Bay'', but some of the landing craft were ultimately able to land on the Herdship.<ref name="Ruin" />

[[File:Corran-Ruin.jpg|thumb|left|225px|Corran Horn fought alongside the Rogues at the Battle of Ithor.]]
After the Jedi took out the Yuuzhan Vong's command center on Ithor's surface, Corran Horn contacted enemy Commander [[Shedao Shai]] via Yuuzhan Vong [[villip]] and negotiated a one-week truce. After that time, he and Shai would fight a duel, with Shai agreeing to leave Ithor alone if he lost. Heaps more Ithorians were evacuated during the respite, and after the week was up, Shai was slain by Horn in their duel. However, Shai's successor [[Deign Lian]] reneged on the agreement and sent a [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]] onto the planet inside twelve yorik coral pods. Kre'fey and Pellaeon responded by destroying Lian's [[Kor Chokk|flagship]], the ''[[Legacy of Torment]]'', but Ithor and its massive biodiversity were completely lost.<ref name="Ruin" />

In the wake of the disaster, Pellaeon was recalled to Bastion, Horn and the Jedi were villified by the media, and the New Republic military became subjected to senatorial oversight. Jaina Solo was deeply hurt by the death of Capstan, her wingmate, but Fel decided to keep two of his squadrons with the New Republic to liaise with Rogue Squadron.<ref name="Ruin" /> Jaina received temporary leave from the squadron four months after joining, and she visited her brothers at the Jedi Praxeum on Yavin 4,<ref name="Jedi Eclipse chapter 6">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos II: Jedi Eclipse]]''</ref> but she was back in action<ref name="Balance Point">''[[The New Jedi Order: Balance Point]]''</ref> at the beginning of [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]]<ref name="NEC" /> when the Yuuzhan Vong [[Battle of Kalarba|struck]] at [[Kalarba/Legends|Kalarba]].<ref name="Balance Point" />

====The New Republic falls====
{{Quote|We'd be willing to detach a squadron to support the Wild Knights on their mission&mdash;say Rogue?''"<br />"''Hisser, what do you think? Still want to try for that yammosk?''"<br />"''By all meanz. It would be an honor to hunt with Colonel Darklighter.|Wedge Antilles, Luke Skywalker, and Saba Sebatyne, before launching for Talfaglio|<ref name="Star by Star">''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]''</ref>}}
After [[Battle of Gyndine|conquering]] [[Battle of Tynna|such]] New Republic worlds as [[Gyndine/Legends|Gyndine]], [[Bimmiel/Legends|Bimmiel]], and [[Tynna/Legends|Tynna]], the Yuuzhan Vong used a dovin basal to pull Kalarba's orbiting [[Hosk Station/Legends|Hosk Station]] into a collision course with the planet. The stations's turbolasers and [[Zebra starfighter|defense force]] were vanquished, and the Bothan Assault Cruiser [[Champion (Bothan Assault Cruiser)|''Champion'']] led Rogue Squadron, Chiss clawcraft, and two squadrons of E-wings in fighting off the attackers as Kalarbans fled their doomed world en masse. Already a veteran of dozens of battles with the Rogues, Jaina Solo flew in a flight group under Major Varth and helped destroy enemy coralskippers, but when ''Champion'' lost its shields, its destruction caught Solo's X-wing and forced her to eject.<ref name="Balance Point" /> Bacta helped her heal from [[Magnetic field/Legends|magnetic field]] exposure, and when Major [[Harthis]] from Darklighter's office located her family, she joined them on [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] to complete her recovery. Meanwhile, the Yuuzhan Vong continued on from Kalarba and [[Battle of Druckenwell (Yuuzhan Vong War)|took]] [[Battle of Falleen (Yuuzhan Vong War)|both]] [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]] and [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]].<ref name="Balance Point" />

Solo took a leave of absence from the squadron while her [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] healed,<ref name="Conquest chapter 2">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory I: Conquest]]''</ref> which kept her out of a cockpit for months. Darklighter was reluctant to recall her to duty following her recovery, however, owing to her status as a Jedi&mdash;the Yuuzhan Vong [[Warmaster]] [[Tsavong Lah]] had, after the [[Battle of Duro (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Fall of Duro]], publicly promised that he would invade no more planets if all Jedi were turned over to him. Solo had additionally been involved in an unsanctioned [[Invasion of Yavin 4|evacuation]] of the Jedi Academy on Yavin 4, and to her disgust, Darklighter asked her to extend her leave of absence indefinitely in late 26 ABY. That same day, Rogue Squadron were on Coruscant, and they mobilized to protect Luke and Mara Jade Skywalker as the two Jedi Masters fled from a New Republic arrest warrant in their [[Horizon-class star yacht|starship]], the ''[[Jade Shadow]]''. Although Darklighter was angered by Fey'lya's actions against the Skywalkers, Luke managed to talk him out of risking his career, and the ''Jade Shadow'' ultimately made their getaway without the Rogues' assistance. Solo was nearby in her own X-wing to escort her aunt and uncle, and Darklighter took the opportunity to contact her and apologize, and to let her know that he still considered her a part of the squadron.<ref name="Rebirth">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]''</ref>

[[File:Jainainbactatank.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Jaina Solo, Rogue Eleven, heals in a bacta tank after the Battle of Kalarba.]]
When Solo tracked down the rogue Jedi [[Kyp Durron]] at her uncle's behest, he revealed to her that the Yuuzhan Vong were growing a [[gravitic superweapon]] within the remains of Sernpidal. With himself on bad terms with the New Republic military, he asked for her help in getting the news to them, and when she reached out to Darklighter a meeting was arranged with General Antilles on Chandrila. Antilles knew that a strike on the weapon would never receive Senate approval, but Solo and Darklighter's convictions were enough to convince him to use his influence to organize a volunteer fleet. Admiral Kre'fey and the ''Ralroost'' joined in the venture, and the fleet entered the [[Julevian system|Sernpidal system]] with the aid of an old interdictor he had been restoring. Rigged to explode when its shields reached twelve percent, the derelict ship took care of a number of the Yuuzhan Vong's defenses, and the resulting gravitic shift opened up a safe entry point from hyperspace for the volunteer fleet's forces. The [[Second Battle of Sernpidal]] began, with Solo flying once again with Rogue Squadron, serving under Alinn Varth in Three Flight alongside a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] named [[Lensi]] and a [[Rogue Ten (Second Battle of Sernpidal)|Twi'lek Rogue Ten]].<ref name="Rebirth" />

The Rogues and [[Kyp's Dozen]] entered the battleground first, with Durron leading his own squadron toward the superweapon while the Rogues worked on clearing the entry point of coralskippers for the arrival of their capital ships. Asteroids formed from Sernpidal's destruction floated everywhere, and Darklighter took One Flight through them toward a large unknown target that he designated "[[Wampa/Legends|Wampa]]." Two- and Three-Flights covered them, and Three Flight quickly found that the Yuuzhan Vong had caught onto their proven strategy&mdash;the Rogues' initial low-powered shots were being absorbed early, which freed up the coralskippers' dovin basal vortices to focus on absorbing the Rogues' subsequent full-power quad volleys. Solo compensated with additional volleys, which punched through, and by detonating proton torpedoes early, doing massive damage before they could be absorbed. The other flights were not so lucky, losing Rogues Three and Four to the enemy.<ref name="Rebirth" />

Solo and Rogue Ten both took damage to their engines, but the harried pilots received a reprieve when target Wampa blew. With it went the coralskipper's [[yammosk]] war coordinator, which allowed the Rogues to easily pick off the disarrayed enemy fighter craft. The ''Ralroost'', two corvettes, and a [[Heavy cruiser/Legends|heavy cruiser]] entered realspace then, ready to clear a path through more enemy ships to the superweapon. That path was not an easy one, with Rogue Ten lost to a collision with an asteroid and Alinn Varth taking major damage, but the newly-arrived capital ships managed to cut through a defense perimeter that had earlier taken out five of Kyp's Dozen. Antilles boarded an X-wing and joined up with the Rogues, being given command of an ad hoc Two Flight with Rogues Seven, Eleven, and Twelve. The next wave of Yuuzhan Vong attacks was the hardest-hitting one yet, however, launching suicide attacks against both starfighters and capital ships.<ref name="Rebirth" />

Once they understood what was happening, the remaining Rogues and Dozen fanned out and started picking off the suicidal fighters well in advance. The superweapon puzzled its foes when no attack came from it, and they were able to destroy it very quickly. Gazing at its wreckage, Solo realized it was not a weapon at all, and back aboard the ''Ralroost'', she confronted Durron while the rest of the pilots were celebrating. He admitted that he had lied and tricked the fleet into attacking a non-military [[Koros-Strohna|worldship]], hoping to send the Yuuzhan Vong the message that their civilians, too, were liable to be attacked. Disgusted that she had unwittingly proven herself no better than her enemy, Solo left the fleet to find the ''Errant Venture'', where her aunt, Mara Jade Skywalker, had recently given birth to a [[Ben Skywalker|baby boy]]. The arrest warrant for her and her husband had also been rescinded by Chief of State Fey'lya.<ref name="Rebirth" />

[[File:Secondbattleofsernpidal.jpg|thumb|left|175px|At Sernpidal, the Rogues were tricked into destroying a Yuuzhan Vong civilian worldship.]]
At the beginning of [[27 ABY]], two years into the war,<ref name="NEC" /> Rogue Squadron were rotating through Coruscant when General Antilles scrambled them to intercept the ''[[Sweet Surprise]]'', a smuggling vessel en route to the galactic capital about which Han and Leia Organa Solo had warned him. The Rogues brought their X-wings into Coruscant's skies and intercepted the suspicious ship, with Darklighter telling its crew that they were subject to a random military inspection. As the ''Sweet Surprise'' continued forward, Darklighter was ordered by General Rieekan, who had been placed in charge of the [[Coruscant Planetary Defense Force]], to prevent the vessel from entering the [[Mine/Legends|mine]] shell that protected the planet. The ''Sweet Surprise''{{'s}} attempt at pulling up prompted numerous mines to attack it, and the Rogues pursued it while warning other ships out of the now chaotic traffic lanes. When three Rogues blasted a docking breach into the disabled vessel's hull in order to board it, Organa Solo commed Darklighter from the ''Millennium Falcon'' to warn him of the possible presence of [[voxyn]], Jedi-killing creatures bred by the Yuuzhan Vong.<ref name="Star by Star" />

Darklighter reached [[Engineer/Legends|engineering]] and stabilized the ship's erratic flight path, but when a nearby [[Steady Lady|cruiser]] offered to take on its passengers, Darklighter found four voxyn blocking the [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]]. He commed Organa Solo for advice, and her husband brought the ''Falcon'' in close, allowing the creatures to sense her Force powers and spring into the ''Falcon''{{'s}} [[Docking tube/Legends|docking tube]]. There, they were taken out by [[Leia's lightsaber/Legends|Organa Solo's lightsaber]], blaster fire from her [[Adar|Noghri]] [[Meewalh|bodyguards]], and exposure to [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]]. The voxyn were not the only tool in Warmaster Lah's vendetta against the Jedi&mdash;before returning to Coruscant, Solo and Organa Solo had met with Yuuzhan Vong [[Executor (Yuuzhan Vong rank)|Executor]] [[Nom Anor]], who had told them that a refugee convoy [[Capture of the Talfaglio refugees|held]] in orbit around [[Talfaglio]] would be destroyed if the location of the Jedi's [[Eclipse Station|secret base]] was not revealed. When infighting within the New Republic Senate prevented any official aid from being sent, the Jedi took matters into their own hands and [[Operation Safe Passage|launched]] for Talfaglio.<ref name="Star by Star" />

Talon Karrde caught wind of the Jedi's plans and informed Generals Antilles and Bel Iblis, who arranged to take the New Republic Star Destroyers [[Mon Mothma (Imperial-class)|''Mon Mothma'']] and [[Elegos A'Kla (Imperial-class)|''Elegos A'Kla'']] on a shakedown cruise that just happened to pass by Talfaglio. Upon their arrival, they wasted no time in offering their help to Master Skywalker, whose Jedi fleet aimed to break the enemy blockade and give the refugee convoy time to escape. Antilles dispatched Rogue Squadron to help the Jedi [[Saba Sebatyne]]'s [[Wild Knights]] [[Yammosk Action|capture]] the Yuuzhan Vong's yammosk, and the Rogues launched with the Jedi fleet as it took point in [[T-65XJ3 X-wing starfighter|XJ3 X-wings]], [[Blastboat/Legends|blastboats]], and other support craft. Antilles and Bel Iblis, meanwhile, assumed crossfire positions on either side of the [[Talfaglio system/Legends|system's]] escape corridor. Kyp's Dozen were the first into the fray, disrupting the blockade by peppering enemy cruisers with [[Jedi shadow bomb]]s&mdash;the new weapons were proton torpedoes drained of propellant and armed instead with explosive [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]], armed with [[proximity fuse]]s and guided to their targets by use of the Force.<ref name="Star by Star" />

A path to freedom opened for the refugee ships as Yuuzhan Vong craft rushed at Kyp's Dozen from all directions, at which point the rest of the Jedi entered the battle. Meanwhile, the Wild Knights found the enemy's yammosk thanks to the efforts of [[Danni Quee]], a former [[Astrophysicist/Legends|astrophysicist]] who had been [[Battle of Helska IV|thrust]] into the war and was now developing methods of tracking and countering the yammosk war coordinators. The Rogues received its coordinates from Sebatyne and made for their target, with Han Solo's ''Millennium Falcon'' and Lando Calrissian's ''Lady Luck'' assisting, and Sebatyne ordered them to target the yammosk-housing cruiser with their torpedoes. As the Jedi, Antilles, and Bel Iblis had smashed through the blockade, the cruiser found itself all alone and prepared to [[Precision hyperspace jump|microjump]] away from the battle; unluckily for the Yuuzhan Vong, ''Mon Mothma'' and ''Elegos A'Kla'' possessed interdictor technology and blocked its jump. The Wild Knights disabled it with missiles, allowing Calrissian's [[YVH 1]] droids to board it: the still-intact yammosk was captured, the refugees were saved, and the day was won.<ref name="Star by Star" />

[[File:BattleOfCoruscantYuuzhanVongWar-TheNJOSourcebook.jpg|thumb|right|225px|The Fall of Coruscant]]
Back on Coruscant, the Rogues, Wild Knights, and some other veterans of the battle were invited to the [[Solo apartment]], where they watched the consequences of their actions play out on a live [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] feed of the [[Grand Convocation Chamber|New Republic Senate Chamber]]. The Senate was split between gratitude to the Jedi for saving so many civilian lives, and anger at them for taking matters into their own hands and risking Yuuzhan Vong retaliation. Senator [[Viqi Shesh]] of Kuat was the loudest voice speaking out against them, but the Jedi found an unlikely ally in Chief of State Fey'lya, whom Antilles revealed had secretly sent him and Bel Iblis to Talfaglio. Fey'lya pushed back against Shesh and revealed that he would henceforth direct the military to cooperate with the Jedi, news which the Rogues and Jedi pilots all cheered. Solo and Organa Solo were more skeptical, sussing out that Fey'lya was cooperating with the Jedi only to solidify his power base, by winning the favor of the Jedi supporters within the Senate.<ref name="Star by Star" />

Rogue Squadron were called into action not long afterward when a massive Yuuzhan Vong fleet arrived at the far edge of the Coruscant system and began to [[Battle Plan Coruscant|make its way]] toward the New Republic's capital planet. Rogue and Wraith Squadrons were aboard General Antilles's ''Mon Mothma'' in [[Fleet Group Three]] as the enemy slowly proceeded toward their target, screening their fleet with ships filled with captive civilian refugees. New Republic frigates, corvettes, cruisers and Star Destroyers fell by the dozens in desperate attempts to prevent the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Fall of Coruscant]], and Antilles eventually joined up with Traest Kre'fey's [[Fleet Group One]] and Bel Iblis's [[Fleet Group Two]] to surround the attacking fleet. Antilles offered the Rogues and Wraiths to support Master Skywalker in an attack on the various Yammosks that were coordinating the enemy action, and although several Yammosks were destroyed, Coruscant was ultimately lost.<ref name="Star by Star" />

While New Republic ships were busy fleeing the conquered planet, Rogue Squadron found themselves among a large group of X-wings pursuing a [[Trickster|Yuuzhan Vong frigate]]. The Solos, aboard the ''Millennium Falcon'', soon realized that their daughter Jaina was on the [[Ro'ik chuun m'arh|frigate]], as she and [[Myrkr strike team|some other young Jedi]] had just returned from a dangerous [[Mission to Myrkr|mission]] to kill the [[voxyn queen]]. Organa Solo broadcasted that information on an open hail, and the X-wings subsequently broke off their pursuit.<ref name="Dark Journey">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Journey]]''</ref> Several days later, with the chain of command in disarray, Rogue Squadron traveled with parts of Fleet Group Three to Borleias, which Antilles intended to [[Battle of Borleias (Yuuzhan Vong War; Second)|capture]] from the Yuuzhan Vong. By digging in and holding an important base so close to Coruscant, he hoped to accomplish four things: give the military a chance to catch its breath and take stock of what they had left; build morale after the loss of the capital; hold the Yuuzhan Vong's attention so others in the New Republic could regroup; and finally, use the [[Pyria system]] as a crossroads for refugees fleeing from Coruscant.<ref name="Rebel Dream">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines I: Rebel Dream]]''</ref>

====Stand at Borleias====
{{Quote|Rogue Squadron to Borleias. We're back. We kicked your butt twenty years ago. Now we're here to do it again.|Gavin Darklighter, just before capturing Borleias from the Yuuzhan Vong|<ref name="Rebel Dream" />}}
Above Borleias, Rogue Squadron were among a score of New Republic starfighters to deploy from Antilles's ''Mon Mothma'' as coralskippers rose up to meet them. Bolstered by frigates and destroyers, the New Republic forces were able to escort shuttles and [[Troop transport/Legends|troop transports]] to the surface, where further battle awaited. Due in no small part to Lando Calrissian's [[YVH-Series battle droid]]s, the enemy's [[Domain Kraal base|ground base]] was captured. Antilles knew that both the Yuuzhan Vong headquarters and the old [[Borleias New Republic base|New Republic base]] it had been built atop were washes, and so Gavin Darklighter and Kral Nevil gave a Rogue escort to Antilles's shuttle as the general went to inspect the old [[Alderaan Biotics]] facility. Six square [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] of surrounding jungle were promptly burned off, and Antilles had his base of operations. The next day, at a meeting of his senior officers, the general ordered Darklighter to keep the Rogues on high guard in orbit of the planet until further notice.<ref name="Rebel Dream" />

[[File:Xwingsatborleias.jpg|thumb|left|225px|Wedge Antilles and his close friends led the Rogues through the occupation of Borleias.]]
Corran Horn requested to rejoin the squadron, but he and various other friends and allies of Antilles were instead given assorted necessary tasks and positions. Darklighter was recalled to the surface on day three of the occupation to help welcome the New Republic Advisory Council, who arrived unexpectedly and claimed that Councilor [[Pwoe]] was the new Chief of State, following Fey'lya's death in the Battle of Coruscant. When Pwoe ordered Antilles to hold Borleias at all costs, he agreed on the condition that he would receive three months of supplies, control over any forces that were en route to join him, and lastly, the ''Lusankya''. Antilles and his allies suspected the councilors knew that holding Borleias was a pipe dream and simply wanted time to build up their own power, having completely given up on the New Republic. Nevertheless, Antilles intended to slow the Yuuzhan Vong by holding the planet as long as possible, shunning the Advisory Council's jurisdiction and fighting in the [[Insiders|style]] of the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="Rebel Dream" />

More elements of Fleet Group Three joined them on Borleias, and when Yuuzhan Vong forces arrived on the ninth day of the occupation, Antilles planned to let them take a sensor station on the [[Pyria VI's fourth moon|fourth moon]] of the nearby planet [[Pyria VI]]. His goal was to string along, for as long as he could, an enemy whom he assumed was an average commander of an average fleet. Rogue Squadron, the Wild Knights, and Luke Skywalker's [[Twin Suns Squadron]] blasted off to join the battle; the Rogues' job was to set up above Borleias's moon and make speed runs against any targets of opportunity. Although Horn flew with Twin Suns that day, the [[Kuati]] [[Volu Nyth]] was one of the Rogues' new pilots.<ref name="Rebel Dream" />

Midway through the battle, Antilles's plans were complicated by the arrival of the ''Lusankya'' and ''Millennium Falcon'', who emerged from hyperspace in the middle of the Yuuzhan Vong reserve forces. He redirected ''Mon Mothma'', the Rogues, and Twin Suns to assist the new arrivals and clear an escape path for them. One of Rogue Squadron's flight groups quickly cleared out four of the eight coralskippers that were harrying the ''Falcon'', which was being piloted by the Solos with the Jedi Knights [[Ganner Rhysode]] and [[Alema Rar]] stationed in its quad turrets. The Rogues quickly reached the ''Lusankya'' and started taking apart coralskippers and Yuuzhan Vong frigates, allowing the Super Star Destroyer to focus on ripping through the enemy fleet. With their yammosks already destroyed, the confused Yuuzhan Vong fleet continued to thin until its few remaining capital ships retreated.<ref name="Rebel Dream" />

Although the arrival of the Solos and their passengers&mdash;Jedi survivors of the mission to kill the Voxyn queen on [[Myrkr]]&mdash;cheered all of the forces on Borleias, Antilles regretted that his reluctant decimation of the Yuuzhan Vong fleet likely meant a newer and better enemy commander would be assigned to deal with them. Over the next week, squadrons of coralskippers launched from the captured moon of Pyria VI several times to test the New Republic's weaknesses, but Antilles was more concerned with news that the Yuuzhan Vong had become more adept at tracking refugee ships. Rogue Squadron joined a group led by Calrissian to investigate, and their X-wings were hidden inside a [[Cargo container/Legends|cargo container]] on the hull of the transport ''[[Jeolocas]]''. Fitted with a tracking device designed by Danni Quee, the ship was sent on several missions until the enemy decided to capture it.<ref name="Rebel Dream" />

When a Yuuzhan Vong frigate cornered the ''Jeolocas'', Alema Rar and a team of YVH droids handled the boarding party while Rogue Squadron launched from their cargo container and attacked the frigate. Its gravitic singularities swallowed their laser blasts but were overwhelmed by their proton torpedoes, and when it cracked in half, the Rogues returned to base. Quee's device failed to locate any kind of enemy tracking creature, leading Calrissian and Rar to conclude that refugees were simply selling each other out. Back on Borleias, Jaina Solo arrived with Kyp Durron and Jagged Fel, and the three pilots all joined Twin Suns squadron, with Jaina taking over command from her uncle. The Rogues also got a new member, as Corran Horn's transfer was finally made official. Around that same time, some of the Rogues converted one of the base's bio-reactor tanks into a [[hot tub]].<ref name="Rebel Dream" />

On the thirty-seventh day of the occupation, a Yuuzhan Vong worldship arrived in the Pyria system. Two days after that, all of the base's children were evacuated by the ''Millennium Falcon'', with an escort provided by Horn and Nevil. The rest of the Rogues participated in [[Starlancer Project|Operation Starlancer]], a psyop designed to trick the enemy into believing that the New Republic possessed a superweapon. The pilots deployed to Borleias's atmosphere in order to escort a [[pipefighter]] into space, with [[Blackmoon Squadron]], Twin Suns Squadron, and the Wild Knights doing the same. The four pipefighters created a network of laser fire that worked together to launch a larger, central beam toward the Coruscant system.<ref name="Rebel Dream" />

[[File:Landoandalemaatborleias.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Lando Calrissian and Alema Rar led Rogue Squadron on a mission from Borleias to protect refugee ships.]]
Each squadron defended its position from attacking coralskippers, but the plan was complicated when the Yuuzhan Vong's prime target was revealed to be Jaina Solo&mdash;whom many Yuuzhan Vong believed to be their trickster [[Deity/Legends|goddess]], [[Yun-Harla]]&mdash;and not the pipefighters. While Rogue Squadron dogfought their foes, Twin Suns Squadron meanwhile found themselves facing five times as many enemy fighters; the Rogues were only able to fly to the rescue after Jaina, Durron, and Fel had already survived a hectic showdown with fifty coralskippers and a [[Vua'spar interdictor|Yuuzhan Vong interdictor]]. The pilots returned to the surface, and the Rogue pilots landed in the special ops docking bay.<ref name="Rebel Dream" />

Over the following days, the four special operations squadrons that had flown in Operation Starlancer began to use a former incubation chamber as an informal lounge. A ground invasion by the Yuuzhan Vong came on Day forty-nine, and all four squadrons launched to defend the biotics building, with Rogue Squadron deployed to the base's south. Orbiting New Republic Star Destroyers supplied additional squadrons for the engagement. An overwhelming onslaught of coralskippers, rakamat siege creatures, and reptoid slave soldiers came against them, and the squadrons were gradually pushed back toward the base.<ref name="Rebel Dream" />

Rogue Squadron destroyed a frigate analog with proton torpedoes, but the kill barely made a dent in the enemy forces. When they were ordered to return to the airspace directly above the biotics facility, the area around the base was suddenly free of New Republic forces, and [[Operation Emperor's Hammer]] commenced&mdash;''Lusankya'' rained an orbital bombardment of turbolaser fire onto the Yuuzhan Vong.<ref name="Rebel Dream" />

===Galactic Alliance vets===
====Further deployments====
{{Quote|A minute ago, I just vaped a Rogue.''"<br />"''I did, too. Rogue Leader. A Duros named Lensi. A good man.|Syal and Wedge Antilles, flying for Rakehell Squadron|<ref name="Fury" />}}
In [[29 ABY]], the Rogues flew for the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances in the [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar]] that ended the war and forced the enemy to [[Sekot accords|surrender]]. Colonel Darklighter accepted a Fleet command and handed Rogue Squadron over to a new Rogue Leader.

In [[36 ABY]], the Galactic Alliance found itself caught in the midst of the [[Swarm War]] between the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] and the [[the Colony]]. Gilad Pellaeon, [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Force]], hoped to decimate the Colony's swarms of [[insectoid]] [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] at the Unknown Regions world of [[Tenupe]], but Jedi Master Luke Skywalker proposed a different plan: He would neutralize the Colony's Force‐sensitive [[Joiner]] leaders, [[Lomi Plo]] and [[Raynar Thul]]. Although the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]] would consequently face the Killiks without Alliance assistance and would take heavy casualties, Skywalker knew that the [[Hive mind/Legends|hive minded]] Colony would collapse without its leadership and bring a quick end to the war. The mere destruction of their fleet would simply prolong the conflict and prompt the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] to commit [[speciecide]] with their [[parasite bomb]] weapon.<ref name="The Swarm War">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref>

Rogue and Wraith Squadrons were assigned to support Skywalker as he made his way to the [[Admiral Ackbar (Victory-class)|''Admiral Ackbar'']], a [[Battle of the Murgo Choke|captured]] Star Destroyer where Thul and Plo were stationed. As they escorted the Jedi Master's [[Stomper One|shuttle]] through the [[Battle of Tenupe]], Alliance turbolasers brought down the target's shields and took out Killik [[dartship]]s. Proton torpedoes from the Alliance fighters destroyed more dartships, and the Rogues personally took care of the enemy starfighters that were launched from the ''Admiral Ackbar''{{'s}} hangar bays. A tractor beam from an Alliance Star Destroyer removed the remaining dartships, and Skywalker was able to board the target and achieve his objective. With the Killik threat removed, the Chiss Ascendancy agreed to not continue pursuing the war.<ref name="The Swarm War" />

[[File:Jainasolo.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Jaina Solo briefly served as Rogue Leader during the Second Galactic Civil War.]]
In the year 40 ABY, the [[Five Worlds]] government of the Corellian system came into conflict with the Galactic Alliance, and [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Cal Omas]] imposed a [[Blockade of Corellia|blockade]] of Corellia. Rogue Squadron were stationed with the [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]], and Jaina Solo, who had been prompted by the crisis to reenlist as an active starfighter pilot, served as a colonel<ref name="Bloodlines" /> and as Rogue Leader.<ref name="CSWE Rogue Leader" /> In XJ7 X-wing starfighters, the squadron flew patrol duty in the [[Corellian Exclusion Zone]] behind Colonel Jacen Solo of the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]],<ref name="Bloodlines" /> who had been given temporary command of the [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]]. Due to tensions between the Solo twins, they were unable to maintain a [[Force-meld|Force meld]] with each other and with fellow Jedi [[Zekk]]. Tensions between the three further escalated when Jacen ordered Zekk to turn back a water tanker that was attempting to supply some Corellian shipyards, an order to which both Zekk and Jaina objected on moral grounds.<ref name="Bloodlines" />

For three hours, the Rogues intimidated transports and supply vessels into turning around, albeit without firing any shots. When ships of the [[Corellian Home Fleet|Corellian defense fleet]] finally arrived, Jacen destroyed a [[Starfighter/Legends|Corellian attack fighter]] after it launched a missile at him, effectively firing the first shot of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. When the blockade reached its sixth day, capital ships from several worlds sympathetic to Corellia's cause arrived to lend aid to the bedevilled planet. To avoid a major confrontation, Jaina and Zekk were the only two Rogues to accompany Jacen in that day's harrying sortie, which saw a spirited [[Atzerri/Legends|Atzerri]] freighter nearly collide with both Solo twins. Jaina disabled both of its laser cannons but was nevertheless ordered to destroy it by her brother; as the vessel was civilian, no longer a threat, and had already begun to flee, Jaina refused the order. Her brother consequently took out the ship and immediately suspended Jaina from duty.<ref name="Bloodlines" /> When Jacen attempted to [[Court-martial/Legends|court-martial]] her, Zekk resigned his commission in Rogue Squadron, and he and Jaina instead dedicated their war effort to the Jedi Order.<ref name="Tempest chapter 2">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref>

By [[41 ABY]], Jacen Solo had become a co-Chief of State of the Galactic Alliance, and in that year he led a [[Battle of Centerpoint Station (Second Galactic Civil War)|strike]] at the Corellians' [[Centerpoint Station]]. Rogue Squadron launched from his flagship, the [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']], and soon encountered [[Rakehell Squadron]], a group of Rogue alumni and other veteran pilots that was flying for the Alliance-opposed [[Jedi Coalition]]. Aerial combat commenced between the two squadrons. As former Rogue Leader Wedge Antilles and his daughter [[Syal Antilles|Syal]], both flying for Rakehell, engaged in a dogfight with their enemies, Syal took out a Rogue and her father killed Lensi, the Rogue Leader. The Rakehells were not without losses of their own: the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Twool (Rodian)|Twool]], Rakehell Six, was killed, and [[Sanola Ti|two]] [[Cheriss ke Hanadi|more]] of their fighters were heavily damaged. The [[Confederation]], another party in the war, soon joined the fray when a Commenori task force reverted from hyperspace to support the Corellians, and the Rogues broke away from the Rakehells to engage the new threat. The battle came to an end when Centerpoint was destroyed, owing to sabotage from a Jedi strike team that had been escorted aboard the station by the Rakehells.<ref name="Fury" />

====A new rebellion====
{{Quote|Ho ho ho! You all right! Welcome to Rogue Squadron, Hondo Karr! Come! Andurgo give you ale! Brew it myself!''"<br />"''A drink's a drink.|Rogue pilots Andurgo and Hondo Karr, after a knife fight with each other|<ref name="Legacy 20" />}}
Rogue Squadron was still an active squadron in 137 ABY as the most elite of all of the squadrons in the Galactic Alliance Remnant. Although the Galactic Alliance had since [[Battle of Caamas|fallen]], Admiral [[Gar Stazi]] was leading its Remnant in a campaign of hit-and-run battles against [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]], that formed a large theater of the ongoing [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. The Rogues were stationed aboard the [[Indomitable (Scythe-class)|''Indomitable'']], a [[MC140 Scythe-class main battle cruiser|''Scythe''-class battle cruiser]] that served as the flagship of the [[Core Fleet|Galactic Alliance Core Fleet]], and were flying CF9 Crossfire starfighters.<ref name="LECG" /> The [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Jhoram Bey]] was Rogue Leader, and the squadron members included the [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] [[Ronto (Klatooinian)|Ronto]], the young and brash Human [[Anj Dahl]], the hot-headed [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Andurgo]], and the Mon Calamari [[Monia Gahan]], niece of former [[Triumvirate (Galactic Alliance)|Galactic Alliance Triumvirate]] member Gial Gahan. In 137 ABY, the former Mandalorian [[Hondo Karr]] joined the squadron, and he quickly got into a knife fight with Andurgo aboard the ''Indomitable''. After Commander Bey broke it up, Dahl and Gahan reported to Admiral Stazi that Gahan's uncle would help them capture the [[Imperious-class Star Destroyer|''Imperious''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Alliance (Imperious-class)|''Imperious'']] from [[Darth Krayt|Krayt's]] Empire.<ref name="Legacy 20" />

[[File:Knivesout.jpg|thumb|right|350px|Andurgo welcomes Hondo Karr to Rogue Squadron.]]
During the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Second Imperial Civil War)|Battle of Mon Calamari]], two members of Rogue Squadron fought not from their cockpits, as Monia Gahan sliced into the [[Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards]]' guns<ref name="Legacy 21">[[Legacy (2006) 21|''Legacy'' (2006) 21]]</ref> using codes provided by her uncle,<ref name="Legacy 20" /> and Karr led a task force that took control of the ''Imperious''{{'s}} bridge. Admiral [[Dru Valan]] of Krayt's [[Outer Rim Third Fleet]] let the captured ship escape so that he could focus on Stazi, but the Alliance Remnant fleet evaded him by moving to the far side of the planet-ringing shipyards. The Rogues took on incoming waves of [[Predator-class fighter|''Predator''-class starfighters]], flying interference and destroying several fighters, but Ronto was shot down and barely managed to get to an escape pod. From the [[Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer|''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Relentless (Pellaeon-class)|''Relentless'']], Valan obsessively closed in on Stazi while letting the rest of the Remnant ships escape, and Bey returned to the ''Indomitable'' to rescue an injured Stazi from his crippled flagship. When Captain [[Jaius Yorub]] refused to let Stazi, who had become a symbol of hope, pilot his ship on a suicide run, a punch to the admiral from Bey let Yorub take his commanding officer's place.<ref name="Legacy 21" />

Bey and Stazi, escorted by Dahl and Andurgo, jumped to hyperspace and made it safely back to the Alliance rendezvous point, while Yorub and the ''Indomitable'' took out one third of the enemy shipyards. Bey was promoted to captain and took Yorub's former position at Stazi's side,<ref name="Legacy 21" /> and Dahl became the new Rogue Leader.<ref name="Legacy 36" /> Three days later, Darth Krayt enacted retribution on the Mon Calamari by declaring a [[Genocide on Dac|genocide]] of the entire species, and Monia Gahan&mdash;trapped in Dac's [[New Coral City/Legends|New Coral City]]&mdash;witnessed the [[Massacre of New Coral City|execution]] of her uncle and scores more of her kin via hologram. Only the intervention of [[Imperial Knight]]s [[Treis Sinde]] and [[Sigel Dare]] prevented Gahan herself from being subdued by stormtroopers, as the two had sabotaged the ''Imperious'' before its capture and needed her help to warn Admiral Stazi. Gahan convinced them to also rescue Ronto and several other captive Alliance pilots, and Ronto piloted a [[Darth Azard's Nune-class shuttle|shuttle]] free of the besieged world while Treis Sinde stayed behind to [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|fend off]] the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Lord [[Darth Azard]]. Back aboard the ''Imperious'', the seeds of an alliance between the Galactic Alliance Remnant and the Imperial Knights' [[Empire-in-exile]] were planted, and Stazi defiantly renamed his new ship the ''Alliance''.<ref name="Legacy 22">[[Legacy (2006) 22|''Legacy'' (2006) 22]]</ref>

The alliance was tested in the [[Battle of Ralltiir (Second Imperial Civil War)|Battle of Ralltiir]], a joint operation between the Alliance Remnant and the Empire-in-exile, where each government fielded an armada in an attack on Darth Krayt's [[Coruscant Third Fleet|Third Fleet]]. Stazi's ships arrived first, and the Rogues were tasked with taking out an ion cannon on Ralltiir's [[Moon Twelve]] before it could set up a [[Force field/Legends|force field]]. Gahan and Andurgo quickly achieved their objective before moving on to target TIE predators. When Admiral [[Edouard Fenel]] showed up with the [[Bastion Second Fleet]] to aid Stazi, Krayt's Admiral [[Peto Kelsan|Kelsan]] surrendered to overwhelming enemy strength, but his subordinate Captain [[Vaclen Tor]] of the [[Ardent-class fast frigate|frigate]] [[Steadfast (Ardent-class)|''Steadfast'']] refused the order, vowing to deny so many captured ships to their foes. Buoyed by Tor's resolve, Kelsan ordered all ships of the Third Fleet to self-destruct, and an enraged Fenel instructed his forces to fire on the enemy escape pods. Stazi immediately placed his own ships, including Rogue Squadron, in between the rival Imperial fleets in a bid to prevent a massacre.<ref name="Legacy 36" />

[[File:Themissinglegacyrogues.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Rogues are briefed by Jhoram Bey aboard the ''Alliance''.]]
The ''Steadfast''{{'s}} escape pods and self-destruct mechanism had been damaged, however, and the Rogues flew cover for the frigate as Fenel launched his own TIE predators to destroy it. Unwilling to be treated as less than an equal in his alliance with Fenel's government, Stazi had his fleet lay down suppressing fire to ward off Fenel's starfighters, and a breakdown of the alliance was only averted when Stazi was able to contact [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] Emperor [[Roan Fel]] and remind him of their equality.<ref name="Legacy 36" /> Later, while the Galactic Alliance Core Fleet was stationed in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]], Captain Bey told the Rogue pilots of their next mission in a briefing room aboard the ''Alliance'': They were to [[Mission to Napdu|rescue]] a group of Mon Calamari refugees from [[Napdu]], a moon of [[Da Soocha]]. While the rest of the squadron waited a quick hyperspace jump away, Anj Dahl and Hondo Karr landed on Napdu to meet with their contact: the Hutt [[Azzim Anjiliac Atirue]].<ref name="Legacy 41">[[Legacy (2006) 41|''Legacy'' (2006) 41]]</ref>

Azzim arranged for his guards to [[Stun/Legends|stun]] the two Rogues at their landing site in order to fool potential Imperial spies, but he treated them cordially inside his [[Maya Armus]] spa as details were finalized. When the Mandalorian bounty [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Tes Vevec]]&mdash;Hondo Karr's ex-wife&mdash;suddenly dropped in and attacked Karr, he fended her off as Dahl contacted Rogue Squadron to execute the plan: protect a decoy [[YZ 3000 tanker]] from waiting bounty hunters while another tanker, in fact packed with refugees, made it to lightspeed safely. Dahl went back for her teammate, but Karr decided to leave the Rogues and team up with Vevec to pursue the Mandalorian traitor [[Yaga Auchs]]. One member short,<ref name="Legacy 41" /> the squadron continued serving Stazi, and during a quick reconnaissance flight over enemy-occupied Dac, they were horrified to discover millions of corpses floating on the surface of the water world&mdash;Krayt's Empire had expedited their planetary [[Speciecide|genocide]] by releasing [[viral spore]]s into the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]].<ref name="Legacy 47">[[Legacy (2006) 47|''Legacy'' (2006) 47]]</ref>

An enraged Andurgo launched his Crossfire at some nearby TIE predators, and after the Rogues quickly [[Dogfight above Dac|took out]] their foes, Dahl overlooked his actions due to the gravity of the situation. Their Admiral's response was to swiftly organize a massive [[Evacuation of Dac]], during which the Rogues helped fend off [[Outer Rim Third Fleet|Imperial forces]] who were targeting the volunteers of the ad hoc [[emergency evac fleet]]. The Imperials retreated when Roan Fel's General [[Oron Jaeger]] showed up with a fleet of his own, and evacuation continued unimpeded until time ran out. Only twenty percent of the planet's population was saved.<ref name="Legacy 47" />

[[File:Dogfightondac.jpg|thumb|right|225px|The Crossfire starfighters of Rogue Squadron destroy TIE Predators above Dac.]]
The Galactic Alliance Remnant united with the Empire-in-Exile and the New Jedi Order in an [[Alliance (Second Imperial Civil War)|Alliance]] against Darth Krayt, who began an aggressive military push against his foes. Admiral Stazi brought the ''Alliance'' and the Rogues to [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] to stop Imperial forces from [[Bombing of Falleen|bombing]] the planet, which was facing retribution for being unresponsive to Sith&ndash;Imperial overtures. Also at Falleen was the [[Mynock (Helot-class)|''Mynock'']], the ship of the famed Sith hunter [[Cade Skywalker]]; while Rogue Squadron faced off against TIE predators, Skywalker and Jedi Master [[Wolf Sazen]] boarded the Imperial [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battle cruiser]] ''[[Darklight]]'' and planted explosives, which won the day for the Alliance. Back aboard Stazi's flagship, Anj Dahl became acquainted with the ''Mynock''{{'s}} pilot, [[Jariah Syn]], while Skywalker spoke with Stazi.<ref name="Legacy War 2">[[Legacy — War 2|''Legacy — War'' 2]]</ref> Rogue Squadron and the Alliance fleet later came to the Jedi's aid in the [[Attack on the Hidden Temple|evacuation]] of their [[Hidden Temple (Sith–Imperial War)|Hidden Temple]],<ref name="Legacy War 4">[[Legacy — War 4|''Legacy — War'' 4]]</ref> arriving with one of Fel's fleets to trap an attacking Imperial armada.<ref name="Legacy War 3">[[Legacy — War 3|''Legacy — War'' 3]]</ref>

Having orchestrated the battle so that the entire Alliance would be in one place, Darth Krayt seized the moment and unleashed his secret [[Darth Krayt's Sith trooper|Sith troopers]] into the fray, who broke through the Alliance screen with their [[Dragon ship]]s and [[Annihilator-class starfighter|''Annihilator''-class starfighters]]. While they indiscriminately blasted friend and foe alike on their way to the surface of [[Taivas]], Rogue Squadron were already planetside, saving the ''Mynock'' from the elite Imperial [[Skull Squadron]]. Syn and the ''Mynock'' were thus able to rescue Skywalker from the temple after it launched its evac ships into the sky&mdash;he had remained behind to protect Jedi Master [[T'ra Saa/Legends|T'ra Saa]] from the attacking Sith troopers, which allowed her to channel the planet's energy into a [[beam of light]] that blasted into space and created an escape corridor for the overwhelmed Alliance fleet. Escaping with them were Skull Squadron and a number of other Sith&ndash;Imperial forces who followed Moff [[Rulf Yage]] in defecting from Krayt's Empire.<ref name="Legacy War 4" />

After regrouping at Bastion, the Alliance quickly launched for Coruscant, where a [[Cade Skywalker's strike team|strike team]] of Jedi and Imperial Knights disabled the [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world's]] orbital defenses. The move allowed the combined Alliance fleets to [[Battle of Coruscant (Second Imperial Civil War)|attack]], and the Rogues and Skulls flew into battle together against the Sith Troopers and their ''Annihilator''s. Andurgo<ref name="Legacy War 5">[[Legacy — War 5|''Legacy — War'' 5]]</ref> and Ronto both fell to enemy fire, but when Skywalker killed Krayt on the planet's surface, the Sith Troopers began to go mad. Krayt's surviving Sith acolytes fled the system, and a new [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]] was formed by the victorious Alliance.<ref name="Legacy War 6">[[Legacy — War 6|''Legacy — War'' 6]]</ref>

==Rogue Leaders==
===Luke Skywalker===
{{Main|Luke Skywalker/Legends}}
'''Luke Skywalker''' was one of two Red Squadron pilots to survive the Battle of Yavin in the year 0 BBY, an engagement in which he personally fired the proton torpedoes that destroyed the Empire's Death Star battlestation.<ref name="A New Hope" /> New to the Rebel Alliance, the Force-sensitive Skywalker initially honed his talents as a pilot rather than his skills as a Jedi,<ref name="NEGTC" /> and he was placed in charge of the burgeoning Rogue Flight by the Alliance's Commander Arhul Narra, leading them in various missions<ref name="Warfare" /> and racking up a number of victories.<ref name="NEGTC" /> Skywalker commanded the ad hoc Rogue Group in 3 ABY's Battle of Hoth,<ref name="Warfare" /> after which Wedge Antilles ascended to the Rogue Leader position.<ref name="Shadows novel" /> Skywalker flew often with the new Rogue Squadron over the following year, however,<ref name="NEGTC" /><ref name="Shadows novel" /><ref name="Rogue Leader 2" /> taking the position of Rogue Leader with Antilles flying as Rogue One.<ref name="Shadows Sourcebook" /> In 4 ABY, Skywalker permanently retired from the Rogues, deciding to finally concentrate on rebuilding the Jedi Order.<ref name="Rogue Leader 3" /> Nevertheless, he was promoted to the rank of general in the young New Republic, a commission which he did not resign until one year after Endor.<ref name="NEGTC" />

===Wedge Antilles===
{{Main|Wedge Antilles/Legends}}
[[File:WedgeAntilles.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Wedge Antilles leading Red Squadron at the Battle of Endor]]
A veteran of the cockpit, '''Wedge Antilles''' was often acclaimed as the best starfighter pilot in the galaxy.<ref name="Warfare" /> He developed tactics which were used as textbook examples for new Rebel pilots, and his X-wing piloting was used in simulators throughout the galaxy. His name was revered even among Imperial squadrons,<ref name="X-Wing Handbook" /> and it went on to become synonymous with Rogue Squadron itself.<ref name="Warfare" /> A Red Squadron survivor of Yavin<ref name="A New Hope" /> and a member of Rogue Flight right from its inception, Antilles was initially Skywalker's second-in-command in the nascent flight group. The two decided to expand Rogue Flight into a full squadron while stationed on Hoth, and Antilles participated in Rogue Group's defense of the Alliance's Echo Base,<ref name="Warfare" /> downing an AT-AT walker along with his gunner, Wes Janson.<ref name="ESB" /> Finding himself the new Rogue Leader following that battle,<ref name="Shadows novel" /> Antilles led Rogue Squadron as a unit operating with no set mission profile.<ref name="CSWE Rogue Squadron" /> Placed in permanent command of the squadron a year later,<ref name="Rogue Leader 3" /> just after leading it into the Battle of Endor,<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> he commanded the Rogues until their temporary dissolution in 5 ABY and resumed his post when the unit was rebuilt one year afterward.<ref name="NEGTC" />

That post was resigned by Antilles when the New Republic refused to wage war against the warlord Ysanne Isard, and he commanded his own, unofficial Rogue Squadron to defeat her in the Bacta War. That conflict was retroactively deemed an official New Republic operation, but Antilles promoted Tycho Celchu to Rogue Leader and instead focused on building the new Wraith Squadron.<ref name="Wraith Squadron" /> He later returned to Rogue Squadron as Rogue Leader,<ref name="Heir to the Empire" /> but an eventual promotion to general took him out of active pilot duty, although he would still sometimes oversee Rogue Squadron from the bridge of a capital ship.<ref name="Crimson Empire 5" /><ref name="Warfare" /> He was back in the cockpit as Rogue Leader in 19 ABY,<ref name="Specter of the Past" /> but following peace accords between the New Republic and the Imperial Remnant in that year, he retired from the military.<ref name="NEGTC" /> Decades later, Antilles flew against the Rogues as a member of Rakehell Squadron, which was supporting the Galactic Alliance&ndash;opposed Jedi Coalition in the Second Galactic Civil War. To his deep regret, he shot down and killed Lensi, the current Rogue Leader.<ref name="Fury" />

===Derek "Hobbie" Klivian===
{{Main|Derek Klivian/Legends}}
'''Derek Klivian,''' also known as '''Hobbie''', enlisted in the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] as a young man<ref name="Galaxy Guide 3">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]]</ref> but quickly defected to the Rebel Alliance, becoming one of its most talented pilots.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 3" /> Although he missed being a part of Red Squadron at Yavin due to injury,<ref name="Warfare" /> Klivian was one of the earliest Rogues<ref name="Galaxy Guide 3" /> and flew with them at Hoth<ref name="Warfare" /> and Endor.<ref name="The Briefing of Red Group" /> When Rogue Squadron was recommissioned by the New Republic in 6 ABY, Klivian was assigned elsewhere to train new starfighter squadrons,<ref name="Rogue Squadron" /> but the New Republic brought him in to lead an ersatz Rogue Squadron one year later. He and Wes Janson cobbled together the temporary squadron in order to keep up New Republic citizens' morale following Antilles's resignation. After this brief run as Rogue Leader, Klivian continued flying with the squadron<ref name="Wraith Squadron" /> until his retirement, which came in the wake of the peace between the New Republic and Imperial Remnant.<ref name="Onslaught" /> During his years as a Rogue, Klivian was known for his cautious pessimism<ref name="Galaxy Guide 3" /> and beloved for his vast experience in an X-wing fighter. He was also a survivor of many crashes and a frequenter of healing bacta tanks.<ref name="Who's Who" />

===Tycho Celchu===
{{Main|Tycho Celchu/Legends}}
[[File:Tychocockpitshot.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Tycho Celchu in the cockpit]]
A superior pilot,<ref name="CSWE Tycho" /> the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] '''Tycho Celchu''' served in the Imperial Academy until the Empire [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed his homeworld]]. Defecting to the Alliance, Celchu soon joined the ranks of the Rogues and flew with them at the Battle of Hoth.<ref name="NEGTC" /> Although he piloted an A-wing in the Alliance's Green Squadron at Endor,<ref name="Tycho CCG" /> Celchu was soon back with the Rogues, but a brief period of Imperial imprisonment led some in the New Republic to suspect him of being a brainwashed sleeper agent.<ref name="NEGTC" /> Antilles had to settle for installing Celchu as his Executive Officer in the recommissioned Rogue Squadron<ref name="Rogue Squadron" /> until the man's innocence could be proven.<ref name="NEGTC" /> After the Bacta War, Celchu became temporary Rogue Leader while Antilles was building Wraith Squadron,<ref name="Wraith Squadron" /> and he took the position permanently following Antilles's promotion to general. Major Rogue operations under his command included the hunt for the Invid Pirates<ref name="I, Jedi" /> and the Orinda campaign.<ref name="Warfare" /> Although Antilles was Rogue Leader during the Caamas Document Crisis of 19 ABY,<ref name="Specter of the Past" /> it was Celchu who handed over command of the squadron to Gavin Darklighter before his retirement, which came shortly after Antilles's own.<ref name="CSWE Tycho" />

===Gavin Darklighter===
{{Main|Gavin Darklighter}}
After learning how to fly from behind the yoke of a [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16 skyhopper]] on his homeworld of Tatooine, '''Gavin Darklighter''' joined Rogue Squadron at the age of sixteen, making the cut in part due to his martyred cousin, Biggs.<ref name="NEGTC" /> Support from his fellow Rogues enabled the young pilot to realize his full potential,<ref name="Fact File 90 Gavin">{{FactFile|90|DAR 5-6|Gavin Darklighter}}</ref> and he proved his skills many times over, becoming a master of the strafing run.<ref name="Fact File 14 Rogue Squadron">{{FactFile|14|ROG 1-2|X-Wing Rogue Squadron}}</ref> After years in the squadron and many battles fought, Darklighter became the new Rogue Leader when Antilles and Celchu both retired, but his command of the Rogues was tested by the threat of the extra-galactic Yuuzhan Vong. Serious squadron losses were suffered against the mysterious enemy coralskippers<ref name="NEGTC" /> until Darklighter devised a countermeasure involving his X-wing's inertial compensators,<ref name="Dark Journey" /> and he went on to lead a rebuilt Rogue Squadron in numerous battles against the Yuuzhan Vong, including the evacuation of Coruscant<ref name="NEGTC" /> and the later [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar|recapture of it]].<ref name="The Unifying Force">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref> After the war, he became a [[Commodore/Legends|commodore]] in the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet]].<ref name="The Unseen Queen chapter 10">''[[Dark Nest II: The Unseen Queen]]''</ref>

===Corran Horn===
{{Main|Corran Horn/Legends}}
[[File:CorranHorn-NEGTC2.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Corran Horn briefly commanded the Rogues despite being a full-time Jedi.]]
The Force-sensitive ace pilot '''Corran Horn''' joined a restructured Rogue Squadron<ref name="NEGTC" /> after the New Republic took notice of his flying skills and invited him to apply.<ref name="Fact File 70 Corran">{{FactFile|70|HOR 1-2|Corran Horn}}</ref> He remained with the squadron for years, flying in some of the most important and dangerous missions in which any starfighters had ever been engaged. He also spent time honing his skills with the Force,<ref name="Fact File 90 Corran">{{FactFile|90|HOR 3-4|Corran Horn}}</ref> and when he finally retired from the military, he became a full-time Jedi in Skywalker's order.<ref name="NEGTC" /> Despite this, Horn briefly took command of Rogue Squadron during the Yuuzhan Vong War, serving as Rogue Leader during battles [[Second Battle of Obroa-skai|at Obroa-skai]] and [[Battle of Ebaq|at Ebaq 9]].<ref name="Destiny's Way" />

===Jaina Solo===
{{Main|Jaina Solo Fel}}
'''Jaina Solo''' was a Jedi student and the niece of Luke Skywalker, skilled both with the Force and behind the controls of a starfighter. She was accepted into Rogue Squadron by Gavin Darklighter early in the Yuuzhan Vong Invasion, and she flew in such engagements as the Battle of Dantooine.<ref name="NEGTC" /> Darklighter quickly developed a great respect for her talents,<ref name="Fact File 90 Gavin" /> but she was asked to take an indefinite leave of absence from the squadron when the Yuuzhan Vong began calling for the extermination of the Jedi.<ref name="NEGTC" /> Solo soon took over Twin Suns Squadron from her uncle and commanded it for much of the remainder of the war.<ref name="CSWE Twin Suns Squadron">{{CSWECite|III|270|Twin Suns Squadron}}</ref> When the Corellian government began to rebel against the Galactic Alliance over a decade later, Solo volunteered for active flight duty and was put in command of Rogue Squadron.<ref name="Bloodlines" /> Her tenure as Rogue Leader<ref name="CSWE Rogue Leader" /> was cut short, however, when her morality prompted her to refuse an order from her brother, who was in charge of the Rogues' battle group, and he suspended her from duty.<ref name="Bloodlines" />

===Lensi===
{{Main|Lensi}}
'''Lensi''', a Duros, had claimed a spot in Rogue Squadron<ref name="Rebirth" /> a year and a half into the Yuuzhan Vong War.<ref name="NEC" /> He flew in the Second Battle of Sernpidal, in which the Rogues were told by the rogue Jedi Kyp Durron that they were attacking a gravitic superweapon, but were in fact tricked into helping destroy an enemy worldship that was being grown for non-military purposes.<ref name="Rebirth" /> The sting of Durron's lie remained with Lensi, and when he was involved in a [[Battle of the Duro system|feint attack]] on Yuuzhan Vong&ndash;held Duro<ref name="The Final Prophecy chapter 4">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Final Prophecy]]''</ref> more than two years later,<ref name="NEC" /> he was kept in the dark about the battle's true nature<ref name="The Final Prophecy chapter 4" /> and resigned his commission, feeling betrayed. Lensi later rejoined the squadron and eventually came to command it,<ref name="CSWE Lensi">{{CSWECite|II|250|Lensi}}</ref> but the Rogue Leader was shot down and killed by Wedge Antilles during the Second Galactic Civil War.<ref name="Fury" />

===Jhoram Bey===
{{Main|Jhoram Bey}}
[[File:Anvilandhammer.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Anj Dahl, Rogue Leader]]
In the year 137 ABY, the [[Weequay]] '''Jhoram Bey''' led Rogue Squadron<ref name="Legacy 20" /> during their assignment to the Galactic Alliance Core Fleet. He was dedicated to the fleet, and although the irregulars under his command were lacking in discipline, his strong presence and personality kept them in order and ensured that they were always combat-ready.<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> When the flagship of the Galactic Alliance Remnant's leader, Gar Stazi, took major damage during a battle at Dac, Bey docked his fighter aboard the warship and rushed to its bridge. Stazi was planning to sacrifice his own life, but Bey punched his superior in the face in order to keep him alive and a symbol of hope to the embattled Alliance. As a reprisal, Stazi promoted Bey to be his new second-in-command.<ref name="Legacy 21" />

===Anj Dahl===
{{Main|Anj Dahl}}
A talented pilot and an enthusiastic troublemaker, '''Anj Dahl''' joined the Rogues several years after [[130 ABY]]'s Battle of Caamas. Feeling that everything could end at any moment, she embraced all that was fun in life.<ref name="LECG" /> Dahl saw combat with Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire at Dac<ref name="Legacy 21" /> and at Raaltiir, replacing Jhoram Bey as Rogue Leader between the two battles.<ref name="Legacy 36" /> She was unhappy with the promotion, feeling that Bey had been a more capable commander, but fellow Rogue Hondo Karr believed that her only problem was treating her squadron mates as friends.<ref name="Legacy 41" /> Dahl stayed on as Rogue Leader through the war's end, leading the squadron against Krayt's forces in major engagements at Taivas<ref name="Legacy War 4" /> and Coruscant.<ref name="Legacy War 6" />
